16.105.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sthānamuttamam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ vistarātkatha yāmi te .. 1 ..
16.105.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथान्यत्संप्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं स्थानमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापहरं नृणां विस्तरात्कथ यामि ते .. 1 ..
16.105.m: Īśvara said: / “Now I shall proclaim another secret, supreme place / that removes all sins of men; I will describe it to you at length.

16.105.s:
pradhānadevamāhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kalpavāsinām ..
someśo daityahaṃtā ca vālarūpī pitāmahaḥ ..2..
16.105.d:
प्रधानदेवमाहात्म्यं माहात्म्यं कल्पवासिनाम् ..
सोमेशो दैत्यहंता च वालरूपी पितामहः ..2..
16.105.m: It is the māhātmya of the principal deities, the māhātmya of those who dwell there for a kalpa: / Someśa, the slayer of Daityas, the Grandfather in child form,

16.105.s:
arkasthalastathādityaḥ prabhāsaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
ete ṣaṭpravarā devāḥ kṣetre prābhāsike sthitāḥ .. 3 ..
16.105.d:
अर्कस्थलस्तथादित्यः प्रभासः शशिभूषणः ..
एते षट्प्रवरा देवाः क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके स्थिताः .. 3 ..
16.105.m: Arkasthala, as well as Āditya, Prabhāsa, and the moon-adorned one. / These are the six eminent gods established in the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.105.s:
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyaḥ prajāyate ..
mucyate pātakairghorairājanmajanitairdhru vam .. 4 ..
16.105.d:
तेषां दर्शनमात्रेण कृतकृत्यः प्रजायते ..
मुच्यते पातकैर्घोरैराजन्मजनितैर्ध्रु वम् .. 4 ..
16.105.m: By merely beholding them, a person achieves all his aims / and is surely freed from terrible sins accumulated since birth.”

16.105.s:
.. devyuvāca.. ..
pūrveṣāmuktadevānāṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tvayā ..
prabhāse bālarūpīti yatproktaṃ tatkathaṃ vacaḥ .. 5 ..
16.105.d:
.. देव्युवाच.. ..
पूर्वेषामुक्तदेवानां माहात्म्यं कथितं त्वया ..
प्रभासे बालरूपीति यत्प्रोक्तं तत्कथं वचः .. 5 ..
16.105.m: The goddess said: / “The māhātmya of the aforesaid gods has been related by you; / but what is the meaning of the statement made that the Grandfather has the form of a child in Prabhāsa?

16.105.s:
anyeṣu sarva sthāneṣu vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
kathaṃ ca samanuprāpto māhātmyaṃ tasya kiṃ smṛtam .. 6 ..
16.105.d:
अन्येषु सर्व स्थानेषु वृद्धरूपी पितामहः ..
कथं च समनुप्राप्तो माहात्म्यं तस्य किं स्मृतम् .. 6 ..
16.105.m: In all other places, the Grandfather has the form of an old man. / How did he come there, and what is remembered as his māhātmya?

16.105.s:
kathaṃ sa pūjyo deveśa yātrā kāryā kathaṃ nṛbhiḥ ..
etadvistarato brūhi prasanno yadi me prabho .. 7 ..
16.105.d:
कथं स पूज्यो देवेश यात्रा कार्या कथं नृभिः ..
एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि प्रसन्नो यदि मे प्रभो .. 7 ..
16.105.m: How should he be worshipped, O Lord of gods? How should the pilgrimage be performed by men? / Tell this in detail, O Lord, if you are pleased with me.”

16.105.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ brahmasambhavam ..
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 8 ..
16.105.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं ब्रह्मसम्भवम् ..
यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 8 ..
16.105.m:
Īśvara said:
Listen, O goddess, I shall declare the māhātmya concerning Brahmā,
by the mere hearing of which one is freed from all sins.

16.105.s:
nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ ..
nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti brahmasamaṃ tapaḥ .. 9 ..
16.105.d:
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो देवो नास्ति ब्रह्मसमो गुरुः ..
नास्ति ब्रह्मसमं ज्ञानं नास्ति ब्रह्मसमं तपः .. 9 ..
16.105.m:
There is no god equal to Brahmā; there is no guru equal to Brahmā;
there is no knowledge equal to Brahmā; there is no austerity equal to Brahmā.

16.105.s:
tāvaddhamaṃti saṃsāre duḥkha śokabhayaplutāḥ ..
na bhavaṃti surajyeṣṭhe yāvadbhaktāḥ pitāmahe .. 7.1.105.10 ..
16.105.d:
तावद्धमंति संसारे दुःख शोकभयप्लुताः ..
न भवंति सुरज्येष्ठे यावद्भक्ताः पितामहे .. 7.1.105.10 ..
16.105.m:
They wander in saṃsāra, flooded with grief, sorrow, and fear,
only as long as they do not become devoted to the grandfather, the eldest among the gods.

16.105.s:
samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jantorviṣayagocare ..
yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta baṃdhanāt .. 11 ..
16.105.d:
समासक्तं यथा चित्तं जन्तोर्विषयगोचरे ..
यद्येवं ब्रह्मणि न्यस्तं को न मुच्येत बंधनात् .. 11 ..
16.105.m:
Just as a creature's mind is intensely attached to the realm of sense objects,
if it were thus directed towards Brahmā, who would not be liberated from bondage?

16.105.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
evaṃ māhātmyasaṃyukto yadi brahmā jagadguruḥ ..
prābhāsike mahātīrthe kasminsthāne tu saṃsthitaḥ .. .. 12 ..
16.105.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
एवं माहात्म्यसंयुक्तो यदि ब्रह्मा जगद्गुरुः ..
प्राभासिके महातीर्थे कस्मिन्स्थाने तु संस्थितः .. .. 12 ..
16.105.m:
The goddess said:
If Brahmā, the guru of the universe, is endowed with such māhātmya,
then in what location does he dwell in the great sacred ford of Prabhāsa?

16.105.s:
kimarthamāgatastatra kasminkāle surottamaḥ ..
kathaṃ sa pūjyo vipreṃdraistithau kasyāṃ kramādvada .. 13 ..
16.105.d:
किमर्थमागतस्तत्र कस्मिन्काले सुरोत्तमः ..
कथं स पूज्यो विप्रेंद्रैस्तिथौ कस्यां क्रमाद्वद .. 13 ..
16.105.m:
For what reason did that best of gods come there, and at what time?
How is he to be worshipped by the foremost of brahmins, and on which lunar day? Tell me in order.

16.105.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
somanāthasya aiśānyāṃ sāṃbādityāgnigocare ..
brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaloka ivāparaḥ .. 14
16.105.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सोमनाथस्य ऐशान्यां सांबादित्याग्निगोचरे ..
ब्रह्मणः परमं स्थानं ब्रह्मलोक इवापरः .. 14
16.105.m:
Īśvara said:
To the northeast of Somanātha, in the direction of the fire god from Sāmbāditya,
is the supreme abode of Brahmā, like a second Brahmaloka.

16.105.s:
tiṣṭhate kalpasaṃsthā vai tatra kalpāṃtavāsinaḥ ..
tatra sthāne sthito devi bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ .. 15 ..
16.105.d:
तिष्ठते कल्पसंस्था वै तत्र कल्पांतवासिनः ..
तत्र स्थाने स्थितो देवि बालरूपी पितामहः .. 15 ..
16.105.m:
The cosmic ages stay there, and those who dwell until the end of a kalpa;
in that place, O goddess, the grandfather resides in the form of a child.

16.105.s:
jagatprabhurlokakartā sattvamūrtirmahāprabhaḥ ..
āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe .. 16 ..
16.105.d:
जगत्प्रभुर्लोककर्ता सत्त्वमूर्तिर्महाप्रभः ..
आगतश्चाष्टवर्षस्तु क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे .. 16 ..
16.105.m:
The lord of the universe, the creator of the worlds, the embodiment of sattva, of great radiance,
came to the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa as an eight-year-old.

16.105.s:
tatrā'karottapo ghoraṃ divyābdānāṃ sahasrakam ..
saṃsthāpya tu mahāliṃgaṃ sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ .. 17 ..
16.105.d:
तत्राऽकरोत्तपो घोरं दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रकम् ..
संस्थाप्य तु महालिंगं सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः .. 17 ..
16.105.m:
There he performed terrible austerity for a thousand divine years,
having installed a great liṅga, desiring to create various creatures.

16.105.s:
tataḥ kālāṃtaretīte somena prārthito vibhuḥ ..
kṣayarogavimuktena samyakchraddhānvitena vai .. 18 ..
16.105.d:
ततः कालांतरेतीते सोमेन प्रार्थितो विभुः ..
क्षयरोगविमुक्तेन सम्यक्छ्रद्धान्वितेन वै .. 18 ..
16.105.m:
Then, after a period of time had elapsed, the all-pervading lord was requested by Soma,
who had been freed from consumption and was endowed with full faith,

16.105.s:
liṃgapratiṣṭhāhetorvai kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe ..
koṭibrahmarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sahito viśvakarmaṇā ..
kārayāmāsa vidhivatpratiṣṭhāṃ liṃgamuttamam.. 19 ..
16.105.d:
लिंगप्रतिष्ठाहेतोर्वै क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे ..
कोटिब्रह्मर्षिभिः सार्द्धं सहितो विश्वकर्मणा ..
कारयामास विधिवत्प्रतिष्ठां लिंगमुत्तमम्.. 19 ..

16.105.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya tato liṃgaṃ somanāthaṃ varānane ..
dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo bhūriśo yajñadakṣiṇām .. 7.1.105.20 ..
16.105.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततो लिंगं सोमनाथं वरानने ..
दापयामास विप्रेभ्यो भूरिशो यज्ञदक्षिणाम् .. 7.1.105.20 ..
16.105.m:
Having then consecrated that liṅga, Somanātha, O fair-faced one,
he had abundant sacrificial fees given to the brahmins.

16.105.s:
evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā ..
varṣāṇi cātra jātāni prabhāse bālarūpiṇaḥ .. 21 ..
16.105.d:
एवं प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा ..
वर्षाणि चात्र जातानि प्रभासे बालरूपिणः .. 21 ..
16.105.m:
Thus the liṅga was consecrated by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds;
and years have passed for him here in Prabhāsa in the form of a child.

16.105.s:
catvāriṃśadvayaṃ caiva kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ ..
evaṃ parārddhamagamatprabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ .. 22 ..
16.105.d:
चत्वारिंशद्वयं चैव क्षेत्रमध्यनिवासिनः ..
एवं परार्द्धमगमत्प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनः .. 22 ..
16.105.m:
His age as a dweller within the sacred field is forty [years];
thus a parārdha has passed for him as an inhabitant of the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.105.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
brahmaṇo dinamānaṃ tu māsavarṣasahasrakam ..
tatsarvaṃ vistarādbrūhi yathāyurbrahmaṇaḥ smṛta m .. 23 ..
16.105.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मणो दिनमानं तु मासवर्षसहस्रकम् ..
तत्सर्वं विस्तराद्ब्रूहि यथायुर्ब्रह्मणः स्मृत म् .. 23 ..
16.105.m:
The goddess said:
Tell me in detail the full measure of a day of Brahmā, / as well as the months, years, and thousands,
according as the lifespan of Brahmā is recorded.

16.105.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
paramāyuḥ smṛto brahmā parārddhaṃ tasya vai gatam..
prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthasya dvitīyaṃ bhavate'dhunā .. 24 ..
16.105.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
परमायुः स्मृतो ब्रह्मा परार्द्धं तस्य वै गतम्..
प्रभासक्षेत्रसंस्थस्य द्वितीयं भवतेऽधुना .. 24 ..
16.105.m:
Īśvara said:
Brahmā is recorded to have the supreme lifespan; indeed, a parārdha of his has passed.
Now begins the second [parārdha] for him who resides in the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.105.s:
yadā prābhāsike kṣetre brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu bālarūpī tadocyate .. 25 ..
16.105.d:
यदा प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
आगतश्चाष्टवर्षस्तु बालरूपी तदोच्यते .. 25 ..
16.105.m:
When Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa,
he was eight years of age, and therefore he is called 'the child-formed'.

16.105.s:
anyeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
muktvā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ sadaiva vibudhapriye .. 26 ..
16.105.d:
अन्येषु सर्वतीर्थेषु वृद्धरूपी पितामहः ..
मुक्त्वा प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं सदैव विबुधप्रिये .. 26 ..
16.105.m:
In all other sacred fords, the grandfather has the form of an old man,
except in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, always, O beloved of the gods.

16.105.s:
brahmāṃḍe yāni tīrthāni brahmāṇasteṣu ye smṛtāḥ ..
teṣāmādyo mahātejāḥ prabhāse yo vyavasthitaḥ .. 27 ..
16.105.d:
ब्रह्मांडे यानि तीर्थानि ब्रह्माणस्तेषु ये स्मृताः ..
तेषामाद्यो महातेजाः प्रभासे यो व्यवस्थितः .. 27 ..
16.105.m:
Among all the tīrthas in the universe, whatever manifestations of Brahmā are recalled,
the first of them is the one of great splendour who resides in Prabhāsa.

16.105.s:
kalpekalpe tu nāmāni śṛṇu tvaṃ tāni vai priye ..
svayaṃbhūḥ prathame kalpe dvitīye padmabhūḥ sthitaḥ .. .28 ..
tṛtīye viśvakarteti bālarūpī caturthake ..
etāni mukhyanāmāni kathitāni svayaṃbhuvaḥ .. 29 ..
16.105.d:
कल्पेकल्पे तु नामानि शृणु त्वं तानि वै प्रिये ..
स्वयंभूः प्रथमे कल्पे द्वितीये पद्मभूः स्थितः .. .28 ..
तृतीये विश्वकर्तेति बालरूपी चतुर्थके ..
एतानि मुख्यनामानि कथितानि स्वयंभुवः .. 29 ..
16.105.m:
Hear his names in kalpa after kalpa, O beloved:
he was Svayambhū in the first kalpa; in the second, he was Padmabhū; / in the third, he was Viśvakartṛ; and in the fourth, he was Bālarūpin.
These principal names of the self-manifest one have been told.

16.105.s: nityaṃ saṃsmarate yastu sa dīrghāyurnaro bhavet ..7.1.105.30..
16.105.d: नित्यं संस्मरते यस्तु स दीर्घायुर्नरो भवेत् ..7.1.105.30..
16.105.m: The man who constantly remembers them becomes long-lived.

16.105.s:
candrasūryagrahāḥ sarve sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ..
trailokyaṃ naśyate sarvaṃ brahmarātri samāgame..31..
16.105.d:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहाः सर्वे सदेवासुरमानुषाः ..
त्रैलोक्यं नश्यते सर्वं ब्रह्मरात्रि समागमे..31..
16.105.m:
The moon, sun, and all the planets, along with gods, asuras, and humans—
the entire three worlds perish at the arrival of the night of Brahmā.

16.105.s:
punardine tu saṃjāte prabuddhaḥ sanpitāmahaḥ..
tathā sṛṣṭiṃ prakurute yathāpūrvamabhūtpriye..32..
16.105.d:
पुनर्दिने तु संजाते प्रबुद्धः सन्पितामहः..
तथा सृष्टिं प्रकुरुते यथापूर्वमभूत्प्रिये..32..
16.105.m:
When day dawns once again, the grandfather, having awakened,
performs the creation just as it was before, O beloved.

16.105.s:
dinamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇo lokakartṛṇaḥ ..
netrabhāgāccaturbhāgastruṭiḥ kālo nigadyate .. 33 ..
16.105.d:
दिनमानं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणो लोककर्तृणः ..
नेत्रभागाच्चतुर्भागस्त्रुटिः कालो निगद्यते .. 33 ..
16.105.m:
I shall declare the measure of a day of Brahmā, the creator of the worlds:
a fourth part of an eye's wink is said to be the unit of time called a truṭi.

16.105.s:
tasmācca dviguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ nimiṣāṃtaṃ varānane ..
nimiṣaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā ityucyate budhaiḥ..
triṃśadbhiścaiva kāṣṭhābhiḥ kalā proktā manīṣibhiḥ ..34..
16.105.d:
तस्माच्च द्विगुणं ज्ञेयं निमिषांतं वरानने ..
निमिषैः पञ्चदशभिः काष्ठा इत्युच्यते बुधैः..
त्रिंशद्भिश्चैव काष्ठाभिः कला प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः ..34..

16.105.s:
triṃśatkalo muhūrtaḥ syāddinaṃ paṃcadaśaistu taiḥ..
dinamānā niśā jñeyā ahorātraṃ tayorbhavet ..35..
16.105.d:
त्रिंशत्कलो मुहूर्तः स्याद्दिनं पंचदशैस्तु तैः..
दिनमाना निशा ज्ञेया अहोरात्रं तयोर्भवेत् ..35..
16.105.m:
Thirty kalās make a muhūrta, and fifteen of them make a day;
the night is to be known as of the same measure as the day; the two make a day-and-night.

16.105.s:
taiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣābhyāṃ māsa ucyate ..
māsaiścaivāyanaṃ ṣaṅbhirabdaṃ syādayanadvayāt ..36..
16.105.d:
तैः पंचदशभिः पक्षः पक्षाभ्यां मास उच्यते ..
मासैश्चैवायनं षङ्भिरब्दं स्यादयनद्वयात् ..36..
16.105.m:
Fifteen of these [days and nights] make a fortnight; two fortnights are called a month;
six months make an ayana; and from two ayanas a year is formed.

16.105.s:
catvāriṃśaddhi lakṣāṇi lakṣāṇāṃ tritayaṃ punaḥ ..
viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi jñeyaṃ sauraṃ caturyugam .. 37 ..
16.105.d:
चत्वारिंशद्धि लक्षाणि लक्षाणां त्रितयं पुनः ..
विंशतिश्च सहस्राणि ज्ञेयं सौरं चतुर्युगम् .. 37 ..
16.105.m:
Forty lakhs, and three lakhs more,
and twenty thousand [solar years] are to be known as a solar caturyuga.

16.105.s:
caturyugaikasaptatyā manvaṃtaramudāhṛtam ..
aindrametadbhavedāyuḥ samāsāttava kīrtitam .. 38 ..
16.105.d:
चतुर्युगैकसप्तत्या मन्वंतरमुदाहृतम् ..
ऐन्द्रमेतद्भवेदायुः समासात्तव कीर्तितम् .. 38 ..
16.105.m:
Seventy-one caturyugas are declared to be a manvantara;
this is the lifespan of an Indra, told to you in brief.

16.105.s:
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ manuḥ svārociṣastataḥ ..
auttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastataḥ .. 39..
16.105.d:
स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं मनुः स्वारोचिषस्ततः ..
औत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्ततः .. 39..
16.105.m:
First was Svāyambhuva Manu, and then Svārociṣa Manu;
Auttami, Tāmasa, Raivata, and then Cākṣuṣa;

16.105.s:
vaivasvato'rkasāvarṇirbrahmasā varṇireva ca ..
dharmasāvarṇināmā ca raucyo bhūtyastathaiva ca .. 7.1.105.40 ..
16.105.d:
वैवस्वतोऽर्कसावर्णिर्ब्रह्मसा वर्णिरेव च ..
धर्मसावर्णिनामा च रौच्यो भूत्यस्तथैव च .. 7.1.105.40 ..
16.105.m:
Vaivasvata, Arkasāvarṇi, and Brahmasāvarṇi;
and the one named Dharmasāvarṇi, Raucya, and likewise Bhautya.

16.105.s:
caturdaśaite manavaḥ sam̐khyātāste yathākramam ..
bhūtānbhaviṣyāniṃdrāṃśca sarvā nvakṣye tava kramāt .. 41 ..
16.105.d:
चतुर्दशैते मनवः सम्̐ख्यातास्ते यथाक्रमम् ..
भूतान्भविष्यानिंद्रांश्च सर्वा न्वक्ष्ये तव क्रमात् .. 41 ..
16.105.m:
These fourteen Manus have been enumerated to you in order;
and I shall declare to you in sequence all the past and future Indras:

16.105.s:
viśvabhukca vipaścicca sukīrtiḥ śibireva ca ..
vibhurmanobhuvaścaiva tathaujasvī balirbalī .. 42 ..
16.105.d:
विश्वभुक्च विपश्चिच्च सुकीर्तिः शिबिरेव च ..
विभुर्मनोभुवश्चैव तथौजस्वी बलिर्बली .. 42 ..
16.105.m:
Viśvabhuj, Vipaścit, Sukīrti, and Śibi;
Vibhu, Manobhuva, and likewise the mighty Ojasvin, Bali;

16.105.s:
adbhutaśca tathā śāṃtī ramyo devavaro vṛṣā ..
ṛtadhāmā divaḥsvāmī śuciḥ śakrāścaturdaśa .. 43 ..
16.105.d:
अद्भुतश्च तथा शांती रम्यो देववरो वृषा ..
ऋतधामा दिवःस्वामी शुचिः शक्राश्चतुर्दश .. 43 ..
16.105.m:
Adbhuta, and likewise Śānti, Ramya, Devavara, Vṛṣan,
Ṛtadhāman, Divaḥsvāmin, and Śuci—these are the fourteen Śakras.

16.105.s:
ete sarve vinaśyaṃti brahmaṇo divase priye ..
rātristu tāvatī jñeyā kalpamānamidaṃ smṛtam .. 44 ..
16.105.d:
एते सर्वे विनश्यंति ब्रह्मणो दिवसे प्रिये ..
रात्रिस्तु तावती ज्ञेया कल्पमानमिदं स्मृतम् .. 44 ..
16.105.m:
All these perish in a single day of Brahmā, O beloved;
the night is to be known as of equal length; this is recalled as the measure of a kalpa.

16.105.s:
prathamaṃ śvetakalpastu dvitīyo nīlalohitaḥ ..
vāmadevastṛtīyastu tato rāthaṃtaro'paraḥ .. 45 ..
16.105.d:
प्रथमं श्वेतकल्पस्तु द्वितीयो नीललोहितः ..
वामदेवस्तृतीयस्तु ततो राथंतरोऽपरः .. 45 ..
16.105.m:
The first is the Śvetakalpa, and the second is the Nīlalohita;
the third is Vāmadeva, and after that the other is Rāthantara;

16.105.s:
rauravaḥ paṃcamaḥ proktaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāṇa iti smṛtaḥ ..
saptamo'tha bṛhatkalpaḥ kandarpo'ṣṭama ucyate .. 46 ..
16.105.d:
रौरवः पंचमः प्रोक्तः षष्ठः प्राण इति स्मृतः ..
सप्तमोऽथ बृहत्कल्पः कन्दर्पोऽष्टम उच्यते .. 46 ..
16.105.m:
the fifth is declared to be Raurava; the sixth is recorded as Prāṇa;
then the seventh is the Bṛhatkalpa; the eighth is called Kandarpa;

16.105.s:
sadyo'tha navamaḥ proktaḥ īśāno daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
dhyāna ekādaśaḥ proktastathā sārasvato'paraḥ .. 47 ..
16.105.d:
सद्योऽथ नवमः प्रोक्तः ईशानो दशमः स्मृतः ..
ध्यान एकादशः प्रोक्तस्तथा सारस्वतोऽपरः .. 47 ..
16.105.m:
then the ninth is declared to be Sadya; the tenth is remembered as Īśāna;
the eleventh is declared to be Dhyāna; and the next is Sārasvata;

16.105.s:
trayodaśa udānastu garuḍo'tha caturdaśaḥ ..
kaurmaḥ paṃcadaśo jñeyaḥ paurṇamāsī prajāpateḥ .. 48 ..
16.105.d:
त्रयोदश उदानस्तु गरुडोऽथ चतुर्दशः ..
कौर्मः पंचदशो ज्ञेयः पौर्णमासी प्रजापतेः .. 48 ..
16.105.m:
the thirteenth is Udāna, and then the fourteenth is Garuḍa;
the fifteenth should be known as Kaurma, the full-moon day of Prajāpati;

16.105.s:
ṣoḍaśo nārasiṃhastu samādhistu tataḥ paraḥ ..
āgneyo'ṣṭādaśaḥ proktaḥ somakalpastato'paraḥ .. 49 ..
16.105.d:
षोडशो नारसिंहस्तु समाधिस्तु ततः परः ..
आग्नेयोऽष्टादशः प्रोक्तः सोमकल्पस्ततोऽपरः .. 49 ..
16.105.m:
the sixteenth is Nārasiṃha, and following that is Samādhi;
the eighteenth is declared to be Āgneya, and after that the Somakalpa.

16.105.s:
bhāvano viṃśatiḥ proktaḥ suptamālīti cāparaḥ ..
vaikuṇṭhaścārciṣo rudro lakṣmīkalpastathāpareḥ .. 7.1.105.50 ..
16.105.d:
भावनो विंशतिः प्रोक्तः सुप्तमालीति चापरः ..
वैकुण्ठश्चार्चिषो रुद्रो लक्ष्मीकल्पस्तथापरेः .. 7.1.105.50 ..
16.105.m: The twentieth is said to be the Bhāvana, and another is Suptamālin; / then Vaikuṇṭha, Arciṣa, Rudra, and next the Lakṣmīkalpa.

16.105.s:
saptaviṃśo'tha vairājo gaurīkalpastathoṃ''dhakaḥ ..
māheśvarastathā proktastripuro yatra ghātitaḥ .. 51 ..
16.105.d:
सप्तविंशोऽथ वैराजो गौरीकल्पस्तथों'ऽधकः ..
माहेश्वरस्तथा प्रोक्तस्त्रिपुरो यत्र घातितः .. 51 ..
16.105.m: The twenty-seventh is the Vairāja, then the Gaurīkalpa and Andhaka; / then the Māheśvara is proclaimed, wherein Tripura was slain.

16.105.s:
pitṛkalpastathāṃte ca yā kuhūrbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtā ..
triṃśatkalpāḥ samākhyātā brahmaṇo māsi vai priye .. 52 ..
16.105.d:
पितृकल्पस्तथांते च या कुहूर्ब्रह्मणः स्मृता ..
त्रिंशत्कल्पाः समाख्याता ब्रह्मणो मासि वै प्रिये .. 52 ..
16.105.m: And at the end is the Pitṛkalpa, which is regarded as the new-moon day of Brahmā. / Thus thirty kalpas are enumerated in a month of Brahmā, O beloved!

16.105.s:
atītāḥ kathitāḥ sarve vārāho varttate'dhunā ..
pratipadbrahmaṇo yatra vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī .. 53 ..
16.105.d:
अतीताः कथिताः सर्वे वाराहो वर्त्ततेऽधुना ..
प्रतिपद्ब्रह्मणो यत्र वाराहेणोद्धृता मही .. 53 ..
16.105.m: All these have passed; now the Vārāha is current, / the first day of the fortnight of Brahmā, wherein the earth was raised up by the Boar.

16.105.s:
triṃśatkalpaiḥ smṛto māso varṣaṃ dvādaśabhistu taiḥ ..
anena varṣamānena tadā brahmā'ṣṭavārṣikaḥ ..
ānītaḥ somarājena somanāthaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 54 ..
16.105.d:
त्रिंशत्कल्पैः स्मृतो मासो वर्षं द्वादशभिस्तु तैः ..
अनेन वर्षमानेन तदा ब्रह्माऽष्टवार्षिकः ..
आनीतः सोमराजेन सोमनाथः प्रतिष्ठितः .. 54 ..
16.105.m: A month is considered to consist of thirty kalpas, and a year of twelve such [months]. / By this reckoning of years, Brahmā was then eight years old / when brought by the moon-god, and Somanātha was consecrated.

16.105.s:
evaṃ kṣetre nivasataḥ prabhāse bālarūpiṇaḥ ..
parārddhamekamagamaddvitīyaṃ vartate' dhunā .. 55 ..
16.105.d:
एवं क्षेत्रे निवसतः प्रभासे बालरूपिणः ..
परार्द्धमेकमगमद्द्वितीयं वर्तते' धुना .. 55 ..
16.105.m: While he thus resided in the sacred field of Prabhāsa in the form of a child, / one half [of his lifespan] passed, and the second is current now.

16.105.s:
evaṃ mahāprabhāvo'sau prabhāsakṣetramadhyagaḥ ..
brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānbālatvātkṣetramāśritaḥ .. 56 ..
16.105.d:
एवं महाप्रभावोऽसौ प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यगः ..
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान्बालत्वात्क्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 56 ..
16.105.m: Thus of great power is this Lord Brahmā, self-manifest, situated in the midst of the Prabhāsakṣetra, / who resorted to the sacred field on account of his childhood.

16.105.s:
sa vai pūjyo namaskāryo vaṃdanīyo manīṣibhiḥ ..
ādau sa eva pūjyaḥ syātsamyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 57 ..
16.105.d:
स वै पूज्यो नमस्कार्यो वंदनीयो मनीषिभिः ..
आदौ स एव पूज्यः स्यात्सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 57 ..
16.105.m: He indeed is to be worshipped, saluted, and praised by the wise; / he alone should be worshipped first by those desiring the complete fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.105.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa māṃ pūjayate bhuvam ..
yastaṃ dveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭi yosya pūjyo mamaiva saḥ .. 58 ..
16.105.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या स मां पूजयते भुवम् ..
यस्तं द्वेष्टि स मां द्वेष्टि योस्य पूज्यो ममैव सः .. 58 ..
16.105.m: Whoever worships him with devotion, surely worships me; / whoever hates him, hates me; whoever is honoured by him, is honoured by me.

16.105.s:
brahmaṇā pūjyamānena ahaṃ viṣṇuśca pūjitaḥ ..
viṣṇunā pūjyamānena ahaṃ brahmā ca pūjitaḥ .. 59 ..
16.105.d:
ब्रह्मणा पूज्यमानेन अहं विष्णुश्च पूजितः ..
विष्णुना पूज्यमानेन अहं ब्रह्मा च पूजितः .. 59 ..
16.105.m: When Brahmā is worshipped, Viṣṇu and I are worshipped; / when Viṣṇu is worshipped, Brahmā and I are worshipped.

16.105.s:
mayā pūjita mātreṇa brahmaviṣṇū ca pūjitau ..
sattvaṃ brahmā rajo viṣṇustamo'haṃ saṃprakīrtitaḥ .. 7.1.105.60 ..
16.105.d:
मया पूजित मात्रेण ब्रह्मविष्णू च पूजितौ ..
सत्त्वं ब्रह्मा रजो विष्णुस्तमोऽहं संप्रकीर्तितः .. 7.1.105.60 ..
16.105.m: By merely worshipping me, both Brahmā and Viṣṇu are worshipped. / Brahmā is proclaimed as sattva, Viṣṇu as rajas, and I as tamas.

16.105.s:
vāyurbrahmā'nalo rudro viṣṇurāpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
rātrirviṣṇuraho rudro yā saṃdhyā sa pitāmahaḥ ..61..
16.105.d:
वायुर्ब्रह्माऽनलो रुद्रो विष्णुरापः प्रकीर्तितः ..
रात्रिर्विष्णुरहो रुद्रो या संध्या स पितामहः ..61..
16.105.m: Brahmā is proclaimed as wind, Rudra as fire, and Viṣṇu as the waters; / Viṣṇu is night, Rudra is day, and the twilight is the Grandfather.

16.105.s:
sāmavedo hyahaṃ devi brahmā ṛgveda ucyate ..
yajurvedo bhavedviṣṇuḥ kulādhāro hyatharvaṇaḥ .. 62..
16.105.d:
सामवेदो ह्यहं देवि ब्रह्मा ऋग्वेद उच्यते ..
यजुर्वेदो भवेद्विष्णुः कुलाधारो ह्यथर्वणः .. 62..
16.105.m: For I am the Sāmaveda, O goddess, Brahmā is called the Ṛgveda, / Viṣṇu is the Yajurveda, and the Atharvaveda is the support of the family.

16.105.s:
uṣṇakālo hyahaṃ devi varṣākālaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
śītakālo bhavedviṣṇurevaṃ kālatrayaṃ hi saḥ .. 63 ..
16.105.d:
उष्णकालो ह्यहं देवि वर्षाकालः पितामहः ..
शीतकालो भवेद्विष्णुरेवं कालत्रयं हि सः .. 63 ..
16.105.m: I am the hot season, O goddess, the Grandfather is the rainy season, / and Viṣṇu is the cold season; thus he is the triad of seasons.

16.105.s:
dakṣiṇāgnirahaṃ jñeyo gārhapatyo hariḥ smṛtaḥ ..
brahmā cāhavanīyastu evaṃ sarvaṃ tridaivatam .. 64 ..
16.105.d:
दक्षिणाग्निरहं ज्ञेयो गार्हपत्यो हरिः स्मृतः ..
ब्रह्मा चाहवनीयस्तु एवं सर्वं त्रिदैवतम् .. 64 ..
16.105.m: I am to be known as the Dakṣiṇāgni, Hari is remembered as the Gārhapatya, / and Brahmā as the Āhavanīya; thus all is threefold in divinity.

16.105.s:
ahaṃ liṃgasvarūpastho bhago viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
bījasaṃstho bhavedbrahmā viṣṇurāpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..65..
16.105.d:
अहं लिंगस्वरूपस्थो भगो विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः ..
बीजसंस्थो भवेद्ब्रह्मा विष्णुरापः प्रकीर्तितः ..65..
16.105.m: I reside in the form of the liṅga; Viṣṇu is proclaimed as the womb; / Brahmā resides in the seed, and Viṣṇu is proclaimed as the waters.

16.105.s:
ahamākāśarūpastha evaṃ tattvamayaṃ prabhuḥ ..
ākāśātsravate yacca tadbījaṃ brahmasaṃsthitam ..
svarūpaṃ brāhmamāśritya brahmā bījaprarohakaḥ..66..
16.105.d:
अहमाकाशरूपस्थ एवं तत्त्वमयं प्रभुः ..
आकाशात्स्रवते यच्च तद्बीजं ब्रह्मसंस्थितम् ..
स्वरूपं ब्राह्ममाश्रित्य ब्रह्मा बीजप्ररोहकः..66..
16.105.m: I reside in the form of space, the lord consisting of the principles thus; / and that seed which trickles from space is situated in Brahmā; / resting on his own form as Brahmā, Brahmā is the sprout of the seed.

16.105.s:
nābhimadhye sthito brahmā viṣṇuśca hṛdayāṃtare ..
vaktramadhye ahaṃ devi ādhāraḥ sarvadehinām ..67..
16.105.d:
नाभिमध्ये स्थितो ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च हृदयांतरे ..
वक्त्रमध्ये अहं देवि आधारः सर्वदेहिनाम् ..67..
16.105.m: Brahmā is situated in the navel, and Viṣṇu within the heart; / I am in the mouth, O goddess, the support of all embodied beings.

16.105.s:
yaścāhaṃ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo brahmā sa hutāśanaḥ ..
yā devī sa svayaṃ viṣṇuryo viṣṇuḥ sa ca candramāḥ .. 68 ..
16.105.d:
यश्चाहं स स्वयं ब्रह्मा यो ब्रह्मा स हुताशनः ..
या देवी स स्वयं विष्णुर्यो विष्णुः स च चन्द्रमाः .. 68 ..
16.105.m: He who is I, is himself Brahmā; he who is Brahmā, is the fire; / she who is the Goddess, is herself Viṣṇu; he who is Viṣṇu, is the moon.

16.105.s:
yaḥ kālaḥ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo rudraḥ sa ca bhāskaraḥ ..
evaṃ śaktiviśeṣeṇa paraṃ brahma sthitaṃ priye .. 69 ..
oṃkārastatparaṃ brahma gāyatrī prakṛtiḥ parā ..
ubhāvetau naro jñātvā na vicyavati mucyate ..7.1.105.7...
16.105.d:
यः कालः स स्वयं ब्रह्मा यो रुद्रः स च भास्करः ..
एवं शक्तिविशेषेण परं ब्रह्म स्थितं प्रिये .. 69 ..
ओंकारस्तत्परं ब्रह्म गायत्री प्रकृतिः परा ..
उभावेतौ नरो ज्ञात्वा न विच्यवति मुच्यते ..7.1.105.7...
16.105.m:
He who is Time, is himself Brahmā; he who is Rudra, is the sun; / thus, through distinctions of power, the supreme Brahman exists, O beloved!
The syllable Oṃ is that supreme Brahman; the Gāyatrī is the supreme primordial matter; / knowing these two, a man does not fall away; he is liberated.

16.105.s:
evaṃ yo veda deveśi advaitaṃ paramākṣaram ..
sa sarvaṃ veda naivānyo bhedakarttā narādhamaḥ .. 71 ..
16.105.d:
एवं यो वेद देवेशि अद्वैतं परमाक्षरम् ..
स सर्वं वेद नैवान्यो भेदकर्त्ता नराधमः .. 71 ..
16.105.m: Whoever thus knows the supreme imperishable non-duality, O ruler of the gods, / he knows everything, and no other; one who creates division is the lowest of men.

16.105.s:
ekarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma kāryabhāvātpṛthaksthitaḥ ..
yastaṃ dveṣṭi varārohe brahmadveṣṭā sa ucyate .. 72 ..
16.105.d:
एकरूपं परं ब्रह्म कार्यभावात्पृथक्स्थितः ..
यस्तं द्वेष्टि वरारोहे ब्रह्मद्वेष्टा स उच्यते .. 72 ..
16.105.m: The supreme Brahman of single form stands distinct because of the nature of its effects; / whoever hates it, O fair-hipped woman, is called a hater of Brahman.

16.105.s:
dakṣiṇāṃge sthito brahmā vāmāṃge mama keśavaḥ ..
yastayordveṣamādhatte sa dveṣṭā mama bhāmini .. 73 ..
16.105.d:
दक्षिणांगे स्थितो ब्रह्मा वामांगे मम केशवः ..
यस्तयोर्द्वेषमाधत्ते स द्वेष्टा मम भामिनि .. 73 ..
16.105.m: Brahmā is situated on my right side, Keśava on my left; / he who shows hatred toward those two, hates me, O passionate woman!

16.105.s:
evaṃ jñātvā varārohe hyabhinnenāntarātmanā ..
brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ rudramekarūpeṇa pūja yet .. 74 ..
16.105.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा वरारोहे ह्यभिन्नेनान्तरात्मना ..
ब्रह्माणं केशवं रुद्रमेकरूपेण पूज येत् .. 74 ..
16.105.m: Knowing thus with an undivided inner self, O fair-hipped woman, / one should worship Brahmā, Keśava, and Rudra as one single form.

16.105.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ brahma māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 105 .. .. ..
16.105.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मध्ययात्रायां ब्रह्म माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 105 .. .. ..
16.105.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Brahmā during the Intermediate Pilgrimage', in the First [Part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the Seventh Section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.106.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
evamadvaitabhāvena yadbrahma parikīrtitam ..
tasya pūjā vidhānaṃ me kathayasva yathārthataḥ .. 1 ..
16.106.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
एवमद्वैतभावेन यद्ब्रह्म परिकीर्तितम् ..
तस्य पूजा विधानं मे कथयस्व यथार्थतः .. 1 ..
16.106.m: The Goddess said: / Tell me correctly the procedure for the worship of that Brahman / which has thus been proclaimed in the sense of non-duality.

16.106.s:
kṣetre prābhāsike deva bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
sa kathaṃ pūjyate lokaiḥ parabrahmasvarūpavān .. 2 ..
16.106.d:
क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके देव बालरूपी पितामहः ..
स कथं पूज्यते लोकैः परब्रह्मस्वरूपवान् .. 2 ..
16.106.m: In the sacred field of Prabhāsa, O god, how is the Grandfather in child-form, / who possesses the nature of the supreme Brahman, worshipped by people?

16.106.s:
ke mantrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tadbāhmaṇāstatra kīdṛśāḥ ..
tatra sthitānāṃ viprāṇāṃ kathaṃ kṣetraphalaṃ bhavet .. 3 ..
16.106.d:
के मन्त्राः किं विधानं तद्बाह्मणास्तत्र कीदृशाः ..
तत्र स्थितानां विप्राणां कथं क्षेत्रफलं भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.106.m: What are the mantras? What is that procedure? Of what kind are the brahmins there? / How does the fruit of the sacred field accrue to the brahmins residing there?

16.106.s:
katiprakārāste viprāstatra kṣetranivāsinaḥ ..
kimācārā mahādeva kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃparāyaṇāḥ .. 4 ..
16.106.d:
कतिप्रकारास्ते विप्रास्तत्र क्षेत्रनिवासिनः ..
किमाचारा महादेव किंशीलाः किंपरायणाः .. 4 ..
16.106.m: Of how many kinds are those brahmins residing in the sacred field? / What are their practices, O Mahādeva, of what character are they, and to what are they devoted?

16.106.s: etadvistarato brūhi brāhmaṇānāṃ mahodayam .. 5 ..
16.106.d: एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि ब्राह्मणानां महोदयम् .. 5 ..
16.106.m: Declare in full this great exaltation of the brahmins!

16.106.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahādevi samyakpraśnaviśārade ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā māhātmyaṃ vipradaivatam .. 6 ..
16.106.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महादेवि सम्यक्प्रश्नविशारदे ..
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा माहात्म्यं विप्रदैवतम् .. 6 ..
16.106.m: Īśvara said: / Excellent, excellent, O great goddess, skilled in well-posed questions! / Becoming one-minded, listen to the glory of the brahmins as deities,

16.106.s:
yacchrutvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..
ye kecitsāgarāṃtāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kīrtitā dvijāḥ .. 7 ..
16.106.d:
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..
ये केचित्सागरांतायां पृथिव्यां कीर्तिता द्विजाः .. 7 ..
16.106.m: hearing which a mortal is freed from all sins, O goddess! / Whatever twice-born ones are spoken of upon the earth bounded by the oceans,

16.106.s: tadrūpaṃ mama deveśi pratyakṣaṃ dharaṇītale .. pratyakṣaṃ brāhmaṇā devāḥ parokṣaṃ divi devatāḥ .. 8 ..
16.106.d: तद्रूपं मम देवेशि प्रत्यक्षं धरणीतले .. प्रत्यक्षं ब्राह्मणा देवाः परोक्षं दिवि देवताः .. 8 ..
16.106.m: that form of mine is visible upon the surface of the earth, O ruler of the gods; / brahmins are visible deities, while the gods in heaven are invisible.

16.106.s:
brāhmaṇā matpriyā nityaṃ brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ ..
yastānarcayate bhaktyā sa māmarcayate sadā .. 9 ..
yastāṃstoṣayate bhaktyā sa ca māṃ paritoṣayet ..7.1.106.1...
16.106.d:
ब्राह्मणा मत्प्रिया नित्यं ब्राह्मणा मामकी तनुः ..
यस्तानर्चयते भक्त्या स मामर्चयते सदा .. 9 ..
यस्तांस्तोषयते भक्त्या स च मां परितोषयेत् ..7.1.106.1...
16.106.m:
Brahmins are ever dear to me; brahmins are my own body; / whoever worships them with devotion, always worships me.
Whoever pleases them with devotion, also pleases me.

16.106.s:
ye brāhmaṇāḥ so'hamasaṃśayaṃ priye teṣvarciteṣvarcito'haṃ bhaveyam ..
teṣveva tuṣṭeṣvahameva tuṣṭo vairaṃ ca tairyasya mamāpi vairam .. 11 ..
16.106.d:
ये ब्राह्मणाः सोऽहमसंशयं प्रिये तेष्वर्चितेष्वर्चितोऽहं भवेयम् ..
तेष्वेव तुष्टेष्वहमेव तुष्टो वैरं च तैर्यस्य ममापि वैरम् .. 11 ..
16.106.m: Those who are brahmins, that am I, without doubt, O beloved; when they are worshipped, I am worshipped. / When they are satisfied, I alone am satisfied; and whoever bears hostility toward them, bears hostility toward me.

16.106.s:
yaścandanaiḥ sāgarugandhamālyai rabhyarcayecchailamayīṃ mamārcām..
asau na māmarcayatercayanvai viprārcanādarcita eva cāham .. 12 ..
16.106.d:
यश्चन्दनैः सागरुगन्धमाल्यै रभ्यर्चयेच्छैलमयीं ममार्चाम्..
असौ न मामर्चयतेर्चयन्वै विप्रार्चनादर्चित एव चाहम् .. 12 ..
16.106.m: And he who might worship my stone image with sandalpastes, aloes, and fragrant garlands /—he does not worship me; indeed, by worshipping the brahmins, I am truly worshipped.

16.106.s:
yāvaṃtaḥ pṛthivīmadhye cīrṇavedavratā dvijāḥ ..
acīrṇavratavedā vā te'pi pūjyā dvijāḥ priye .. 13 ..
16.106.d:
यावंतः पृथिवीमध्ये चीर्णवेदव्रता द्विजाः ..
अचीर्णव्रतवेदा वा तेऽपि पूज्या द्विजाः प्रिये .. 13 ..
16.106.m: As many twice-born ones as there are on the earth who have performed the Vedic observances, / or even those who have not performed the observances or [studied] the Veda, they too are to be worshipped, O beloved!

16.106.s:
na brāhmaṇānparīkṣeta śrāddhe kṣetranivāsinaḥ ..
sumahānparivādo'sya brāhmaṇānāṃ parīkṣaṇe .. 14 ..
16.106.d:
न ब्राह्मणान्परीक्षेत श्राद्धे क्षेत्रनिवासिनः ..
सुमहान्परिवादोऽस्य ब्राह्मणानां परीक्षणे .. 14 ..
16.106.m: One should not examine the brahmins residing in the sacred field at a śrāddha; / very great censure attaches to this examining of brahmins.

16.106.s:
kāṇāḥ khañjāśca kṛṣṇāśca daridrā vyādhitāstathā ..
sarve śrāddhe niyoktavyā miśritā vedapāragaiḥ .. 15 ..
16.106.d:
काणाः खञ्जाश्च कृष्णाश्च दरिद्रा व्याधितास्तथा ..
सर्वे श्राद्धे नियोक्तव्या मिश्रिता वेदपारगैः .. 15 ..
16.106.m: One-eyed, lame, dark-skinned, poor, and afflicted with disease— / all of them are to be engaged at a śrāddha, mixed with those who have mastered the Vedas.

16.106.s:
brāhmaṇā jātitaḥ pūjyā vedābhyāsāttataḥ param ..
tatorthaṃ havyakavyeṣu na nindyā brāhmaṇāḥ kvacit .. 16 ..
16.106.d:
ब्राह्मणा जातितः पूज्या वेदाभ्यासात्ततः परम् ..
ततोर्थं हव्यकव्येषु न निन्द्या ब्राह्मणाः क्वचित् .. 16 ..
16.106.m: Brahmins are worthy of worship by birth, and even more so on account of Vedic study; / therefore, in offerings to gods and ancestors, brahmins should never be disparaged.

16.106.s:
kāṇānkuṇṭāṃśca kubjāśca daridrānvyādhitānapi..
nāvamanyeddvijānprājño mama rūpaṃ yataḥ smṛtam .. 17 ..
16.106.d:
काणान्कुण्टांश्च कुब्जाश्च दरिद्रान्व्याधितानपि..
नावमन्येद्द्विजान्प्राज्ञो मम रूपं यतः स्मृतम् .. 17 ..
16.106.m: A wise man should not despise twice-born [brahmins], even if one-eyed, crippled, hunchbacked, poor, or diseased, / since they are known to be my form.

16.106.s:
bahavo hi na jānaṃti narā jñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
yathāhaṃ dvijarūpeṇa carāmi pṛthivīmimām .. 18 ..
16.106.d:
बहवो हि न जानंति नरा ज्ञानबहिष्कृताः ..
यथाहं द्विजरूपेण चरामि पृथिवीमिमाम् .. 18 ..
16.106.m: For many men, excluded from knowledge, do not know / that I roam this earth in the form of a twice-born.

16.106.s:
madrūpānghnanti ye viprānvikarma kārayaṃti ca ..
apreṣaṇe preṣayaṃti dāsatvaṃ kārayanti ca .. 19 ..
16.106.d:
मद्रूपान्घ्नन्ति ये विप्रान्विकर्म कारयंति च ..
अप्रेषणे प्रेषयंति दासत्वं कारयन्ति च .. 19 ..
16.106.m: Those who strike brahmins who have my form, make them perform improper deeds, / send them on improper errands, or reduce them to slavery—

16.106.s:
mṛtāṃstānkarapatreṇa yamadūtā mahābalāḥ ..
nikṛṃtaṃti yathā kāṣṭhaṃ sūtramārgeṇa śilpinaḥ .. 7.1.106.20 ..
16.106.d:
मृतांस्तान्करपत्रेण यमदूता महाबलाः ..
निकृंतंति यथा काष्ठं सूत्रमार्गेण शिल्पिनः .. 7.1.106.20 ..
16.106.m: When they die, the mighty messengers of Yama cut them apart with a saw, / as carpenters saw wood along a marked line.

16.106.s:
ye caivāślakṣṇayā vācā tarjayanti narādhamāḥ ..
vadaṃti paruṣaṃ krodhātpādena nihanaṃti ca .. 21 ..
16.106.d:
ये चैवाश्लक्ष्णया वाचा तर्जयन्ति नराधमाः ..
वदंति परुषं क्रोधात्पादेन निहनंति च .. 21 ..
16.106.m: And the lowest of men who intimidate [them] with harsh speech, / speak cruelly out of anger, or strike them with a foot—

16.106.s:
mṛtāṃstānyamalokā hi nihatya dharaṇītale ..
krūrapādena cākramya krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ .. 22 ..
agnivarṇaiśca saṃdaṃśairjihvāmuddharate yamaḥ ..
ye nu viprānnirīkṣante pāpāḥ pāpena cakṣuṣā .. 22 ..
16.106.d:
मृतांस्तान्यमलोका हि निहत्य धरणीतले ..
क्रूरपादेन चाक्रम्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः .. 22 ..
अग्निवर्णैश्च संदंशैर्जिह्वामुद्धरते यमः ..
ये नु विप्रान्निरीक्षन्ते पापाः पापेन चक्षुषा .. 22 ..
16.106.m:
When they die, [the messengers of] the world of Yama strike them down upon the ground, / trample them with cruel feet, their eyes blood-red with fury,
And Yama tears out their tongue with fire-colored tongs. / Sinful men who gaze upon brahmins with an evil eye—

16.106.s:
abrahmaṇyāstu te bāhyā nityaṃ brahmadviṣo narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ ghorā mahākāyā vajratuṃḍā bhayānakāḥ ..
uddharaṃti muhūrtena cakṣuḥ kākā yamājñayā .. 24 ..
16.106.d:
अब्रह्मण्यास्तु ते बाह्या नित्यं ब्रह्मद्विषो नराः ..
तेषां घोरा महाकाया वज्रतुंडा भयानकाः ..
उद्धरंति मुहूर्तेन चक्षुः काका यमाज्ञया .. 24 ..
16.106.m: Such men are unbrahmanical, outcasts, ever hating brahmins. / At Yama's command, terrifying, gigantic crows with beaks like thunderbolts / pluck out their eyes in an instant.

16.106.s:
yastāḍayati vipraṃ vai kṣate kuryāddhi śoṇitam ..
asthibhaṃgaṃ ca vā kuryātprāṇairvāpi viyojayet ..25..
16.106.d:
यस्ताडयति विप्रं वै क्षते कुर्याद्धि शोणितम् ..
अस्थिभंगं च वा कुर्यात्प्राणैर्वापि वियोजयेत् ..25..
16.106.m: He who strikes a brahmin so that blood flows from a wound, / or breaks his bone, or deprives him of his life,

16.106.s:
brahmaghnaḥ sa tu vijñeyo na tasmai niṣkṛtiḥ smṛtā ..
pañcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyeṣu narakeṣvanupūrvaśaḥ .. 26 ..
16.106.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नः स तु विज्ञेयो न तस्मै निष्कृतिः स्मृता ..
पञ्चाशत्कोटिसंख्येषु नरकेष्वनुपूर्वशः .. 26 ..
16.106.m: Must be known as the slayer of a brahmin; no expiation is prescribed for him. / In the fifty-crore hells, in succession,

16.106.s:
sa bahūni sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi pacyate bhṛśam..
tasmādvipro varārohe namaskāryo nṛbhiḥ sadā.. 27 ..
16.106.d:
स बहूनि सहस्राणि वर्षाणि पच्यते भृशम्..
तस्माद्विप्रो वरारोहे नमस्कार्यो नृभिः सदा.. 27 ..
16.106.m: He is fiercely boiled for many thousands of years. / Therefore, O fair-hipped lady, a brahmin must ever be bowed down to by men.

16.106.s:
annapānapradānaistu pūjyā hi satataṃ dvijāḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ caiva dānānāṃ viprāḥ sarve'dhikāriṇaḥ .. 28 ..
16.106.d:
अन्नपानप्रदानैस्तु पूज्या हि सततं द्विजाः ..
सर्वेषां चैव दानानां विप्राः सर्वेऽधिकारिणः .. 28 ..
16.106.m: Twice-born [brahmins] are always to be worshipped with gifts of food and drink; / indeed, all brahmins are entitled to receive all gifts.

16.106.s:
nānyaḥ samartho deveśi gṛhṇanyātyadhamāṃ gatim ..
tapasā pāvito devi brāhmaṇo dhṛtakilviṣaḥ .. 29 ..
16.106.d:
नान्यः समर्थो देवेशि गृह्णन्यात्यधमां गतिम् ..
तपसा पावितो देवि ब्राह्मणो धृतकिल्विषः .. 29 ..
16.106.m: None other is worthy [to receive them], O ruler of gods; by accepting, [another] goes to a wretched destination. / O goddess, a brahmin purified by austerity, even if bearing sin,

16.106.s:
na sīdetpratigṛhṇānaḥ pṛthivīmanusāgarām..
nāsti kiṃcinmahādevi duṣkṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu .. 7.1.106.30 ..
16.106.d:
न सीदेत्प्रतिगृह्णानः पृथिवीमनुसागराम्..
नास्ति किंचिन्महादेवि दुष्कृतं ब्राह्मणस्य तु .. 7.1.106.30 ..
16.106.m: Does not sink down, [even] while accepting the whole earth bounded by oceans. / There is no evil act [that defiles] a brahmin, O great goddess.

16.106.s:
yastu sthitaḥ sadā'dhyātme nityaṃ sadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ..
brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ janmanā saha jāyate .. 31 ..
16.106.d:
यस्तु स्थितः सदाऽध्यात्मे नित्यं सद्भावभावितः ..
ब्राह्मणो हि महद्भूतं जन्मना सह जायते .. 31 ..
16.106.m: He who is ever established in the spiritual self, always imbued with true being— / indeed, a brahmin is born as a great being from his very birth.

16.106.s:
loke lokeśvarāścāpi sarve brāhmaṇapūjakāḥ ..
tatastānnāvamanyeta yadīcchejjīvitaṃ ciram .. 32 ..
16.106.d:
लोके लोकेश्वराश्चापि सर्वे ब्राह्मणपूजकाः ..
ततस्तान्नावमन्येत यदीच्छेज्जीवितं चिरम् .. 32 ..
16.106.m: In the world, even the lords of the world are all worshippers of brahmins. / Therefore, one should not despise them, if one wishes for a long life.

16.106.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kupitā hanyurbhasmīkuryuḥ svatejasā ..
lokānanyānsṛjeyuśca lokapālāṃstathā'parān .. 33 ..
16.106.d:
ब्राह्मणाः कुपिता हन्युर्भस्मीकुर्युः स्वतेजसा ..
लोकानन्यान्सृजेयुश्च लोकपालांस्तथाऽपरान् .. 33 ..
16.106.m: Enraged brahmins could slay and turn [all] to ashes by their own splendor; / they could create other worlds and other world-guardians.

16.106.s:
apeyaḥ sāgaro yaiśca kṛtaḥ kopānmahātmabhiḥ ..
yeṣāṃ kopāgniradyāpi daṃḍake nopaśāmyati ..34..
16.106.d:
अपेयः सागरो यैश्च कृतः कोपान्महात्मभिः ..
येषां कोपाग्निरद्यापि दंडके नोपशाम्यति ..34..
16.106.m: By these great souls, the ocean was made undrinkable out of wrath; / their fire of anger does not subside even today in the Daṇḍaka forest.

16.106.s:
ete svargasya netāro devadevāḥ sanātanāḥ..
ebhiścāpi kṛtaḥ paṃthā devayānaḥ sa ucyate .. 35 ..
16.106.d:
एते स्वर्गस्य नेतारो देवदेवाः सनातनाः..
एभिश्चापि कृतः पंथा देवयानः स उच्यते .. 35 ..
16.106.m: These are the guides to heaven, the eternal gods of gods; / and the path made by them is called the path of the gods.

16.106.s:
te pūjyāste namaskāryāsteṣu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
te vai lokānimānsarvānpārayaṃti parasparam..36..
16.106.d:
ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्यास्तेषु सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
ते वै लोकानिमान्सर्वान्पारयंति परस्परम्..36..
16.106.m: They are to be worshipped, they are to be saluted; in them everything is established. / They indeed bring across all these worlds mutually.

16.106.s:
gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ..
vidyāsnātā vratasnātā anapāśritya jīvinaḥ..37..
16.106.d:
गूढस्वाध्यायतपसो ब्राह्मणाः शंसितव्रताः ..
विद्यास्नाता व्रतस्नाता अनपाश्रित्य जीविनः..37..
16.106.m: Brahmins keep their Vedic study and austerity concealed; they are steadfast in their vows, / bathed in learning, bathed in vows, living without dependent attachment.

16.106.s:
āśīviṣā iva kruddhā upacaryā hi brāhmaṇāḥ..
tapasā dīpyamānāste daheyuḥ sāgarānapi..38..
16.106.d:
आशीविषा इव क्रुद्धा उपचर्या हि ब्राह्मणाः..
तपसा दीप्यमानास्ते दहेयुः सागरानपि..38..
16.106.m: Brahmins are to be approached with care, like angered venomous serpents; / blazing with austerity, they could burn up even the oceans.

16.106.s:
brāhmaṇeṣu ca tuṣṭuṣu tuṣyaṃte sarvadevatāḥ..
te gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ..39..
16.106.d:
ब्राह्मणेषु च तुष्टुषु तुष्यंते सर्वदेवताः..
ते गतिः सर्वभूतानामध्यात्मगतिचिन्तकाः..39..
16.106.m: When the brahmins are pleased, all the deities are pleased. / They are the refuge of all beings, contemplating the path of the spiritual self.

16.106.s:
ādimadhyāvasānānāṃ jñānānāṃ chinnasaṃśayāḥ..
parāparaviśeṣajñā netāraḥ paramāṃ gatim ..
avadhyā brāhmaṇāstasmātpāpeṣvapi ratāḥ sadā .. 7.1.106.40 ..
16.106.d:
आदिमध्यावसानानां ज्ञानानां छिन्नसंशयाः..
परापरविशेषज्ञा नेतारः परमां गतिम् ..
अवध्या ब्राह्मणास्तस्मात्पापेष्वपि रताः सदा .. 7.1.106.40 ..
16.106.m: Their doubts are severed regarding knowledge of the beginning, middle, and end; / knowing the difference between the higher and the lower, they lead to the supreme goal. / Therefore brahmins are never to be killed, even if devoted to sin.

16.106.s:
yaśca sarvamidaṃ hanyādbrāhmaṇaṃ cāpi tatsamam ..
so'gniḥ so'rko mahātejā viṣaṃ bhavati kopitaḥ .. 41 ..
16.106.d:
यश्च सर्वमिदं हन्याद्ब्राह्मणं चापि तत्समम् ..
सोऽग्निः सोऽर्को महातेजा विषं भवति कोपितः .. 41 ..
16.106.m: And he who would destroy all this [universe] is equal to one who kills a brahmin. / [A brahmin] is fire; he is the sun of great radiance; when angered, he becomes poison.

16.106.s:
bhūtānāmagrabhugvipro varṇaśreṣṭhaḥ pitā guruḥ ..
na skandate na vyathate na vinaśyati karhicit..42..
16.106.d:
भूतानामग्रभुग्विप्रो वर्णश्रेष्ठः पिता गुरुः ..
न स्कन्दते न व्यथते न विनश्यति कर्हिचित्..42..
16.106.m: The brahmin eats first of all beings; he is the highest caste, father, and teacher. / He does not fail, he does not tremble, he never perishes.

16.106.s:
variṣṭhamagnihotrāddhi brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam..
viprāṇāṃ vapurāśritya sarvāstiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ..43..
16.106.d:
वरिष्ठमग्निहोत्राद्धि ब्राह्मणस्य मुखे हुतम्..
विप्राणां वपुराश्रित्य सर्वास्तिष्ठंति देवताः..43..
16.106.m: What is offered into the mouth of a brahmin is superior even to an Agnihotra oblation. / Residing in the bodies of brahmins, all deities remain.

16.106.s: ataḥ pūjyāstu te viprā alābhe pratimādayaḥ .. 44 ..
16.106.d: अतः पूज्यास्तु ते विप्रा अलाभे प्रतिमादयः .. 44 ..
16.106.m: Therefore, those brahmins are to be worshipped; idols and the like are secondary in their absence.

16.106.s:
avidyo vā savidyo vā brāhmaṇo mama daivatam ..
praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdaivataṃ mahat .. 45 ..
16.106.d:
अविद्यो वा सविद्यो वा ब्राह्मणो मम दैवतम् ..
प्रणीतश्चाप्रणीतश्च यथाग्निर्दैवतं महत् .. 45 ..
16.106.m: Whether ignorant or learned, a brahmin is my deity, / just as fire, whether formally consecrated or unconsecrated, is a great deity.

16.106.s:
smaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati ..
havyakavyavyapeto'pi brāhmaṇo naiva duṣyati .. 46 ..
16.106.d:
स्मशानेष्वपि तेजस्वी पावको नैव दुष्यति ..
हव्यकव्यव्यपेतोऽपि ब्राह्मणो नैव दुष्यति .. 46 ..
16.106.m: Radiant fire is not defiled even in cremation grounds; / a brahmin, even when devoid of offerings to gods and ancestors, is never defiled.

16.106.s:
mahāpātakavarjyaṃ hi pūjyo vipro varānane ..
sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ sarvathā daivataṃ mahat ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rakṣedāpadgataṃ dvijam .. 47 ..
16.106.d:
महापातकवर्ज्यं हि पूज्यो विप्रो वरानने ..
सर्वथा ब्राह्मणाः पूज्याः सर्वथा दैवतं महत् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रक्षेदापद्गतं द्विजम् .. 47 ..
16.106.m: Except for major sins, a brahmin is to be worshipped, O fair-faced lady; / in every way brahmins are to be worshipped, in every way they are a great deity. / Therefore, with all effort, one should protect a twice-born [brahmin] fallen into distress.

16.106.s:
evaṃ viprā mahādevi pūjyāḥ sarvatra mānavaiḥ ..
kiṃ punaḥ saṃjitātmāno viśeṣātkṣetravāsinaḥ .. 48 ..
16.106.d:
एवं विप्रा महादेवि पूज्याः सर्वत्र मानवैः ..
किं पुनः संजितात्मानो विशेषात्क्षेत्रवासिनः .. 48 ..
16.106.m: Thus, O great goddess, brahmins are everywhere to be worshipped by men; / how much more so those of conquered self, especially residents of a sacred field?

16.106.s:
atha kṣetrasthitānāṃ ca caturāśramavāsinām ..
viprāṇāṃ vṛttito bhedaṃ pravakṣyāmyānupūrvyaśaḥ .. 49 ..
16.106.d:
अथ क्षेत्रस्थितानां च चतुराश्रमवासिनाम् ..
विप्राणां वृत्तितो भेदं प्रवक्ष्याम्यानुपूर्व्यशः .. 49 ..
16.106.m: Now I shall describe, in regular order, the division according to mode of life / of the brahmins dwelling in the sacred field and residing in the four stages of life.

16.106.s:
kṣetrasya saṃnyāsavidhiṃ ye jānaṃti dvijātayaḥ ..
vṛttibhedaṃ kramāccaiva te kṣetraphalabhāginaḥ .. 7.1.106.50 ..
16.106.d:
क्षेत्रस्य संन्यासविधिं ये जानंति द्विजातयः ..
वृत्तिभेदं क्रमाच्चैव ते क्षेत्रफलभागिनः .. 7.1.106.50 ..
16.106.m: Those twice-born who know the rule of renunciation in the sacred field, / and the division of modes of life in due order, share in the fruit of the sacred field.

16.106.s:
yathā kṣetre nivasatā vartitavyaṃ dvijātinā ..
prājāpatyādibhedena tacchṛṇu tvaṃ varānane .. 51 ..
16.106.d:
यथा क्षेत्रे निवसता वर्तितव्यं द्विजातिना ..
प्राजापत्यादिभेदेन तच्छृणु त्वं वरानने .. 51 ..
16.106.m: How a twice-born must conduct himself while dwelling in the sacred field, / through divisions such as the Prājāpatya and others, listen to that, O fair-faced lady.

16.106.s:
prājāpatyā mahīpālāḥ kapotā graṃthikāstathā ..
kuṭikāścātha vaitālāḥ padmahaṃsā varānane .. 52 ..
16.106.d:
प्राजापत्या महीपालाः कपोता ग्रंथिकास्तथा ..
कुटिकाश्चाथ वैतालाः पद्महंसा वरानने .. 52 ..
16.106.m: Prājāpatyas, Mahīpālas, Kapotas, and Granthikas, / Kuṭikas, and then Vaitālas, Padma-Haṃsas, O fair-faced lady,

16.106.s:
dhṛtarāṣṭrā bakāḥ kaṃkā gopālāścaiva bhāmini ..
truṭikā maṭharāścaiva guṭikā daṃḍikāḥ pare .. 53 ..
16.106.d:
धृतराष्ट्रा बकाः कंका गोपालाश्चैव भामिनि ..
त्रुटिका मठराश्चैव गुटिका दंडिकाः परे .. 53 ..
16.106.m: Dhṛtarāṣṭras, Bakas, Kaṅkas, and Gopālas, O passionate lady, / Truṭikas, Maṭharas, Guṭikas, and other Daṇḍikas—

16.106.s: kṣetrasthānāmime bhedā vṛttiṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇuṣva ca .. 54 ..
16.106.d: क्षेत्रस्थानामिमे भेदा वृत्तिं तेषां शृणुष्व च .. 54 ..
16.106.m: These are the divisions of those established in the sacred field; hear their mode of life.

16.106.s:
ahiṃsā guruśuśrūṣā svādhyāyaḥ śaucasaṃyamaḥ ..
satyamasteyametaddhi prājāpatyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam .. 55 ..
16.106.d:
अहिंसा गुरुशुश्रूषा स्वाध्यायः शौचसंयमः ..
सत्यमस्तेयमेतद्धि प्राजापत्यं व्रतं स्मृतम् .. 55 ..
16.106.m: Non-violence, service to the teacher, study of the Veda, purity, self-restraint, / truth, and non-stealing—this is remembered as the Prājāpatya vow.

16.106.s:
kṣayapuṣṭyarthavidveṣakarmabhiḥ śāṃtikādibhiḥ ..
pālayaṃti mahīṃ yasmānmahīpālāstataḥ smṛtāḥ .. 56 ..
16.106.d:
क्षयपुष्ट्यर्थविद्वेषकर्मभिः शांतिकादिभिः ..
पालयंति महीं यस्मान्महीपालास्ततः स्मृताः .. 56 ..
16.106.m: Because they protect the earth through pacification rites and other rituals / for destruction, prosperity, and enmity, they are therefore known as Mahīpālas.

16.106.s:
patitā ye kaṇā bhūmau saṃharaṃti kapotavat ..
uddhṛtyājīvanaṃ yeṣāṃ kapotāste tu sādhakāḥ .. 57 ..
16.106.d:
पतिता ये कणा भूमौ संहरंति कपोतवत् ..
उद्धृत्याजीवनं येषां कपोतास्ते तु साधकाः .. 57 ..
16.106.m: Those practitioners who gather fallen grains on the ground like pigeons, / and whose livelihood is obtained thereby, are Kapotas.

16.106.s:
gṛhaṃ kṛtvā tu sadgraṃthāḥ sahasaiva tyajaṃti ye ..
kuṭikā sādhakāste vai śivārādhanatatparāḥ .. 58 ..
16.106.d:
गृहं कृत्वा तु सद्ग्रंथाः सहसैव त्यजंति ये ..
कुटिका साधकास्ते वै शिवाराधनतत्पराः .. 58 ..
16.106.m: Those who, having made a house, suddenly abandon good attachments, / are Kuṭika practitioners, devoted to the worship of Śiva.

16.106.s:
tīrthāsaktāḥ sapatnīkā yathālabdhopajīvinaḥ ..
mahāsāhasayuktāste vaitālākhyāstu sādhakāḥ .. 59 ..
16.106.d:
तीर्थासक्ताः सपत्नीका यथालब्धोपजीविनः ..
महासाहसयुक्तास्ते वैतालाख्यास्तु साधकाः .. 59 ..
16.106.m: Attached to sacred fords, with their wives, living on whatever is obtained, / endowed with great daring, they are the practitioners known as Vaitālas.

16.106.s:
saṃyatāḥ kāmanāsaktā rājyakāmārthasādhakāḥ ..
padmāste sādhakāḥ khyātā bhikṣācaryāratāḥ sadā .. 7.1.106.60 ..
16.106.d:
संयताः कामनासक्ता राज्यकामार्थसाधकाः ..
पद्मास्ते साधकाः ख्याता भिक्षाचर्यारताः सदा .. 7.1.106.60 ..
16.106.m: Restrained, yet attached to desire, accomplishing goals of kingdom and wealth, / constantly devoted to wandering for alms, they are known as Padma practitioners.

16.106.s:
jñānayogasamāyuktā dvaitācāraratāśca ye ..
haṃsāste sādhakāḥ khyātāḥ svayamutpannasaṃvidaḥ .. 61 ..
16.106.d:
ज्ञानयोगसमायुक्ता द्वैताचाररताश्च ये ..
हंसास्ते साधकाः ख्याताः स्वयमुत्पन्नसंविदः .. 61 ..
16.106.m: Those endowed with the yoga of knowledge and devoted to conduct in the realm of duality, / whose understanding has arisen spontaneously, are known as the Haṃsa practitioners.

16.106.s:
brahmacaryeṇa sattvena tathā'lubdhatayāpi vā ..
jitaṃ jagaddhārayanto dhṛtarāṣṭrā matāstu ye .. 62 ..
16.106.d:
ब्रह्मचर्येण सत्त्वेन तथाऽलुब्धतयापि वा ..
जितं जगद्धारयन्तो धृतराष्ट्रा मतास्तु ये .. 62 ..
16.106.m: Those who, through celibacy, purity of mind, or lack of greed, / sustain the world that has been conquered, are considered Dhṛtarāṣṭras.

16.106.s:
gūḍhāścaraṃti ye jñānaṃ vrataṃ dharmamathāpi vā ..
svārthaikāgataniṣṭhāstu bakāste sādhakā matāḥ.. .. 63 ..
16.106.d:
गूढाश्चरंति ये ज्ञानं व्रतं धर्ममथापि वा ..
स्वार्थैकागतनिष्ठास्तु बकास्ते साधका मताः.. .. 63 ..
16.106.m: Those who secretly pursue knowledge, a vow, or religious duty, / but are solely devoted to their own purpose, are considered Baka practitioners.

16.106.s:
jalāśrayaṃ samāśritya sthitā utkṛṣṭasiddhaye ..
bisaśṛṃgāṭakāhārāste kaṃkāḥ sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 64 ..
16.106.d:
जलाश्रयं समाश्रित्य स्थिता उत्कृष्टसिद्धये ..
बिसशृंगाटकाहारास्ते कंकाः साधकाः स्मृताः .. 64 ..
16.106.m: Those who, resorting to water reservoirs, dwell there for supreme spiritual perfection, / subsisting on lotus stalks and water chestnuts, are remembered as the Kaṅka practitioners.

16.106.s:
gobhiḥ sārddhaṃ vrajaṃtyatra goṣṭhe ca nivasaṃti ye ..
paṃcagavyarasā ye vai gopālāste tu sādhakāḥ .. 65 ..
16.106.d:
गोभिः सार्द्धं व्रजंत्यत्र गोष्ठे च निवसंति ये ..
पंचगव्यरसा ये वै गोपालास्ते तु साधकाः .. 65 ..
16.106.m: Those who wander here along with cows and reside in a cowpen, / consuming the essence of the five products of the cow, are the Gopāla practitioners.

16.106.s:
kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇaiścaiva kṣapayaṃti svakaṃ vapuḥ ..
truṭimātrāśanāste tu truṭikāḥ sādhakā matāḥ .. 66 ..
16.106.d:
कृच्छ्रचांद्रायणैश्चैव क्षपयंति स्वकं वपुः ..
त्रुटिमात्राशनास्ते तु त्रुटिकाः साधका मताः .. 66 ..
16.106.m: Those who emaciate their own bodies through Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa penances, / eating only a tiny fraction of food, are considered Truṭika practitioners.

16.106.s:
kṛtvā kuśamayīṃ patnīṃ maṭhe ye gṛhamedhinaḥ ..
bhaikṣavṛttiratāḥ śuddhā maṭharāste tu sādhakāḥ .. 67 ..
16.106.d:
कृत्वा कुशमयीं पत्नीं मठे ये गृहमेधिनः ..
भैक्षवृत्तिरताः शुद्धा मठरास्ते तु साधकाः .. 67 ..
16.106.m: Those householders who make an effigy of a wife from kuśa grass and live in a hermitage, / pure and devoted to the practice of alms-begging, are the Maṭhara practitioners.

16.106.s:
grāsamātrasamānābhirguṭikābhirathāṣṭabhiḥ ..
kandamūlaphalotthābhirguṭikāste dvijātayaḥ .. 68 ..
16.106.d:
ग्रासमात्रसमानाभिर्गुटिकाभिरथाष्टभिः ..
कन्दमूलफलोत्थाभिर्गुटिकास्ते द्विजातयः .. 68 ..
16.106.m: Those twice-born who subsist on eight pills equal in size to a mouthful, / made from bulbs, roots, and fruits, are the Guṭikas.

16.106.s:
svadehadaṇḍanairyuktā rātrau vīrāsane sthitāḥ ..
daṃḍinaste samākhyātāḥ sarvametattavoditam .. 69 ..
16.106.d:
स्वदेहदण्डनैर्युक्ता रात्रौ वीरासने स्थिताः ..
दंडिनस्ते समाख्याताः सर्वमेतत्तवोदितम् .. 69 ..
16.106.m: Those who engage in mortifications of their own body and sit in the vīrāsana posture at night / are declared to be Daṇḍins. All this has been described to you.

16.106.s:
sāmānyo'pi viśeṣaśca vṛttino gṛhiṇo'pi vā ..
teṣāṃ bhedo mayā khyātāḥ samyakkṣetranivāsinām .. 7.1.106.70 ..
16.106.d:
सामान्योऽपि विशेषश्च वृत्तिनो गृहिणोऽपि वा ..
तेषां भेदो मया ख्याताः सम्यक्क्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् .. 7.1.106.70 ..
16.106.m: Whether ordinary or special, of those who maintain their livelihoods or of householders, / these divisions of the dwellers in the sacred field have been fully declared by me.

16.106.s:
evamādidharmayuktāḥ prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ ..
taiḥ pūjyo bhagavāndevo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ .. 71 ..
16.106.d:
एवमादिधर्मयुक्ताः प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनः ..
तैः पूज्यो भगवान्देवो बालरूपी पितामहः .. 71 ..
16.106.m: Endowed with such virtues, the dwellers in the sacred field of Prabhāsa / must worship the divine Lord, the Grandfather [Brahmā] in the form of a child.

16.106.s:
mahāpātakino ye tu ye tu viprairbahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
na ca te saṃspṛśeyurvai brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam ... 72 ..
16.106.d:
महापातकिनो ये तु ये तु विप्रैर्बहिष्कृताः ..
न च ते संस्पृशेयुर्वै ब्रह्माणं बालरूपिणम् ... 72 ..
16.106.m: Those who are perpetrators of great sins and those who have been expelled by brahmins / should not touch Brahmā in the form of a child.

16.106.s:
brahmacārī sadā dāṃto jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ ..
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ khyātāḥ kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ .. 73 ..
16.106.d:
ब्रह्मचारी सदा दांतो जितक्रोधो जितेंद्रियः ..
एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः ख्याताः क्षेत्रमध्यनिवासिनः .. 73 ..
16.106.m: Always celibate, self-controlled, with anger conquered and the senses mastered— / such are the brahmins declared to reside within the sacred field.

16.106.s:
taiḥ pūjyo bhagavāndevo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ ..
ye vedādhyayane yuktāstaiḥ prapūjyaḥ pitāmahaḥ .. .. 74 ..
16.106.d:
तैः पूज्यो भगवान्देवो बालरूपी पितामहः ..
ये वेदाध्ययने युक्तास्तैः प्रपूज्यः पितामहः .. .. 74 ..
16.106.m: By them the divine Lord, the Grandfather in the form of a child, is to be worshipped; / by those engaged in the study of the Vedas, the Grandfather must be venerated.

16.106.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ brāhmaṇapraśaṃsā varṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 106 ..
16.106.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मध्ययात्रायां ब्राह्मणप्रशंसा वर्णनंनाम षडुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 106 ..
16.106.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixth chapter, entitled 'Praise of the Brahmins in the Intermediate Pilgrimage', in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.107.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi samāsataḥ ..
bhaktibhedānpṛthaktasya brahmaṇo bālarūpiṇaḥ .. 1 ..
16.107.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ पूजाविधानं ते कथयामि समासतः ..
भक्तिभेदान्पृथक्तस्य ब्रह्मणो बालरूपिणः .. 1 ..
16.107.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall briefly declare to you the ritual of worship / and the varieties of devotion to that Brahmā in the form of a child,

16.107.s:
rathayātrāvidhānaṃ tu stotramaṃtravidhikramam ..
vividhā bhaktiruddiṣṭā manovākkāyasaṃbhavā .. .. 2 ..
16.107.d:
रथयात्राविधानं तु स्तोत्रमंत्रविधिक्रमम् ..
विविधा भक्तिरुद्दिष्टा मनोवाक्कायसंभवा .. .. 2 ..
16.107.m: as well as the procedure for the chariot festival and the order of hymns and mantras. / Various kinds of devotion arising from mind, speech, and body have been taught:

16.107.s:
laukikī vaidikī cāpi bhavedādhyātmikī tathā ..
dhyānadhāraṇayā yā tu vedānāṃ smaraṇena ca ..
brahmaprītikarī caiṣā mānasī bhaktirucyate .. 3 ..
16.107.d:
लौकिकी वैदिकी चापि भवेदाध्यात्मिकी तथा ..
ध्यानधारणया या तु वेदानां स्मरणेन च ..
ब्रह्मप्रीतिकरी चैषा मानसी भक्तिरुच्यते .. 3 ..
16.107.m: it may be secular, Vedic, and likewise spiritual. / That which is performed through meditation, concentration, and the remembrance of the Vedas, / bringing pleasure to Brahmā, is called mental devotion.

16.107.s:
maṃtravedanamaskārairagniśrāddhavidhānakaiḥ ..
jāpyaiścāraṇyakaiścaiva vācikī bhaktirucyate .. 4 ..
16.107.d:
मंत्रवेदनमस्कारैरग्निश्राद्धविधानकैः ..
जाप्यैश्चारण्यकैश्चैव वाचिकी भक्तिरुच्यते .. 4 ..
16.107.m: Performed through mantras, Vedic recitations, prostrations, procedures of the fire-rite and ancestral offerings, / and through silent mutterings and Āraṇyaka texts, it is called vocal devotion.

16.107.s:
vratopavāsaniyamaiściteṃdriyanirodhibhiḥ ..
kṛcchra sāṃtapanaiścānyaistathā cāṃdrāyaṇādibhiḥ .. 5 ..
16.107.d:
व्रतोपवासनियमैश्चितेंद्रियनिरोधिभिः ..
कृच्छ्र सांतपनैश्चान्यैस्तथा चांद्रायणादिभिः .. 5 ..
16.107.m: Through vows, fasts, and observances that restrain the mind and senses, / through Kṛcchra, Sāṃtapana, and other austerities such as Cāndrāyaṇa,

16.107.s:
brahmoktaiścopavāsaiśca tathānyaiśca śubhavrataiḥ ..
kāyikī bhaktirākhyātā trividhā tu dvijanmanām .. 6 ..
16.107.d:
ब्रह्मोक्तैश्चोपवासैश्च तथान्यैश्च शुभव्रतैः ..
कायिकी भक्तिराख्याता त्रिविधा तु द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6 ..
16.107.m: through fasts taught by Brahmā and other auspicious vows— / such threefold physical devotion has been declared for the twice-born.

16.107.s:
goghṛtakṣīradadhibhirmadhvikṣusukuśodakaiḥ ..
gaṃdhamālyaiśca vividhairvastubhiścopapādibhiḥ .. 7 ..
16.107.d:
गोघृतक्षीरदधिभिर्मध्विक्षुसुकुशोदकैः ..
गंधमाल्यैश्च विविधैर्वस्तुभिश्चोपपादिभिः .. 7 ..
16.107.m: With cow's ghee, milk, curds, honey, sugarcane juice, and kuśa grass water, / with fragrant pastes, garlands, and various suitable articles,

16.107.s:
ghṛtagugguladhūpaiśca kṛṣṇāgurusugaṃdhibhiḥ ..
bhūṣaṇai haimaratnādyaiścitrābhiḥ sragbhireva ca .. 8 ..
16.107.d:
घृतगुग्गुलधूपैश्च कृष्णागुरुसुगंधिभिः ..
भूषणै हैमरत्नाद्यैश्चित्राभिः स्रग्भिरेव च .. 8 ..
16.107.m: with incenses of ghee and guggulu and fragrant black aloe-wood, / with ornaments of gold, gems, and the like, and with colorful garlands,

16.107.s:
nyāsaiḥ parisaraiḥ stotraiḥ patākābhistathotsavaiḥ ..
nṛtyavāditragītaiśca sarvavastūpahārakaiḥ .. 9 ..
16.107.d:
न्यासैः परिसरैः स्तोत्रैः पताकाभिस्तथोत्सवैः ..
नृत्यवादित्रगीतैश्च सर्ववस्तूपहारकैः .. 9 ..
16.107.m: with ritual placements, circumambulations, hymns of praise, banners, and festivals, / with dances, instrumental music, songs, and offerings of all kinds of things,

16.107.s:
bhakṣyabhojyānna pānaiśca yā pūjā kriyate naraiḥ ..
pitāmahaṃ samuddiśya sā bhaktirlaukikī matā .. 7.1.107.10 ..
16.107.d:
भक्ष्यभोज्यान्न पानैश्च या पूजा क्रियते नरैः ..
पितामहं समुद्दिश्य सा भक्तिर्लौकिकी मता .. 7.1.107.10 ..
16.107.m: and with food to chew, eat, and drink, the worship that is performed by men / directed toward the Grandfather is considered secular devotion.

16.107.s: vedamaṃtrahavirbhāgaiḥ kriyā yā vaidikī smṛtā .. 11 ..
16.107.d: वेदमंत्रहविर्भागैः क्रिया या वैदिकी स्मृता .. 11 ..
16.107.m: The rite performed with Vedic mantras and portions of oblations is remembered as Vedic.

16.107.s:
darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ cāgnihotrajam ..
prāśanaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ puroḍāśa iti kriyā .. 12 ..
16.107.d:
दर्शे च पौर्णमास्यां च कर्त्तव्यं चाग्निहोत्रजम् ..
प्राशनं दक्षिणादानं पुरोडाश इति क्रिया .. 12 ..
16.107.m: On the new moon and full moon days, the rite born of the Agnihotra is to be performed: / the tasting, the giving of the priestly gift, and the puroḍāśa offering;

16.107.s:
iṣṭirdhṛtiḥ somapānaṃ yājñiyaṃ karma sarvaśaḥ ..
ṛgyajuḥ sāmajāpyāni saṃhitādhyayanāni ca ..
kriyate brahmāṇamuddiśya sā bhaktirvedikocyate .. 13 ..
16.107.d:
इष्टिर्धृतिः सोमपानं याज्ञियं कर्म सर्वशः ..
ऋग्यजुः सामजाप्यानि संहिताध्ययनानि च ..
क्रियते ब्रह्माणमुद्दिश्य सा भक्तिर्वेदिकोच्यते .. 13 ..
16.107.m: the Iṣṭi sacrifice, the Dhṛti libation, the drinking of Soma, every kind of sacrificial act, / the silent recitation of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, and the recitation of the Saṃhitās— / [when] performed directed toward Brahmā, that is called Vedic devotion.

16.107.s:
prāṇāyāmaparo nityaṃ dhyānavānvijiteṃdriyaḥ ..
bhaikṣyabhakṣī vratī cāpi sarvapratyāhṛteṃdriyaḥ .. 14 ..
16.107.d:
प्राणायामपरो नित्यं ध्यानवान्विजितेंद्रियः ..
भैक्ष्यभक्षी व्रती चापि सर्वप्रत्याहृतेंद्रियः .. 14 ..
16.107.m: Constantly devoted to breath-control, meditative, with the senses conquered, / eating food received as alms, observant of vows, with all senses withdrawn,

16.107.s:
dhāraṇaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā dhyāyamānaḥ prajeśvaram ..
hṛtpadmakarṇikāsīnaṃ raktavarṇaṃ sulocanam ..15..
16.107.d:
धारणं हृदये कृत्वा ध्यायमानः प्रजेश्वरम् ..
हृत्पद्मकर्णिकासीनं रक्तवर्णं सुलोचनम् ..15..
16.107.m: holding concentration in his heart and meditating on the Lord of creatures / seated on the pericarp of the heart-lotus, red in color, with beautiful eyes,

16.107.s:
paśyannuddyotitamukhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sukaṭītaṭam..
raktavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ varadābhayahastakam..
evaṃ yaściṃtayeddevaṃ brahmabhaktaḥ sa ucyate .. 16 ..
16.107.d:
पश्यन्नुद्द्योतितमुखं ब्रह्माणं सुकटीतटम्..
रक्तवर्णं चतुर्बाहुं वरदाभयहस्तकम्..
एवं यश्चिंतयेद्देवं ब्रह्मभक्तः स उच्यते .. 16 ..
16.107.m: beholding Brahmā with a radiant face, handsome waist, / red complexion, four arms, and hands granting boons and fearlessness— / whoever contemplates the god thus is called a devotee of Brahmā.

16.107.s: vidhiṃ ca śṛṇu me devi yaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣetravāsinām .. 17 ..
16.107.d: विधिं च शृणु मे देवि यः स्मृतः क्षेत्रवासिनाम् .. 17 ..
16.107.m: Hear also from me, O goddess, the ritual rule that is prescribed for dwellers in the sacred field:

16.107.s:
nirmamā nirahaṃkārā niḥsaṃgā niṣparigrahāḥ..
caturvargepi niḥsnehāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ ..18..
16.107.d:
निर्ममा निरहंकारा निःसंगा निष्परिग्रहाः..
चतुर्वर्गेपि निःस्नेहाः समलोष्टाश्मकांचनाः ..18..
16.107.m: Free from the sense of 'mine', free from egoism, unattached, without possessions, / detached even toward the four aims of life, regarding a clod of earth, a stone, and gold as equal,

16.107.s:
bhūtānāṃ karmabhirnityaṃ trividhairabhayapradāḥ ..
prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṃ paradhyānaparāyaṇāḥ .. 19 ..
16.107.d:
भूतानां कर्मभिर्नित्यं त्रिविधैरभयप्रदाः ..
प्राणायामपरा नित्यं परध्यानपरायणाः .. 19 ..
16.107.m: always granting freedom from fear to all beings through their threefold actions, / constantly devoted to breath-control, intent on supreme meditation,

16.107.s:
jāpinaḥ śucayo nityaṃ yatidharmakriyāparāḥ ..
sāṃkhyayogavidhijñā ye dharmavicchinnasaṃśayāḥ .. 7.1.107.20 ..
16.107.d:
जापिनः शुचयो नित्यं यतिधर्मक्रियापराः ..
सांख्ययोगविधिज्ञा ये धर्मविच्छिन्नसंशयाः .. 7.1.107.20 ..
16.107.m: regularly muttering prayers, pure, intent on the duties and practices of an ascetic, / knowing the rules of Sāṃkhya and Yoga, their doubts dispelled by righteousness,

16.107.s:
brahmapūjāratā nityaṃ te viprāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ ..
tairyathā pūjanīyo vai bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ .. 21 ..
16.107.d:
ब्रह्मपूजारता नित्यं ते विप्राः क्षेत्रवासिनः ..
तैर्यथा पूजनीयो वै बालरूपी पितामहः .. 21 ..
16.107.m: constantly engaged in the worship of Brahmā—such are the brahmins residing in the sacred field. / How the Grandfather in the form of a child is to be worshipped by them,

16.107.s:
tathāhaṃ kīrttayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye ..
snātvā tu vimale tīrthe śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ..
pūjopahārasaṃyuktastato brahmāṇamarcayet .. 22 ..
16.107.d:
तथाहं कीर्त्तयिष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः प्रिये ..
स्नात्वा तु विमले तीर्थे शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः..
पूजोपहारसंयुक्तस्ततो ब्रह्माणमर्चयेत् .. 22 ..
16.107.m: that I shall declare; listen with a single mind, O beloved! / Having bathed in a pure sacred ford, clad in white garments, pure, / provided with offerings for worship, one should then venerate Brahmā.

16.107.s:
pūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā paṃcāmṛtarasodakaiḥ ..
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam .. 23 ..
16.107.d:
पूर्वं संस्नाप्य विधिना पंचामृतरसोदकैः ..
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् .. 23 ..
16.107.m: First bathing [the deity] according to the rule with the five nectars and water: / cow's urine, cow dung, milk, curds, clarified butter, and kuśa grass water.

16.107.s:
gāyatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gaṃdhadvāreti gomayam ..
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi .. 24 ..
16.107.d:
गायत्र्या गृह्य गोमूत्रं गंधद्वारेति गोमयम् ..
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि .. 24 ..
16.107.m: Taking the cow's urine with the Gāyatrī mantra, cow dung with 'Gandhadvārā...', / milk with 'Āpyāyasva...', and curds with 'Dadhikrāvṇo...',

16.107.s:
tejo'si śukramityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam ..
āpohiṣṭheti maṃtreṇa paṃcagavyena snāpayet .. 25 ..
16.107.d:
तेजोऽसि शुक्रमित्याज्यं देवस्य त्वा कुशोदकम् ..
आपोहिष्ठेति मंत्रेण पंचगव्येन स्नापयेत् .. 25 ..
16.107.m: ghee with 'Tejo'si śukram...', and kuśa grass water with 'Devasya tvā...', / one should bathe him with the five products of the cow using the mantra 'Āpo hi ṣṭhā...'.

16.107.s:
kapilāpaṃcagavyena kuśavāriyutena ca ..
snāpayenmaṃtrapūtena brahmasnānaṃ hi tatsmṛtam .. 26 ..
16.107.d:
कपिलापंचगव्येन कुशवारियुतेन च ..
स्नापयेन्मंत्रपूतेन ब्रह्मस्नानं हि तत्स्मृतम् .. 26 ..
16.107.m: With the five products of a tawny cow mixed with kuśa grass water, / purified with mantras, one should bathe him; that is indeed remembered as the Brahma-snāna.

16.107.s:
varṣakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam ..
surajyeṣṭhaṃ tu saṃsnāpya dahetsarvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 27 ..
16.107.d:
वर्षकोटिसहस्रैस्तु यत्पापं समुपार्जितम् ..
सुरज्येष्ठं तु संस्नाप्य दहेत्सर्वं न संशयः .. 27 ..
16.107.m: Whatever sin has been accumulated over thousands of crores of years, / by bathing the Eldest of the gods, one burns it all away, without a doubt.

16.107.s:
evaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam ..
karpūrāgarutoyena tataḥ saṃsnāpayeddvijaḥ .. 28 ..
16.107.d:
एवं संस्नाप्य विधिना ब्रह्माणं बालरूपिणम् ..
कर्पूरागरुतोयेन ततः संस्नापयेद्द्विजः .. 28 ..
16.107.m: Having thus bathed according to the injunctions Brahmā in the form of a child, / the twice-born should then bathe [him] with water of camphor and agallochum.

16.107.s:
evaṃ kṛtvārccayeddevaṃ gāyatrīnyāsayogataḥ ..
mūrdhnaḥ pādatalaṃ yāvatpraṇavaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ .. 29 ..
16.107.d:
एवं कृत्वार्च्चयेद्देवं गायत्रीन्यासयोगतः ..
मूर्ध्नः पादतलं यावत्प्रणवं विन्यसेद्बुधः .. 29 ..
16.107.m: Having done so, the wise man should worship the god by means of the ritual imposition (nyāsa) of the Gāyatrī; / he should place the praṇava from the head to the soles of the feet.

16.107.s:
takāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni sakāraṃ mukhamaṇḍale ..
vikāraṃ kaṃṭhadeśe tu tukāraṃ cāṃgasaṃdhiṣu .. 7.1.107.30 ..
16.107.d:
तकारं विन्यसेन्मूर्ध्नि सकारं मुखमण्डले ..
विकारं कंठदेशे तु तुकारं चांगसंधिषु .. 7.1.107.30 ..
16.107.m: He should place the syllable 'tat' on the head, the syllable 'sa' on the region of the face, / the syllable 'vi' in the region of the throat, and the syllable 'tu' on the joints of the limbs;

16.107.s:
vakāraṃ hṛdi madhye tu rekāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ ..
ṇikāraṃ dakṣiṇe kukṣau yakāraṃ vāmasaṃjñite .. 31 ..
16.107.d:
वकारं हृदि मध्ये तु रेकारं पार्श्वयोर्द्वयोः ..
णिकारं दक्षिणे कुक्षौ यकारं वामसंज्ञिते .. 31 ..
16.107.m: the syllable 'va' in the middle of the heart, the syllable 're' on the two sides, / the syllable 'ṇi' in the right flank, and the syllable 'ya' in that known as the left;

16.107.s:
bhakāraṃ kaṭinābhisthaṃ gokāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ ..
dekāraṃ jānunornyasya vakāraṃ pādapadmayoḥ .. 32 ..
16.107.d:
भकारं कटिनाभिस्थं गोकारं पार्श्वयोर्द्वयोः ..
देकारं जानुनोर्न्यस्य वकारं पादपद्मयोः .. 32 ..
16.107.m: the syllable 'bha' situated on the waist and navel, the syllable 'go' on both sides; / having placed the syllable 'de' on the two knees, the syllable 'va' on the lotus-feet;

16.107.s:
syakāramaṃguṣṭhayornyasya dhīkāramurasi nyaset ..
makāraṃ jānumūle tu hi kāraṃ guhyamāśritam .. 33 ..
16.107.d:
स्यकारमंगुष्ठयोर्न्यस्य धीकारमुरसि न्यसेत् ..
मकारं जानुमूले तु हि कारं गुह्यमाश्रितम् .. 33 ..
16.107.m: having placed the syllable 'sya' on the two big toes, he should place the syllable 'dhī' on the chest, / the syllable 'ma' at the root of the knees, and the syllable 'hi' resting on the private parts;

16.107.s:
dhikāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yokāraṃ cādharoṣṭhake ..
yokāraṃ ca tathaivānyamuttaroṣṭhe nyasetsudhīḥ .. 34 ..
16.107.d:
धिकारं हृदये न्यस्य योकारं चाधरोष्ठके ..
योकारं च तथैवान्यमुत्तरोष्ठे न्यसेत्सुधीः .. 34 ..
16.107.m: having placed the syllable 'dhi' on the heart, and the syllable 'yo' on the lower lip, / the wise man should likewise place the other syllable 'yo' on the upper lip;

16.107.s:
nakāraṃ nāsikāgre tu prakāraṃ netramāśritam ..
cokāraṃ ca bhruvormadhye dakāraṃ prāṇamāśritam .. 35 ..
16.107.d:
नकारं नासिकाग्रे तु प्रकारं नेत्रमाश्रितम् ..
चोकारं च भ्रुवोर्मध्ये दकारं प्राणमाश्रितम् .. 35 ..
16.107.m: the syllable 'na' on the tip of the nose, the syllable 'pra' situated in the eye, / the syllable 'co' between the eyebrows, and the syllable 'da' residing in the vital breath;

16.107.s:
yātkāraṃ ca lalāṭāṃte vinyasedvai sureśvari ..
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā''tmano dehe deve kuryāttathā priye .. 36 ..
16.107.d:
यात्कारं च ललाटांते विन्यसेद्वै सुरेश्वरि ..
न्यासं कृत्वा'ऽत्मनो देहे देवे कुर्यात्तथा प्रिये .. 36 ..
16.107.m: and he should place the syllable 'yāt' at the edge of the forehead, O ruler of the gods! / Having performed the ritual imposition on his own body, he should likewise perform it on the god, O beloved!

16.107.s:
sarvopahārasaṃpannaṃ kṛtvā samyaṅnirīkṣayet ..
kuṃkumāgarukarpūracaṃdanena vimiśritam .. 37 ..
16.107.d:
सर्वोपहारसंपन्नं कृत्वा सम्यङ्निरीक्षयेत् ..
कुंकुमागरुकर्पूरचंदनेन विमिश्रितम् .. 37 ..
16.107.m: Having made it furnished with all offerings, he should gaze upon it thoroughly, / mixed with saffron, agallochum, camphor, and sandalwood.

16.107.s:
gaṃdhatoyairupaskṛtya gāyatryā praṇavena ca ..
prokṣayetsarvadravyāṇi paścādarcanamārabhet .. 38 ..
16.107.d:
गंधतोयैरुपस्कृत्य गायत्र्या प्रणवेन च ..
प्रोक्षयेत्सर्वद्रव्याणि पश्चादर्चनमारभेत् .. 38 ..
16.107.m: Having consecrated [them] with fragrant waters, he should sprinkle all the articles / with the Gāyatrī and the praṇava, and thereafter begin the worship.

16.107.s:
divyai puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhaiśca mālatīkamalādibhiḥ ..
aśokaiḥ śatapatraiśca bakulaiḥ pūjayetkramāt .. 39 ..
16.107.d:
दिव्यै पुष्पैः सुगंधैश्च मालतीकमलादिभिः ..
अशोकैः शतपत्रैश्च बकुलैः पूजयेत्क्रमात् .. 39 ..
16.107.m: With heavenly, fragrant flowers, with jasmine, lotuses, and others, / with aśokas, hundred-petalled lotuses, and bakulas, he should worship in proper order;

16.107.s:
kṛṣṇāgarusudhūpena ghṛtadīpaistathottamaiḥ ..
tataḥ pradāpayettatra naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ kramāt .. 7.1.107.40 ..
16.107.d:
कृष्णागरुसुधूपेन घृतदीपैस्तथोत्तमैः ..
ततः प्रदापयेत्तत्र नैवेद्यं विविधं क्रमात् .. 7.1.107.40 ..
16.107.m: with the fine incense of black agallochum, and likewise with the best ghee-lamps; / then he should offer there various food-offerings in proper order:

16.107.s:
khaṇḍalaḍḍukaśrīveṣṭakāṃsārāśokapallavaiḥ ..
svastikollipikādugdhā tilaveṣṭakilāṭikām .. 41 ..
16.107.d:
खण्डलड्डुकश्रीवेष्टकांसाराशोकपल्लवैः ..
स्वस्तिकोल्लिपिकादुग्धा तिलवेष्टकिलाटिकाम् .. 41 ..
16.107.m: with sugar-candy laḍḍus, śrīveṣṭakas, sārā, and aśoka shoots, / svastikas, ollipikās, milk, tilaveṣṭakas, and curd-cakes,

16.107.s:
phalāni caiva pakvāni mūlamaṃtreṇa dāpayet ..
ṛgvedaṃ ca yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca pūjayet .. 42 ..
16.107.d:
फलानि चैव पक्वानि मूलमंत्रेण दापयेत् ..
ऋग्वेदं च यजुर्वेदं सामवेदं च पूजयेत् .. 42 ..
16.107.m: and ripe fruits, he should offer them with the root-mantra. / And he should worship the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, and the Sāmaveda.

16.107.s:
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ ..
īśānādikramāddevi diśāsu vidiśāsu ca .. 43 ..
16.107.d:
ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं धर्मं संपूजयेद्बुधः ..
ईशानादिक्रमाद्देवि दिशासु विदिशासु च .. 43 ..
16.107.m: The wise man should worship knowledge, detachment, sovereignty, and righteousness, / O goddess, beginning from the north-east in succession, in the cardinal and intermediate directions.

16.107.s:
caturddaśavidyāsthānāni brahmaṇo'gre prapūjayet ..
hṛdayāni tato nyasya devasya purataḥ kramāt .. 44 ..
16.107.d:
चतुर्द्दशविद्यास्थानानि ब्रह्मणोऽग्रे प्रपूजयेत् ..
हृदयानि ततो न्यस्य देवस्य पुरतः क्रमात् .. 44 ..
16.107.m: He should worship the fourteen seats of knowledge in front of Brahmā. / Then, having placed the heart-[mantras] in succession before the god:

16.107.s:
āpohiṣṭheti ṛgiyaṃ hṛdayaṃ parikīrttitam ..
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ śikhā proktā udutyaṃ netramādiśet .. 45 ..
16.107.d:
आपोहिष्ठेति ऋगियं हृदयं परिकीर्त्तितम् ..
ऋतं सत्यं शिखा प्रोक्ता उदुत्यं नेत्रमादिशेत् .. 45 ..
16.107.m: This verse beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' is proclaimed to be the heart; / 'ṛtaṃ satyam' is said to be the topknot; he should designate 'ud u tya' as the eye;

16.107.s:
citraṃ devānāmityevaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam ..
brahmaṃste chādayāmīti kavacaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 46 ..
16.107.d:
चित्रं देवानामित्येवं सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतम् ..
ब्रह्मंस्ते छादयामीति कवचं समुदाहृतम् .. 46 ..
16.107.m: [the verse] 'citraṃ devānām' is thus celebrated in all worlds; / 'brahmāṃs te chādayāmi' is cited as the armour;

16.107.s:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaritīreśa pūjanaṃ parikīrtitam ..
gāyatryā pūjayeddevamoṃkāreṇābhimaṃtritam.. 47..
16.107.d:
भूर्भुवः स्वरितीरेश पूजनं परिकीर्तितम् ..
गायत्र्या पूजयेद्देवमोंकारेणाभिमंत्रितम्.. 47..
16.107.m: the worship with 'bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' is proclaimed, O ruler! / He should worship the god with the Gāyatrī consecrated with the sound 'oṃ'.

16.107.s:
praṇavenāparānsarvānṛgvedādīnprapūjayet ..
gāyatrī paramo maṃtro vedamātā vibhāvarī .. 48 ..
16.107.d:
प्रणवेनापरान्सर्वानृग्वेदादीन्प्रपूजयेत् ..
गायत्री परमो मंत्रो वेदमाता विभावरी .. 48 ..
16.107.m: With the praṇava he should thoroughly worship all the others, the Ṛgveda and the rest. / The Gāyatrī is the supreme mantra, the mother of the Vedas, radiant.

16.107.s:
gāyatryakṣaratattvaistu brahmāṇaṃ yastu pūjayet ..
upoṣya paṃcadaśyāṃ tu sa yāti paramaṃ padam .. 49 ..
16.107.d:
गायत्र्यक्षरतत्त्वैस्तु ब्रह्माणं यस्तु पूजयेत् ..
उपोष्य पंचदश्यां तु स याति परमं पदम् .. 49 ..
16.107.m: Whoever, having fasted on the fifteenth day, worships Brahmā / through the principles of the syllables of the Gāyatrī, reaches the supreme state.

16.107.s:
saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoramuttitīrṣurdvijo yadi ..
prabhāse kārttike māsi brahmāṇaṃ pūjayetsadā .. 7.1.107.50 ..
16.107.d:
संसारसागरं घोरमुत्तितीर्षुर्द्विजो यदि ..
प्रभासे कार्त्तिके मासि ब्रह्माणं पूजयेत्सदा .. 7.1.107.50 ..
16.107.m: If a twice-born desires to cross over the terrible ocean of worldly existence, / he should always worship Brahmā in Prabhāsa during the month of Kārttika.

16.107.s:
yasya darśanamātreṇa aśvamedha phalaṃ labhet ..
kastaṃ na pūjayedvidvānprabhāse bālarūpiṇam .. 51 ..
16.107.d:
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण अश्वमेध फलं लभेत् ..
कस्तं न पूजयेद्विद्वान्प्रभासे बालरूपिणम् .. 51 ..
16.107.m: By the mere sight of whom one obtains the fruit of an horse-sacrifice, / what learned man would not worship him in the form of a child in Prabhāsa?

16.107.s:
yasyaikadivasaprāṃte sadevāsuramānavāḥ ..
vilayaṃ yāṃti deveśi kastaṃ na pratipūjayet .. 52 ..
16.107.d:
यस्यैकदिवसप्रांते सदेवासुरमानवाः ..
विलयं यांति देवेशि कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् .. 52 ..
16.107.m: At the close of a single day of whom the gods, demons, and mortals / go to dissolution, O ruler of gods—who would not worship him?

16.107.s:
pitā yaḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ..
yasmādeṣa sa taiḥ pūjyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣetravāsibhiḥ .. 53 ..
16.107.d:
पिता यः सर्वदेवानां भूतानां च पितामहः ..
यस्मादेष स तैः पूज्यो ब्राह्मणैः क्षेत्रवासिभिः .. 53 ..
16.107.m: He who is the father of all gods and the grandfather of created beings— / since he is this, he is to be worshipped by them, the brahmins residing in the sacred field.

16.107.s:
rudrarūpī viśvarūpī sa eva bhuvaneśvaraḥ ..
paurṇamāsyāmupoṣitvā brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim ..
arcayedyo vidhānena so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 54 ..
16.107.d:
रुद्ररूपी विश्वरूपी स एव भुवनेश्वरः ..
पौर्णमास्यामुपोषित्वा ब्रह्माणं जगतां पतिम् ..
अर्चयेद्यो विधानेन सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 54 ..
16.107.m: Having the form of Rudra, having universal form, he is the Lord of the world. / Fasting on the full-moon day, whoever worships Brahmā, the lord of worlds, / according to the injunctions, obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

16.107.s:
kārttike māsi devasya rathayātrā prakīrttitā ..
yāṃ kṛtvā mānavo bhaktyā yāti brahmasalokatām .. 55 ..
16.107.d:
कार्त्तिके मासि देवस्य रथयात्रा प्रकीर्त्तिता ..
यां कृत्वा मानवो भक्त्या याति ब्रह्मसलोकताम् .. 55 ..
16.107.m: In the month of Kārttika, the chariot-procession of the god is proclaimed, / having performed which with devotion a mortal goes to dwelling in the world of Brahmā.

16.107.s:
kārttike māsi deveśi paurṇamāsyāṃ caturmukham ..
mārgeṇa carmaṇā sārddhaṃ sāvitryā ca paraṃtapaḥ .. 56 ..
16.107.d:
कार्त्तिके मासि देवेशि पौर्णमास्यां चतुर्मुखम् ..
मार्गेण चर्मणा सार्द्धं सावित्र्या च परंतपः .. 56 ..
16.107.m: In the month of Kārttika, O ruler of the gods, on the full-moon day, the tormentor of foes, / [taking] the four-faced one along with the deer-skin and Sāvitrī,

16.107.s:
bhrāmayennagaraṃ sarvaṃ nānāvādyaiḥ samanvitam ..
sthāpayedbhrāmayitvā tu sakalaṃ nagaraṃ nṛpaḥ .. 57 ..
16.107.d:
भ्रामयेन्नगरं सर्वं नानावाद्यैः समन्वितम् ..
स्थापयेद्भ्रामयित्वा तु सकलं नगरं नृपः .. 57 ..
16.107.m: should take [them] around the whole city, accompanied by various musical instruments. / Having taken [them] around the entire city, the king should install [them].

16.107.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvāgre śāṃḍileyaṃ prapūjya ca ..
āropayedrathe devaṃ puṇyavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ .. 58 ..
16.107.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वाग्रे शांडिलेयं प्रपूज्य च ..
आरोपयेद्रथे देवं पुण्यवादित्रनिःस्वनैः .. 58 ..
16.107.m: Having first fed the brahmins and worshipped Śāṇḍileya, / he should mount the god on the chariot amidst the sounds of auspicious musical instruments.

16.107.s:
rathāgre śāṃḍilīputraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṃgalam .. 59 ..
16.107.d:
रथाग्रे शांडिलीपुत्रं पूजयित्वा विधानतः ..
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयित्वा च कृत्वा पुण्याहमंगलम् .. 59 ..
