16.107.m: Having worshipped the son of Śāṇḍilī at the front of the chariot according to the rules, / and having caused the brahmins to recite, performing the auspicious ceremony of the day,

16.107.s:
devamāropayitvā tu rathe kuryātprajāgaram ..
nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakairbrahmaśeṣaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .. 7.1.107.60 ..
16.107.d:
देवमारोपयित्वा तु रथे कुर्यात्प्रजागरम् ..
नानाविधैः प्रेक्षणकैर्ब्रह्मशेषैश्च पुष्कलैः .. 7.1.107.60 ..
16.107.m: and having mounted the god on the chariot, he should keep a night-vigil / with various kinds of spectacles and plentiful offerings left from Brahmā.

16.107.s:
nāroḍhavyaṃ rathe devi śūdreṇa śubhamicchatā ..
nādharmeṇa viśeṣeṇa muktvaikaṃ bhojakaṃ priye .. 61 ..
16.107.d:
नारोढव्यं रथे देवि शूद्रेण शुभमिच्छता ..
नाधर्मेण विशेषेण मुक्त्वैकं भोजकं प्रिये .. 61 ..
16.107.m: The chariot should not be mounted, O goddess, by a Śūdra desiring good fortune, / nor especially by an unrighteous person, except solely for the Bhojaka, O beloved.

16.107.s:
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśve sāvitrīṃ sthāpayetpriye ..
bhojakaṃ vāmapārśve tu purataḥ paṃkajaṃ nyaset .. 62 ..
16.107.d:
ब्रह्मणो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे सावित्रीं स्थापयेत्प्रिये ..
भोजकं वामपार्श्वे तु पुरतः पंकजं न्यसेत् .. 62 ..
16.107.m: He should place Sāvitrī on the right side of Brahmā, O beloved; / and the Bhojaka on the left side, while in front he should place a lotus.

16.107.s:
evaṃ tūryaninādaiśca śaṃkhaśabdaiśca puṣkalaiḥ ..
bhrāmayitvā rathaṃ devi puraṃ sarvaṃ ca dakṣiṇam ..
svasthāne sthāpayedbhūyaḥ kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ budhaḥ .. 63 ..
16.107.d:
एवं तूर्यनिनादैश्च शंखशब्दैश्च पुष्कलैः ..
भ्रामयित्वा रथं देवि पुरं सर्वं च दक्षिणम् ..
स्वस्थाने स्थापयेद्भूयः कृत्वा नीराजनं बुधः .. 63 ..
16.107.m: Having thus taken the chariot around, O goddess, and the entire city circumambulated clockwise, / amidst the sounds of horns and abundant conch-calls, / the wise man should reinstall [him] in his own place after performing the waving of lights.

16.107.s:
ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ bhaktyā yaścāpi paśyati ..
rathaṃ vā''karṣayedyastu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam .. 64 ..
16.107.d:
य एवं कुरुते यात्रां भक्त्या यश्चापि पश्यति ..
रथं वा'ऽकर्षयेद्यस्तु स गच्छेद्ब्रह्मणः पदम् .. 64 ..
16.107.m: Whoever performs the procession in this manner, and whoever watches it with devotion, / or whoever pulls the chariot, goes to the abode of Brahmā.

16.107.s:
yo dīpaṃ dhārayettatra brahmaṇo rathapṛṣṭhagaḥ ..
padepade'śvamedhasya sa phalaṃ viṃdate mahat .. 65 ..
16.107.d:
यो दीपं धारयेत्तत्र ब्रह्मणो रथपृष्ठगः ..
पदेपदेऽश्वमेधस्य स फलं विंदते महत् .. 65 ..
16.107.m: He who holds a lamp there, walking behind the chariot of Brahmā, / at every step obtains the great fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

16.107.s:
yo na kārayate rājā rathayātrāṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ ..
sa pacyate mahādevi raurave kālamakṣayam .. 66 ..
16.107.d:
यो न कारयते राजा रथयात्रां तु ब्रह्मणः ..
स पच्यते महादेवि रौरवे कालमक्षयम् .. 66 ..
16.107.m: The king who does not cause the chariot-procession of Brahmā to be conducted, / is roasted in the Raurava hell for imperishable time, O great goddess.

16.107.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rāṣṭrasya kṣemamicchatā ..
rathayātrāṃ viśeṣeṇa svayaṃ rājā pravarttayet .. 67 ..
16.107.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन राष्ट्रस्य क्षेममिच्छता ..
रथयात्रां विशेषेण स्वयं राजा प्रवर्त्तयेत् .. 67 ..
16.107.m: Therefore, with every effort, desiring the welfare of his realm, / the king himself should especially institute the chariot-procession.

16.107.s:
pratipadbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi bhojayedvi dhivatsudhīḥ ..
vāsobhirahataiścāpi gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 68 ..
16.107.d:
प्रतिपद्ब्राह्मणांश्चापि भोजयेद्वि धिवत्सुधीः ..
वासोभिरहतैश्चापि गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 68 ..
16.107.m: And on the first day, the wise man should feed the brahmins according to rule, / [honouring them] with unbleached garments, and also with perfumes, garlands, and unguents.

16.107.s:
kārttike māsyamāvāsyāṃ yastu dīpapradīpanam ..
śālāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kuryātsa gacchetparamaṃ padam .. 69 ..
16.107.d:
कार्त्तिके मास्यमावास्यां यस्तु दीपप्रदीपनम् ..
शालायां ब्रह्मणः कुर्यात्स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् .. 69 ..
16.107.m: Whoever lights lamps on the new-moon day in the month of Kārttika / in the hall of Brahmā, goes to the supreme state.

16.107.s:
utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu sarvakāle viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjayeyurimaṃ viprā brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum .. 7.1.107.70..
16.107.d:
उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु सर्वकाले विशेषतः ..
पूजयेयुरिमं विप्रा ब्रह्माणं जगतां गुरुम् .. 7.1.107.70..
16.107.m: On all festivals and at all times especially, / the brahmins should worship this Brahmā, the guru of the worlds.

16.107.s:
yathākṛtyaprayogeṇa samyakchraddhā samanvitāḥ ..
pūjyo divyopacāreṇa yathāvittānusārataḥ .. 71 ..
16.107.d:
यथाकृत्यप्रयोगेण सम्यक्छ्रद्धा समन्विताः ..
पूज्यो दिव्योपचारेण यथावित्तानुसारतः .. 71 ..
16.107.m: With the proper performance of ritual actions, endowed with full faith, / he should be worshipped with celestial articles of worship, according to one's wealth.

16.107.s:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi pūjāmāhātmyamuttamam ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ bālarūpiṇaḥ .. 72 ..
16.107.d:
एवं ते कथितं देवि पूजामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं ब्रह्मणः बालरूपिणः .. 72 ..
16.107.m: Thus has been told to you, O goddess, the supreme greatness of the worship, / the greatness of the sacred field of Prabhāsa, [and] of Brahmā in child-form.

16.107.s:
tasyāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ..
pradattvā ca paṭhitvā ca yajñāyutaphalaṃ labhet .. 73 ..
16.107.d:
तस्याहं कथयिष्यामि नाम्नामष्टोत्तरं शतम् ..
प्रदत्त्वा च पठित्वा च यज्ञायुतफलं लभेत् .. 73 ..
16.107.m: I shall recite to you his one hundred and eight names; / having imparted and recited it, one attains the fruit of ten thousand sacrifices.

16.107.s:
gāyatryā lakṣajāpyena samyagjaptena yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti stotrasyāsya udīraṇāt .. 74 ..
16.107.d:
गायत्र्या लक्षजाप्येन सम्यग्जप्तेन यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति स्तोत्रस्यास्य उदीरणात् .. 74 ..
16.107.m: Whatever fruit is attained by a hundred thousand recitations of the Gāyatrī properly muttered, / that very fruit one obtains from the utterance of this hymn of praise.

16.107.s:
idaṃ stotravaraṃ divyaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
na deyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ nindakānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 75 ..
16.107.d:
इदं स्तोत्रवरं दिव्यं रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
न देयं दुष्टबुद्धीनां निन्दकानां तथैव च .. 75 ..
16.107.m: This supreme, celestial hymn of praise, a secret destroyer of sins, / must not be given to evil-minded persons or indeed to slanderers.

16.107.s:
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śrotriyāya mahātmane ..
viṣṇunā hi purā pṛṣṭaṃ brahmaṇaḥ stotramuttmam .. 76 ..
16.107.d:
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्यं श्रोत्रियाय महात्मने ..
विष्णुना हि पुरा पृष्टं ब्रह्मणः स्तोत्रमुत्त्मम् .. 76 ..
16.107.m: It should be given to a high-souled, learned brahmin. / For formerly, Viṣṇu asked of Brahmā this supreme hymn of praise:

16.107.s:
keṣukeṣu ca sthāneṣu devadeva pitāmaha ..
saṃcintyastanmamācakṣva tvaṃ hi sarvaviduttama .. 77 ..
16.107.d:
केषुकेषु च स्थानेषु देवदेव पितामह ..
संचिन्त्यस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व त्वं हि सर्वविदुत्तम .. 77 ..
16.107.m: "In which places, O god of gods, O Grandfather, / are you to be meditated upon? Declare that to me, for you are the highest knower of all."

16.107.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
puṣkare'haṃ suraśreṣṭho gayāyāṃ prapitāmahaḥ..
kānyakubje vedagarbho bhṛgukṣetre caturmukhaḥ .. 78 ..
16.107.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
पुष्करेऽहं सुरश्रेष्ठो गयायां प्रपितामहः..
कान्यकुब्जे वेदगर्भो भृगुक्षेत्रे चतुर्मुखः .. 78 ..
16.107.m: Brahmā said: / "At Puṣkara I am the Best of Gods; at Gayā, the Great-Grandfather; / at Kānyakubja, Vedagarbha; at the field of Bhṛgu, the Four-Faced One;

16.107.s:
kauberyāṃ sṛṣṭikartā ca nandipuryāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ..
prabhāse bālarūpī ca vārāṇasyāṃ surapriyaḥ ..79..
16.107.d:
कौबेर्यां सृष्टिकर्ता च नन्दिपुर्यां बृहस्पतिः ..
प्रभासे बालरूपी च वाराणस्यां सुरप्रियः ..79..
16.107.m: and at Kauberī, the Creator; at Nandipurī, Bṛhaspati; / at Prabhāsa, the Child-Formed One; and at Vārāṇasī, the Beloved of Gods;

16.107.s:
dvārāvatyāṃ cakradevo vaidiśe bhuvanādhipaḥ ..
pauṃḍrake puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pītākṣo hastināpure .. 7.1.107.80 ..
16.107.d:
द्वारावत्यां चक्रदेवो वैदिशे भुवनाधिपः ..
पौंड्रके पुण्डरीकाक्षः पीताक्षो हस्तिनापुरे .. 7.1.107.80 ..
16.107.m: at Dvāravatī, Cakradeva; at Vaidiśa, the Lord of the World; / at Pauṇḍraka, the Lotus-Eyed One; at Hastināpura, the Yellow-Eyed One;

16.107.s:
jayaṃtyāṃ vijayaścāsau jayantaḥ puruṣottame ..
vāḍeṣu padmahasto'haṃ tamolipte tamonudaḥ .. 81 ..
16.107.d:
जयंत्यां विजयश्चासौ जयन्तः पुरुषोत्तमे ..
वाडेषु पद्महस्तोऽहं तमोलिप्ते तमोनुदः .. 81 ..
16.107.m: at Jayantī, Vijaya; at Puruṣottama, Jayanta; / at Vāḍa, I am Padmahasta; at Tamolipta, Tamonuda;

16.107.s:
āhicchatryāṃ janānaṃdaḥ kāñcīpuryāṃ janapriyaḥ ..
karṇāṭasya pure brahmā ṛṣikuṇḍe munistathā .. 82 ..
16.107.d:
आहिच्छत्र्यां जनानंदः काञ्चीपुर्यां जनप्रियः ..
कर्णाटस्य पुरे ब्रह्मा ऋषिकुण्डे मुनिस्तथा .. 82 ..
16.107.m: at Āhicchatra, Janānanda; at Kāñcīpurī, Janapriya; / at the city of Karṇāṭa, Brahmā; and at Ṛṣikuṇḍa, the Sage;

16.107.s:
śrīkaṇṭhe śrīnivāsaśca kāmarūpe śubhaṃkaraḥ ..
ucchriyāṇe devakarttā sraṣṭā jālaṃdhare tathā .. 83 ..
16.107.d:
श्रीकण्ठे श्रीनिवासश्च कामरूपे शुभंकरः ..
उच्छ्रियाणे देवकर्त्ता स्रष्टा जालंधरे तथा .. 83 ..
16.107.m: at Śrīkaṇṭha, Śrīnivāsa; and at Kāmarūpa, Śubhaṅkara; / at Ucchriyāṇa, the Maker of Gods; and likewise at Jālandhara, the Creator;

16.107.s:
mallikākhye tathā viṣṇurmahendre bhārgavastathā ..
gonardaḥ sthavirākāre hyujjayinyāṃ pitāmahaḥ .. 84 ..
16.107.d:
मल्लिकाख्ये तथा विष्णुर्महेन्द्रे भार्गवस्तथा ..
गोनर्दः स्थविराकारे ह्युज्जयिन्यां पितामहः .. 84 ..
16.107.m: likewise at the place called Mallikā, Viṣṇu; at Mahendra, Bhārgava; / at Gonarda, Sthavirākāra; and at Ujjayinī, the Grandfather;

16.107.s:
kauśāṃbyāṃ tu mahādevo hyayodhyāyāṃ tu rāghavaḥ ..
viraṃciścitrakūṭe tu vārāho vindhyaparvate .. 85 ..
16.107.d:
कौशांब्यां तु महादेवो ह्ययोध्यायां तु राघवः ..
विरंचिश्चित्रकूटे तु वाराहो विन्ध्यपर्वते .. 85 ..
16.107.m: at Kauśāmbī, Mahādeva; and at Ayodhyā, Rāghava; / at Citrakūṭa, Virañci; at the Vindhya mountain, Vārāha;

16.107.s:
gaṃgādvāre suraśreṣṭho himavante tu śaṃkaraḥ ..
dehikāyāṃ srucāhastaḥ padmahastastathā'rbude ..86 ..
16.107.d:
गंगाद्वारे सुरश्रेष्ठो हिमवन्ते तु शंकरः ..
देहिकायां स्रुचाहस्तः पद्महस्तस्तथाऽर्बुदे ..86 ..
16.107.m: at Gaṅgādvāra, the Best of Gods; and on the Himavat, Śaṃkara; / at Dehikā, Srucāhasta; and on Arbuda, Padmahasta;

16.107.s:
vṛndāvane padmanetraḥ kuśa hastaśca naimiṣe ..
gopakṣetre ca govindaḥ surendro yamunātaṭe .. 87 ..
16.107.d:
वृन्दावने पद्मनेत्रः कुश हस्तश्च नैमिषे ..
गोपक्षेत्रे च गोविन्दः सुरेन्द्रो यमुनातटे .. 87 ..
16.107.m: at Vṛndāvana, Padmanetra; and at Naimiṣa, Kuśahasta; / at Gopakṣetra, Govinda; on the bank of the Yamunā, Surendra;

16.107.s:
bhāgīrathyāṃ padmatanurjanānando janasthale ..
kauṃkaṇe ca sa madhvakṣaḥ kāmpilye kanakaprabhaḥ .. 88 ..
16.107.d:
भागीरथ्यां पद्मतनुर्जनानन्दो जनस्थले ..
कौंकणे च स मध्वक्षः काम्पिल्ये कनकप्रभः .. 88 ..
16.107.m: on the Bhāgīrathī, Padmatanu; at Janasthala, Janānanda; / in the Koṅkaṇa, Madhvakṣa; at Kāmpilya, Kanakaprabha;

16.107.s:
kheṭake cānnadātā ca śaṃbhuścaiva kratusthale ..
laṃkāyāṃ caiva paulastyaḥ kāśmīre haṃsavāhanaḥ .. 89 ..
16.107.d:
खेटके चान्नदाता च शंभुश्चैव क्रतुस्थले ..
लंकायां चैव पौलस्त्यः काश्मीरे हंसवाहनः .. 89 ..
16.107.m: at Kheṭaka, Annadātā; and at Kratusthala, Śambhu; / in Laṅkā, Paulastya; in Kaśmīra, Haṃsavāhana;

16.107.s:
vasiṣṭhaścārbude caiva nāradaścotpalāvane ..
medhake śrutidātā ca prayāge yajuṣāṃ patiḥ .. 7.1.107.90 ..
16.107.d:
वसिष्ठश्चार्बुदे चैव नारदश्चोत्पलावने ..
मेधके श्रुतिदाता च प्रयागे यजुषां पतिः .. 7.1.107.90 ..
16.107.m: on Arbuda, Vasiṣṭha; and in Utpalāvana, Nārada; / at Medhaka, Śrutidātā; and at Prayāga, the Lord of Yajus texts;

16.107.s:
śivaliṃge sāmavedo markaṭe ca madhupriyaḥ ..
nārāyaṇaśca gomante vidarbhāyāṃ dvija priyaḥ .. 91 ..
16.107.d:
शिवलिंगे सामवेदो मर्कटे च मधुप्रियः ..
नारायणश्च गोमन्ते विदर्भायां द्विज प्रियः .. 91 ..
16.107.m: in Śivaliṅga, Sāmaveda; and at Markaṭa, Madhupriya; / on Gomanta, Nārāyaṇa; in Vidarbha, Dvijapriya;

16.107.s:
aṃkulake brahmagarbho brahmavāhe sutapriyaḥ ..
indraprasthe durādharṣaścaṃpāyāṃ suramardanaḥ .. 92 ..
16.107.d:
अंकुलके ब्रह्मगर्भो ब्रह्मवाहे सुतप्रियः ..
इन्द्रप्रस्थे दुराधर्षश्चंपायां सुरमर्दनः .. 92 ..
16.107.m: at Aṅkulaka, Brahmagarbha; at Brahmavāha, Sutapriya; / at Indraprastha, Durādharṣa; at Campā, Suramardana;

16.107.s:
virajāyāṃ mahārūpaḥ surūpo rāṣṭravardhane ..
kadaṃbake janādhyakṣo devādhyakṣaḥ samasthale .. 93 ..
16.107.d:
विरजायां महारूपः सुरूपो राष्ट्रवर्धने ..
कदंबके जनाध्यक्षो देवाध्यक्षः समस्थले .. 93 ..
16.107.m: at Virajā, Mahārūpa; at Rāṣṭravardhana, Surūpa; / at Kadambaka, Janādhyakṣa; at Samasthala, Devādhyakṣa;

16.107.s:
gaṃgādharo rudrapīṭhe supīṭhe jaladaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tryaṃbake tripurāriśca śrīśaile ca trilocanaḥ .. 94 ..
16.107.d:
गंगाधरो रुद्रपीठे सुपीठे जलदः स्मृतः ..
त्र्यंबके त्रिपुरारिश्च श्रीशैले च त्रिलोचनः .. 94 ..
16.107.m: at Rudrapīṭha, Gaṅgādhara; at Supīṭha, remembered as Jalada; / at Tryambaka, Tripura's Enemy; and on Śrīśaila, the Three-Eyed One;

16.107.s:
mahādevaḥ plakṣapure kapāle vedhanāśanaḥ ..
śṛṅgaverapure śaurirnimiṣe cakradhārakaḥ .. 95 ..
16.107.d:
महादेवः प्लक्षपुरे कपाले वेधनाशनः ..
शृङ्गवेरपुरे शौरिर्निमिषे चक्रधारकः .. 95 ..
16.107.m: at Plakṣapura, Mahādeva; at Kapāla, Vedhanāśana; / at Śṛṅgaverapura, Śauri; at Nimiṣa, Cakradhāraka;

16.107.s:
nandipuryāṃ virūpākṣo gautamaḥ plakṣapādape ..
mālyavānhastināthe tu dvijendro vācike tathā .. 96 ..
16.107.d:
नन्दिपुर्यां विरूपाक्षो गौतमः प्लक्षपादपे ..
माल्यवान्हस्तिनाथे तु द्विजेन्द्रो वाचिके तथा .. 96 ..
16.107.m: at Nandipurī, Virūpākṣa; at the Plakṣa tree, Gautama; / at Hastinātha, Mālyavān; and at Vācika, Dvijendra;

16.107.s:
indrapuryāṃ divānātho bhūtikāyāṃ puraṃdaraḥ ..
haṃsabāhuśca candrāyāṃ caṃpāyāṃ garuḍapriyaḥ .. 97 ..
16.107.d:
इन्द्रपुर्यां दिवानाथो भूतिकायां पुरंदरः ..
हंसबाहुश्च चन्द्रायां चंपायां गरुडप्रियः .. 97 ..
16.107.m: at Indrapurī, Divānātha; at Bhūtikā, Purandara; / at Candrā, Haṃsabāhu; at Campā, Garuḍapriya;

16.107.s:
mahodaye mahāyakṣaḥ suyajñaḥ pūtake vane ..
siddheśvare śuklavarṇo vibhāyāṃ padmabodhakaḥ .. 98 ..
16.107.d:
महोदये महायक्षः सुयज्ञः पूतके वने ..
सिद्धेश्वरे शुक्लवर्णो विभायां पद्मबोधकः .. 98 ..
16.107.m: at Mahodaya, Mahāyakṣa; in Pūtaka forest, Suyajña; / at Siddheśvara, Śuklavarṇa; at Vibhā, Padmabodhaka;

16.107.s:
devadāruvane liṃgī udaketha umāpatiḥ ..
vināyako mātṛsthāne alakāyāṃ dhanādhipaḥ .. 99 ..
16.107.d:
देवदारुवने लिंगी उदकेथ उमापतिः ..
विनायको मातृस्थाने अलकायां धनाधिपः .. 99 ..
16.107.m: in Devadāruvana, Liṅgī; in Udaketha, Umā's Lord; / at Mātṛsthāna, Vināyaka; at Alakā, the Lord of Wealth;

16.107.s:
trikūṭe caiva goviṃdaḥ pātāle vāsukistathā ..
kovidāre yugādhyakṣaḥ strīrājye ca surapriyaḥ .. 7.1.107.100 ..
16.107.d:
त्रिकूटे चैव गोविंदः पाताले वासुकिस्तथा ..
कोविदारे युगाध्यक्षः स्त्रीराज्ये च सुरप्रियः .. 7.1.107.100 ..
16.107.m: on Trikūṭa, Govinda; and in Pātāla, Vāsuki; / at Kovidāra, Yugādhyakṣa; and in Strīrājya, Surapriya;

16.107.s:
pūrṇagiryāṃ subhogaśca śālmalyāṃ takṣakastathā ..
amare pāpahā caiva aṃbikāyāṃ sudarśanaḥ .. 101 ..
16.107.d:
पूर्णगिर्यां सुभोगश्च शाल्मल्यां तक्षकस्तथा ..
अमरे पापहा चैव अंबिकायां सुदर्शनः .. 101 ..
16.107.m: on Pūrṇagiri, Subhoga; and at Śālmalī, Takṣaka; / at Amara, Pāpahā; and at Ambikā, Sudarśana;

16.107.s:
naravāpyāṃ mahāvīraḥ kāntāre durganāśanaḥ ..
padmavatyāṃ padmagṛho gagane mṛgalāñchanaḥ .. 102 ..
16.107.d:
नरवाप्यां महावीरः कान्तारे दुर्गनाशनः ..
पद्मवत्यां पद्मगृहो गगने मृगलाञ्छनः .. 102 ..
16.107.m: at Naravāpī, Mahāvīra; in Kāntāra, Durganāśana; / at Padmavatī, Padmagṛha; in the sky, Mṛgalāñchana.

16.107.s:
aṣṭottaraṃ nāmaśataṃ yatraitatparipaṭhyate ..
tatraiva mama sāṃnidhyaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ madhusūdana .. 103 ..
16.107.d:
अष्टोत्तरं नामशतं यत्रैतत्परिपठ्यते ..
तत्रैव मम सांनिध्यं त्रिसंध्यं मधुसूदन .. 103 ..
16.107.m: Wherever this one hundred and eight names is recited, / my presence is right there at the three junctions of day and night, O Madhusūdana.

16.107.s:
teṣāmapi yastvekaṃ paśyedvai bālarūpiṇam ..
sarveṣāṃ labhate puṇyaṃ pūrvoktānāṃ ca vedhasām ..104..
16.107.d:
तेषामपि यस्त्वेकं पश्येद्वै बालरूपिणम् ..
सर्वेषां लभते पुण्यं पूर्वोक्तानां च वेधसाम् ..104..
16.107.m: Moreover, whoever sees that one [form] consisting of the Child-Form, / obtains the merit of all those previously mentioned forms of the Creator.

16.107.s:
etairyo nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇa prabhāse stauti māṃ sadā ..
sthānaṃ me vijayaṃ labdhvā modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 105 ..
16.107.d:
एतैर्यो नामभिः कृष्ण प्रभासे स्तौति मां सदा ..
स्थानं मे विजयं लब्ध्वा मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः .. 105 ..
16.107.m: Whoever always praises me at Prabhāsa with these names, O Kṛṣṇa, / having attained my victorious abode, rejoices for eternal years.

16.107.s:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ caiva duṣkṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti mama stotrā'nu kīrtanāt .. 106 ..
16.107.d:
मानसं वाचिकं चैव कायिकं चैव दुष्कृतम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति मम स्तोत्राऽनु कीर्तनात् .. 106 ..
16.107.m: Misdeeds committed mentally, vocally, / or physically—all of that goes to destruction from the recitation of my hymn of praise.

16.107.s:
puṣpopahaurardhūpaiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ..
dhyānena ca sthireṇāśu prāpyate yatphalaṃ naraiḥ ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti mama stotrānu kīrtanāt .. 107 ..
16.107.d:
पुष्पोपहौरर्धूपैश्च ब्राह्मणानां च तर्पणैः ..
ध्यानेन च स्थिरेणाशु प्राप्यते यत्फलं नरैः ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति मम स्तोत्रानु कीर्तनात् .. 107 ..
16.107.m: Whatever fruit is attained quickly by men through offerings of flowers, incense, / satisfactions offered to brahmins, and steady meditation, / that fruit one completely obtains from the recitation of my hymn of praise.

16.107.s:
brahmahatyādipāpāni iha loke kṛtānyapi ..
akāmataḥ kāmato vā tāni naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 108 ..
16.107.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि इह लोके कृतान्यपि ..
अकामतः कामतो वा तानि नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् .. 108 ..
16.107.m: Even sins such as the killing of a brahmin committed in this world, / unintentionally or intentionally, perish in that very instant.

16.107.s:
idaṃ stotraṃ mamābhīṣṭaṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpnuyānmahadīpsitam .. 109 ..
16.107.d:
इदं स्तोत्रं ममाभीष्टं शृणुयाद्वा पठेच्च वा ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैः प्राप्नुयान्महदीप्सितम् .. 109 ..
16.107.m: Whoever hears or reads this beloved hymn of mine, / is freed from all sins and will attain his great desire.

16.107.s: anyadrahasyaṃ te vacmi śṛṇu kṛṣṇa yathārthataḥ .. 7.1.107.110 ..
16.107.d: अन्यद्रहस्यं ते वच्मि शृणु कृष्ण यथार्थतः .. 7.1.107.110 ..
16.107.m: I will tell you another secret; listen truthfully, O Kṛṣṇa.

16.107.s:
āgneyaṃ tu yadā ṛkṣaṃ kārtikyāṃ bhavati kvacit ..
mahatī sā tithirjñeyā prabhāse mama vallabhā .. 111 ..
16.107.d:
आग्नेयं तु यदा ऋक्षं कार्तिक्यां भवति क्वचित् ..
महती सा तिथिर्ज्ञेया प्रभासे मम वल्लभा .. 111 ..
16.107.m: When the asterism belonging to Agni occurs on the full-moon day of Kārttika, / that should be known as a great lunar day, dear to me at Prabhāsa.

16.107.s:
prājāpatyaṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ tithau tasyāṃ bhavedyadi ..
sā mahākārtikī puṇyā devānāmapi durlabhā .. 112 ..
16.107.d:
प्राजापत्यं यदा ऋक्षं तिथौ तस्यां भवेद्यदि ..
सा महाकार्तिकी पुण्या देवानामपि दुर्लभा .. 112 ..
16.107.m: If on that lunar day the asterism belonging to Prajāpati should occur, / that Mahākārtikī is meritorious and difficult to attain even for the gods.

16.107.s:
maṃde vārke gurau vā'pi kārtikī kṛttikāyutā ..
tatrāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai bālarūpiṇam .. .. 113 ..
16.107.d:
मंदे वार्के गुरौ वाऽपि कार्तिकी कृत्तिकायुता ..
तत्राश्वमेधिकं पुण्यं दृष्ट्वा वै बालरूपिणम् .. .. 113 ..
16.107.m: When the Kārttikī [full-moon day] is joined with Kṛttikā on a Saturday, Sunday, or Thursday, / one attains the merit of a horse sacrifice by seeing the Child-Formed One there.

16.107.s:
viśākhāsu yadā sūryaḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ ..
sa yogaḥ padmako nāma prabhāse durlabho hare .. 114 ..
16.107.d:
विशाखासु यदा सूर्यः कृत्तिकासु च चन्द्रमाः ..
स योगः पद्मको नाम प्रभासे दुर्लभो हरे .. 114 ..
16.107.m: When the sun is in Viśākhā and the moon is in Kṛttikā, / that conjunction is named Padmaka, hard to attain at Prabhāsa, O Hari."

16.107.s:
tasminyoge naro dṛṣṭvā prabhāse bālarūpiṇam ..
pāpakoṭiyuto vā'pi yamalokaṃ na paśyati .. 115 ..
16.107.d:
तस्मिन्योगे नरो दृष्ट्वा प्रभासे बालरूपिणम् ..
पापकोटियुतो वाऽपि यमलोकं न पश्यति .. 115 ..
16.107.m: During that planetary conjunction, a man who sees [Brahmā] in the form of a child at Prabhāsa, / even if laden with millions of sins, does not behold the world of Yama. 115

16.107.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ brahmaṇā haraye punaḥ ..
mayā tava samākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ brahmadaivatam ..116 ..
16.107.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्येवं कथितं स्तोत्रं ब्रह्मणा हरये पुनः ..
मया तव समाख्यातं माहात्म्यं ब्रह्मदैवतम् ..116 ..
16.107.m:
Īśvara said:
Thus was this hymn recounted by Brahmā to Hari; / and the māhātmya with Brahmā as its deity has been related by me to you. 116

16.107.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam ..
bhūmidānaṃ ca dātavyaṃ tatra yātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. .. 117 ..
16.107.d:
सर्वपापहरं नृणां श्रुतं सर्वार्थसाधकम् ..
भूमिदानं च दातव्यं तत्र यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. .. 117 ..
16.107.m: When heard, it destroys all sins of mortals and accomplishes all aims. / And a gift of land should be given there by those desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage. 117

16.107.s:
kamaṃḍaluḥ śvetavastraṃ mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa ..
tatraiva devi deyāni brahmaṇe bālarūpiṇe ..118..
16.107.d:
कमंडलुः श्वेतवस्त्रं महादानानि षोडश ..
तत्रैव देवि देयानि ब्रह्मणे बालरूपिणे ..118..
16.107.m: A water-pot, white garments, and the sixteen great gifts— / right there, O goddess, they should be given to Brahmā in the form of a child. 118

16.107.s:
mahāparvaṇi saṃprāpte kuryuḥ pārāyaṇaṃ dvijāḥ ..
sarve te brāhmaṇā devi kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ .. 119 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye bālarūpibrahmaṇo māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 107 ..
16.107.d:
महापर्वणि संप्राप्ते कुर्युः पारायणं द्विजाः ..
सर्वे ते ब्राह्मणा देवि क्षेत्रमध्यनिवासिनः .. 119 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालरूपिब्रह्मणो माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 107 ..
16.107.m:
When a great festival day arrives, the twice-born should perform recitation of the text— / all those brahmins, O goddess, who reside in the middle of the sacred field. 119
Thus ends the one hundred and seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Brahmā in the Form of a Child,” in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. 107

16.108.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vasūnāṃ liṃgamuttamam ..
someśādīśadigbhāge pañcāśaddhanuṣāntare .. 1 ..
16.108.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि वसूनां लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
सोमेशादीशदिग्भागे पञ्चाशद्धनुषान्तरे .. 1 ..
16.108.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent liṅga of the Vasus, / located in the north-east direction from Someśa at a distance of fifty bows. 1

16.108.s:
sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi caturvaktraṃ surapriyam ..
pratyūṣeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. .. 2 ..
16.108.d:
स्थितं लिंगं महादेवि चतुर्वक्त्रं सुरप्रियम् ..
प्रत्यूषेश्वरनामानं महापातकनाशनम् .. .. 2 ..
16.108.m: Situated [there], O great goddess, is the four-faced liṅga dear to the gods, / named Pratyūṣeśvara, which destroys great sins. 2

16.108.s:
darśanāttasya devasya saptajanmāntarodbhavam..
pāpaṃ praṇāśamāyāti satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane .. 3 ..
16.108.d:
दर्शनात्तस्य देवस्य सप्तजन्मान्तरोद्भवम्..
पापं प्रणाशमायाति सत्यंसत्यं वरानने .. 3 ..
16.108.m: From the darśana of that god, the sin arising from seven births / comes to destruction; truly, truly, O fair-faced one! 3

16.108.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
ko'sau pratyūṣanāmeti kathaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam..
kasya putraḥ sa vikhyāta etanme vada śaṃkara .. 4 ..
16.108.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कोऽसौ प्रत्यूषनामेति कथं लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम्..
कस्य पुत्रः स विख्यात एतन्मे वद शंकर .. 4 ..
16.108.m:
The goddess said:
Who is this one named Pratyūṣa, and how was the liṅga consecrated? / Whose son is he known to be? Tell me this, O Śaṃkara! 4

16.108.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dakṣo brahmasuto devi prajāpatiriti smṛtaḥ ..
tasya kanyāḥ purā ṣaṣṭirdadau dharmāya vai daśa .. 5 ..
16.108.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
दक्षो ब्रह्मसुतो देवि प्रजापतिरिति स्मृतः ..
तस्य कन्याः पुरा षष्टिर्ददौ धर्माय वै दश .. 5 ..
16.108.m:
Īśvara said:
Dakṣa, the son of Brahmā, O goddess, is remembered as a Prajāpati. / Formerly he gave ten of his sixty daughters to Dharma. 5

16.108.s:
tāsāṃ madhye mahādevi ekā viśveti viśrutā ..
sā dharmācca mahādevi aṣṭāvajanayatsutān .. 6 ..
16.108.d:
तासां मध्ये महादेवि एका विश्वेति विश्रुता ..
सा धर्माच्च महादेवि अष्टावजनयत्सुतान् .. 6 ..
16.108.m: Among them, O great goddess, one is renowned as Viśvā. / And she, O great goddess, bore eight sons to Dharma: 6

16.108.s:
āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivā'nalo'nilaḥ ..
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ .. 7 ..
16.108.d:
आपो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवाऽनलोऽनिलः ..
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः .. 7 ..
16.108.m: Āpa, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anala, Anila, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāsa—these are celebrated as the eight Vasus. 7

16.108.s:
teṣāṃ madhye saptamo'sau pratyūṣa iti viśrutaḥ ..
sa putrakāmo deveśi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ .. 8 ..
16.108.d:
तेषां मध्ये सप्तमोऽसौ प्रत्यूष इति विश्रुतः ..
स पुत्रकामो देवेशि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः .. 8 ..
16.108.m: Among them, that seventh one is renowned as Pratyūṣa. / Desiring a son, O queen of gods, he came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa. 8

16.108.s:
sa jñātvā kāmikaṃ kṣetraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram ..
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ priye ..
dhyāyandevaṃ mahādevaṃ śāntastadgatamānasaḥ .. 9 ..
16.108.d:
स ज्ञात्वा कामिकं क्षेत्रं प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् ..
तपश्चचार विपुलं दिव्यं वर्षशतं प्रिये ..
ध्यायन्देवं महादेवं शान्तस्तद्गतमानसः .. 9 ..
16.108.m: Knowing it to be a sacred field that fulfills desires, he consecrated Maheśvara / and performed vast austerity for a hundred divine years, O beloved, / meditating on the god, Mahādeva, tranquil, with his mind fixed upon him. 9

16.108.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya bhaktyā nirañjanaḥ ..
dadau tasya sutaṃ devi devalaṃ yogināṃ varam .. 7.1.108.10 ..
16.108.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्य भक्त्या निरञ्जनः ..
ददौ तस्य सुतं देवि देवलं योगिनां वरम् .. 7.1.108.10 ..
16.108.m: Then Mahādeva, the taintless one, pleased by his devotion, / gave him a son, O goddess: Devala, the best of yogins. 10

16.108.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi talliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ ..
devalo bhagavānyogī pratyūṣasyā'bhavatsutaḥ .. 11 ..
16.108.d:
ततः प्रभृति देवेशि तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावतः ..
देवलो भगवान्योगी प्रत्यूषस्याऽभवत्सुतः .. 11 ..
16.108.m: From that time forward, O queen of gods, through the power of that liṅga, / the venerable yogin Devala became the son of Pratyūṣa. 11
For this reason it is designated as Pratyūṣeśvara. 12

16.108.s:
yaścānapatyaḥ puruṣastaṃ samārādhayiṣyati ..
tasyānvavāye deveśi saṃtatirna vinaśyati .. 13 ..
16.108.d:
यश्चानपत्यः पुरुषस्तं समाराधयिष्यति ..
तस्यान्ववाये देवेशि संततिर्न विनश्यति .. 13 ..
16.108.m: And whatever childless man worships it— / in his lineage, O queen of gods, offspring will never fail. 13

16.108.s:
yaḥ pratyūṣe mahādevi pratyūṣeśvaramuttamam ..
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā satataṃ niyatātmavān ..
tasyaiṣyati kṣayaṃ pāpamapi brahmavadhodbhavama .. 14 ..
16.108.d:
यः प्रत्यूषे महादेवि प्रत्यूषेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
पूजयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या सततं नियतात्मवान् ..
तस्यैष्यति क्षयं पापमपि ब्रह्मवधोद्भवम .. 14 ..
16.108.m: Whoever, at dawn, O great goddess, worships the supreme Pratyūṣeśvara / constantly with true devotion and a restrained mind, / his sin, even that arising from the slaughter of a brahmin, will come to an end. 14
A bull should be given right there by those who desire the full fruit of the pilgrimage. 15

16.108.s:
māghe kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ jāgṛyāttatra vai niśi ..
sarveṣāṃ dānayajñānāṃ phalaṃ jāgaraṇāllabhet .. 16 ..
16.108.d:
माघे कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां जागृयात्तत्र वै निशि ..
सर्वेषां दानयज्ञानां फलं जागरणाल्लभेत् .. 16 ..
16.108.m: One should keep vigil there at night on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha; / through keeping vigil, one obtains the fruit of all charitable gifts and sacrifices. 16

16.108.s:
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsasakṣetramāhātmye pratyūṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 108 ..
pratyūṣopari saṃkṣipta ṭippaṇī
16.108.d:
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभाससक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रत्यूषेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 108 ..
प्रत्यूषोपरि संक्षिप्त टिप्पणी
16.108.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and eighth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Pratyūṣeśvara,” in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. 108
Brief note on Pratyūṣa.

16.109.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi anileśvaramuttamam..
tasyottareśānadiksthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ tritaye priye .. 1 ..
16.109.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अनिलेश्वरमुत्तमम्..
तस्योत्तरेशानदिक्स्थं धनुषां त्रितये प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.109.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Anileśvara, / situated to the north-east of it at a distance of three bows, O beloved. 1

16.109.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi darśanātpāpanāśanam ..
vasūnāṃ pañcamo yo'sāvanilaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.109.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि दर्शनात्पापनाशनम् ..
वसूनां पञ्चमो योऽसावनिलः परिकीर्तितः .. 2 ..
16.109.m: The liṅga is of great power indeed, destroying sins upon darśana. / He who is celebrated as Anila is the fifth among the Vasus. 2

16.109.s:
sa cā''rādhya mahādevaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 3 ..
16.109.d:
स चा'ऽराध्य महादेवं प्रत्यक्षीकृतवान्भवम् ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 3 ..
16.109.m: Having worshipped Mahādeva, he made Bhava visible before him, / and consecrated the liṅga endowed with full faith. 3
Thus, by the power of the Lord, a mighty son was born to him as well, / renowned as Manojavā, and likewise [a son named] Avijñātagati. 4

16.109.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vyādhinā martyo pīḍyate na kadācana ..
nāndho na badhiro mūko na rogī na ca nirdhanaḥ ..
kadācijjāyate martyastena dṛṣṭena bhūtale .. 5 ..
16.109.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा व्याधिना मर्त्यो पीड्यते न कदाचन ..
नान्धो न बधिरो मूको न रोगी न च निर्धनः ..
कदाचिज्जायते मर्त्यस्तेन दृष्टेन भूतले .. 5 ..
16.109.m: Upon seeing it, a mortal is never afflicted by disease; / blind, deaf, mute, sick, or destitute— / no mortal on earth ever becomes so upon seeing it. 5

16.109.s:
puṣpamekaṃ tu yo dadyāttasya liṃgasya copari ..
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpannaḥ sa sadā rūpavānbhavet .. 6 ..
16.109.d:
पुष्पमेकं तु यो दद्यात्तस्य लिंगस्य चोपरि ..
सुखसौभाग्यसंपन्नः स सदा रूपवान्भवेत् .. 6 ..
16.109.m: Whoever offers even a single flower upon that liṅga / becomes endowed with happiness and good fortune, and will always be handsome. 6

16.109.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam..
śrutvā'numodya bhāvena sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhyate .. 7 ..
16.109.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम्..
श्रुत्वाऽनुमोद्य भावेन सर्वकामैः समृद्ध्यते .. 7 ..
16.109.m: Thus has the sin-destroying māhātmya been told, O goddess; / having heard it and approved of it with devotion, one flourishes with all desires fulfilled. 7

16.109.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye 'nileśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaraśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ..109..
16.109.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ऽनिलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवोत्तरशतत मोऽध्यायः ..109..
16.109.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Anileśvara,” in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. 109

16.110.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe prabhāseśvaramuttamam ..
gaurītapovanāddevi paścime samudāhṛtam ..1..
16.110.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे प्रभासेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
गौरीतपोवनाद्देवि पश्चिमे समुदाहृतम् ..1..
16.110.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O fair-hipped woman, one should go to the excellent Prabhāseśvara, / declared to be to the west of the ascetic grove of Gaurī, O goddess, 1

16.110.s:
dhanuṣāṃ saptake devi nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṃgaṃ vasūnāmaṣṭamena hi .. 2 ..
16.110.d:
धनुषां सप्तके देवि नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
स्थापितं तन्महालिंगं वसूनामष्टमेन हि .. 2 ..
16.110.m: situated not very far away, at a distance of seven bows, O goddess. / That great liṅga was established by the eighth among the Vasus, 2

16.110.s:
prabhāsa iti nāmnā hi śivapūjāratena vai ..
sa putrakāmo deveśi prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ ..3..
16.110.d:
प्रभास इति नाम्ना हि शिवपूजारतेन वै ..
स पुत्रकामो देवेशि प्रभासक्षेत्रमागतः ..3..
16.110.m: named Prabhāsa indeed, who was devoted to the worship of Śiva. / Desiring a son, O queen of gods, he came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa. 3

16.110.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṅgaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ..
āgneyamiti vikhyātaṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye .. 4 ..
16.110.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिङ्गं चचार विपुलं तपः ..
आग्नेयमिति विख्यातं दिव्याब्दानां शतं प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.110.m: Having consecrated the great liṅga, he performed vast austerity / renowned as Āgneya, for a hundred divine years, O beloved. 4

16.110.s:
tatastasya mahādevi samyakchraddhānvi tasya vai ..
tutoṣa bhagavānrudro dadau yanmanasīpsitam ..5..
16.110.d:
ततस्तस्य महादेवि सम्यक्छ्रद्धान्वि तस्य वै ..
तुतोष भगवान्रुद्रो ददौ यन्मनसीप्सितम् ..5..
16.110.m: Then, O great goddess, the blessed Rudra was pleased with him / who was endowed with complete faith, and gave what his heart desired. 5

16.110.s:
bṛhaspatestu bhaginī bhuvanā brahmavādinī ..
prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca .. ..6..
16.110.d:
बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी भुवना ब्रह्मवादिनी ..
प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च .. ..6..
16.110.m: Bṛhaspati's sister was Bhuvanā, a speaker of the sacred truth; / she was the wife of Prabhāsa, the eighth of the Vasus. 6

16.110.s:
viśvakarmā sutastasyāḥ sṛṣṭikartā prajāpatiḥ..
devānāṃ takṣako vidvānmanormātāmahaḥ smṛtaḥ ..7..
16.110.d:
विश्वकर्मा सुतस्तस्याः सृष्टिकर्ता प्रजापतिः..
देवानां तक्षको विद्वान्मनोर्मातामहः स्मृतः ..7..
16.110.m: Viśvakarman was her son, the creator of creatures, a Prajāpati, / the wise architect of the gods, remembered as the maternal grandfather of Manu. 7

16.110.s:
takṣakaḥ sūryabiṃbasya tejasaḥ śātano mahān..
evaṃ tasyā'bhavatputro vasūnāmaṣṭamasya vai .. 8 ..
16.110.d:
तक्षकः सूर्यबिंबस्य तेजसः शातनो महान्..
एवं तस्याऽभवत्पुत्रो वसूनामष्टमस्य वै .. 8 ..
16.110.m: He was the great fashioner of the solar orb, reducing its brilliance. / Thus a son was born to that eighth among the Vasus, 8

16.110.s:
prabhāsanāmno deveśi talliṃgārādhanodyataḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ devi prabhāseśvarasūcakam .. 9 ..
16.110.d:
प्रभासनाम्नो देवेशि तल्लिंगाराधनोद्यतः ..
इति ते कथितं देवि प्रभासेश्वरसूचकम् .. 9 ..
16.110.m: named Prabhāsa, O queen of gods, who applied himself to the worship of that liṅga. / Thus has been related to you, O goddess, that which indicates Prabhāseśvara. 9

16.110.s:
māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 7.1.110.10 ..
16.110.d:
माहात्म्यं सर्वपापघ्नं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 7.1.110.10 ..
16.110.m: This auspicious māhātmya destroys all sins and grants all desires. / Whoever worships it with devotion, endowed with complete faith,

16.110.s:
bhūmiśāyī nirāhāro japanvai śatarudriyam ..
māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ snātvā sāgarasaṃgame .. 11 ..
16.110.d:
भूमिशायी निराहारो जपन्वै शतरुद्रियम् ..
माघे मासि चतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा सागरसंगमे .. 11 ..
16.110.m: Sleeping on the ground, fasting, and reciting the Śatarudriya, / having bathed at the confluence with the ocean on the fourteenth day of the month of Māgha,
Bathing [the liṅga] with the five nectars, and having worshipped [it] according to the ritual rules,

16.110.s:
ya evaṃ kurute devi samyagyātrāmahotsavam ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhyate ..
vṛṣastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 13 ..
16.110.d:
य एवं कुरुते देवि सम्यग्यात्रामहोत्सवम् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैः सर्वकामैः समृद्ध्यते ..
वृषस्तत्रैव दातव्यः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 13 ..
16.110.m: Whoever performs this great festival of pilgrimage properly, O Goddess, / is freed from all sins and thrives with all desires. / A bull should be given right there by those who desire the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.110.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāseśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 110 ..
16.110.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रभासेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 110 ..
16.110.m: Thus ends the one hundred and tenth chapter, titled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Prabhāseśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.111.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkarāraṇyamuttamam ..
tasmādīśānakoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam .. 1 ..
16.111.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुष्करारण्यमुत्तमम् ..
तस्मादीशानकोणस्थं धनुषां षष्टिभिः स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.111.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the excellent Puṣkarāraṇya, / situated sixty bows to the northeast of that [place].

16.111.s:
tatra kuṇḍaṃ mahādevi hyaṣṭapuṣkarasaṃjñitam ..
sarva pāpaharaṃ devi duṣprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ .. 2 ..
16.111.d:
तत्र कुण्डं महादेवि ह्यष्टपुष्करसंज्ञितम् ..
सर्व पापहरं देवि दुष्प्राप्यमकृतात्मभिः .. 2 ..
16.111.m: There is a pool there, O Great Goddess, called Aṣṭapuṣkara, / which destroys all sins, O Goddess, and is hard to reach for those of uncontrolled mind.

16.111.s:
tatra kuṇḍasamīpe tu purā rāmeśadhīmatā ..
sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṅgaṃ rāmeśvara iti smṛtam .. 3 ..
16.111.d:
तत्र कुण्डसमीपे तु पुरा रामेशधीमता ..
स्थापितं तन्महालिङ्गं रामेश्वर इति स्मृतम् .. 3 ..
16.111.m: Near that pool, in ancient times, the wise Rāma, lord of the earth, / established that great liṅga known as Rāmeśvara.

16.111.s: tasya pūjanamātreṇa mucyate brahmahatyayā .. 4 ..
16.111.d: तस्य पूजनमात्रेण मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 4 ..
16.111.m: Merely by worshipping it, one is freed from the sin of killing a brahmin.

16.111.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
bhagavanvistarādbrūhi rāmeśvarasamudbhavam ..
kathaṃ tatrāgamadrāmaḥ sasītaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ .. 5 ..
16.111.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्विस्तराद्ब्रूहि रामेश्वरसमुद्भवम् ..
कथं तत्रागमद्रामः ससीतश्च सलक्ष्मणः .. 5 ..
16.111.m: The glorious Goddess said: / Tell me in detail, O Lord, about the origin of Rāmeśvara: / how did Rāma go there, accompanied by Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa?

16.111.s:
kathaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣkare pāpataskare ..
etadvistarato brūhi phalaṃ māhātmyasaṃyutam .. 6 ..
16.111.d:
कथं प्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गं पुष्करे पापतस्करे ..
एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि फलं माहात्म्यसंयुतम् .. 6 ..
16.111.m: How was the liṅga consecrated at Puṣkara, the stealer of sins? / Tell this in detail, together with its fruit and māhātmya.

16.111.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
caturviṃśayuge rāmo vasiṣṭhena purodhasā ..
purā rāvaṇanāśārthaṃ jajñe daśarathātmajaḥ .. 7 ..
16.111.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
चतुर्विंशयुगे रामो वसिष्ठेन पुरोधसा ..
पुरा रावणनाशार्थं जज्ञे दशरथात्मजः .. 7 ..
16.111.m: Īśvara said: / In the twenty-fourth yuga, Rāma, born as the son of Daśaratha / with Vasiṣṭha as his family priest, took birth in ancient times to destroy Rāvaṇa.

16.111.s:
tataḥ kālāntare devi ṛṣiśāpānmahātapāḥ ..
yayau dāśarathī rāmaḥ sasītaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
16.111.d:
ततः कालान्तरे देवि ऋषिशापान्महातपाः ..
ययौ दाशरथी रामः ससीतः सहलक्ष्मणः .. 8 ..
16.111.m: Then, in the course of time, O Goddess, because of a seer's curse, the great ascetic / Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, set forth with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa.

16.111.s:
vanavāsāya niṣkrāṃto divyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ ..
tato yātrāprasaṃgena prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ .. 9 ..
16.111.d:
वनवासाय निष्क्रांतो दिव्यैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वृतः ..
ततो यात्राप्रसंगेन प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः .. 9 ..
16.111.m: He departed into exile in the forest, accompanied by divine brahmin-seers. / Then, in the course of his pilgrimage, he arrived at the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.111.s:
taṃ deśaṃ tu samāsādya suśrāṃto niṣasāda ha ..
astaṃ gate tataḥ sūrye parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale .. 7.1.111.10 ..
16.111.d:
तं देशं तु समासाद्य सुश्रांतो निषसाद ह ..
अस्तं गते ततः सूर्ये पर्णान्यास्तीर्य भूतले .. 7.1.111.10 ..
16.111.m: Having reached that region, utterly exhausted, he sat down. / Then, after the sun had set, he spread leaves on the ground

16.111.s:
suṣvāpātha niśāśeṣe dadṛśe pitaraṃ svakam ..
svapne daśarathaṃ devi saumyarūpaṃ mahāprabham .. 11 ..
16.111.d:
सुष्वापाथ निशाशेषे ददृशे पितरं स्वकम् ..
स्वप्ने दशरथं देवि सौम्यरूपं महाप्रभम् .. 11 ..
16.111.m: And slept; then, at the end of the night, he saw his father, / Daśaratha, in a dream, O Goddess, gentle in form and of great splendor.

16.111.s:
prātarutthāya tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat ..
yathā daśarathaḥ svapne dṛṣṭastena mahātmanā .. 12 ..
16.111.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न्यवेदयत् ..
यथा दशरथः स्वप्ने दृष्टस्तेन महात्मना .. 12 ..
16.111.m: Rising in the morning, he reported all that to the brahmins, / how Daśaratha had been seen in a dream by that great-souled one.

16.111.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
vṛddhikāmāśca pitaro varadāstava rāghava ..
darśanaṃ hi prayacchaṃti svapnānte hi svavaṃśaje .. 13 ..
16.111.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
वृद्धिकामाश्च पितरो वरदास्तव राघव ..
दर्शनं हि प्रयच्छंति स्वप्नान्ते हि स्ववंशजे .. 13 ..
16.111.m: The brahmins said: / The ancestors, desiring increase, grant boons to you, O descendant of Raghu; / they indeed give a darśana at the end of a dream to one born in their lineage.

16.111.s:
etattīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ suguptaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ ..
puṣkareti samākhyātaṃ śrāddhamatra pradīyatām .. 14 ..
16.111.d:
एतत्तीर्थं महापुण्यं सुगुप्तं शार्ङ्गधन्वनः ..
पुष्करेति समाख्यातं श्राद्धमत्र प्रदीयताम् .. 14 ..
16.111.m: This is a very holy sacred ford, well guarded by the wielder of the Śārṅga bow, / renowned as Puṣkara; let a śrāddha be offered here.

16.111.s:
nūnaṃ daśaratho rājā tīrthe cāsminsamīhate ..
tvayā dattaṃ śubhaṃ piṇḍaṃ tataḥ sa darśanaṃ gataḥ .. 15 ..
16.111.d:
नूनं दशरथो राजा तीर्थे चास्मिन्समीहते ..
त्वया दत्तं शुभं पिण्डं ततः स दर्शनं गतः .. 15 ..
16.111.m: Surely King Daśaratha desires [an offering] in this sacred ford, / an auspicious rice ball offered by you; therefore he appeared in a vision.

16.111.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ..
nimaṃtrayāmāsa tadā śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇāñchubhān .. 16 ..
16.111.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामो राजीवलोचनः ..
निमंत्रयामास तदा श्राद्धार्हान्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान् .. 16 ..
16.111.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing those words of theirs, lotus-eyed Rāma / then invited auspicious brahmins worthy of a śrāddha.

16.111.s:
abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ pārśve sthitaṃ vinatakaṃdharam ..
phalārthaṃ vraja saumitre śrāddhārthaṃ tvarayā'nvitaḥ .. 17 ..
16.111.d:
अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं पार्श्वे स्थितं विनतकंधरम् ..
फलार्थं व्रज सौमित्रे श्राद्धार्थं त्वरयाऽन्वितः .. 17 ..
16.111.m: He spoke to Lakṣmaṇa, who stood beside him with bent neck: / “Go quickly, O son of Sumitrā, to fetch fruits for the śrāddha.”

16.111.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāma raghunaṃdanaḥ ..
ānayāmāsa śīghraṃ sa phalāni vividhāni ca .. 18 ..
16.111.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जगाम रघुनंदनः ..
आनयामास शीघ्रं स फलानि विविधानि च .. 18 ..
16.111.m: Saying “So be it,” that delighter of the Raghus went, / and he swiftly brought many kinds of fruits:

16.111.s:
bilvāni ca kapitthāni tindukāni ca bhūriśaḥ ..
badarāṇi karīrāṇi karamardāni ca priye .. 19 ..
16.111.d:
बिल्वानि च कपित्थानि तिन्दुकानि च भूरिशः ..
बदराणि करीराणि करमर्दानि च प्रिये .. 19 ..
16.111.m: Bilvas, kapitthas, and tindukas in abundance, / jujubes, karīras, and karamardas, O dear one,

16.111.s:
cirbhaṭāni parūṣāṇi mātuliṃgāni vai tathā ..
nālikerāṇi śubhrāṇi iṃgudīsaṃbhavāni ca .. 7.1.111.20 ..
16.111.d:
चिर्भटानि परूषाणि मातुलिंगानि वै तथा ..
नालिकेराणि शुभ्राणि इंगुदीसंभवानि च .. 7.1.111.20 ..
16.111.m: Cirbhaṭas, parūṣas, and citrons too, / white coconuts, and the produce of ingudīs.

16.111.s:
athaitāni papācāśu sītā janakanaṃdinī ..
tatastu kutape kāle snātvā valkalabhṛcchuciḥ .. 21 ..
16.111.d:
अथैतानि पपाचाशु सीता जनकनंदिनी ..
ततस्तु कुतपे काले स्नात्वा वल्कलभृच्छुचिः .. 21 ..
16.111.m: Then Sītā, the delighter of Janaka, quickly prepared them. / Thereafter, at the kutapa hour, having bathed, wearing bark garments and purified,

16.111.s:
brāhmaṇānānayāmāsa śrāddhārhāndvijasattamān ..
gālavo devalo raibhyo yavakrīto'tha parvataḥ .. 22 ..
16.111.d:
ब्राह्मणानानयामास श्राद्धार्हान्द्विजसत्तमान् ..
गालवो देवलो रैभ्यो यवक्रीतोऽथ पर्वतः .. 22 ..
16.111.m: He brought brahmins worthy of a śrāddha, the best of the twice-born: / Gālava, Devala, Raibhya, Yavakrīta, then Parvata,

16.111.s:
bharadvājo vasiṣṭhaśca jāvālirgautamo bhṛguḥ ..
ete cānye ca bahavo brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ .. 23 ..
16.111.d:
भरद्वाजो वसिष्ठश्च जावालिर्गौतमो भृगुः ..
एते चान्ये च बहवो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः .. 23 ..
16.111.m: Bharadvāja, Vasiṣṭha, Jāvāli, Gautama, and Bhṛgu. / These and many other brahmins who had mastered the Vedas

16.111.s:
śrāddhārthaṃ tasya saṃprāptā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ..
etasminneva kāle tu rāmaḥ sītāmabhāṣata .. 24 ..
16.111.d:
श्राद्धार्थं तस्य संप्राप्ता रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रामः सीतामभाषत .. 24 ..
16.111.m: Arrived for the śrāddha of that Rāma of untiring deeds. / At that very moment, Rāma spoke to Sītā:

16.111.s:
ehi vaidehi viprāṇāṃ dehi pādāvanejanam ..
etacchrutvā'tha sā sītā praviṣṭā vṛkṣamadhyataḥ .. 25 ..
16.111.d:
एहि वैदेहि विप्राणां देहि पादावनेजनम् ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वाऽथ सा सीता प्रविष्टा वृक्षमध्यतः .. 25 ..
16.111.m: “Come, O princess of Videha, give water for washing the feet of the brahmins.” / Hearing this, Sītā went among the trees,

16.111.s:
gulmairācchādya cātmānaṃ rāmasyādarśane sthitā ..
muhurmuhuryadā rāmaḥ sītāsītāmabhāṣata .. 26 ..
16.111.d:
गुल्मैराच्छाद्य चात्मानं रामस्यादर्शने स्थिता ..
मुहुर्मुहुर्यदा रामः सीतासीतामभाषत .. 26 ..
16.111.m: And hiding herself behind bushes, she stayed out of Rāma's sight, / while again and again Rāma called, “Sītā! Sītā!”

16.111.s:
jñātvā tāṃ lakṣmaṇo naṣṭāṃ kopāviṣṭaṃ ca rāghavam ..
svayameva tadā cakre brāhmaṇārha pratikriyām .. .. 27 ..
16.111.d:
ज्ञात्वा तां लक्ष्मणो नष्टां कोपाविष्टं च राघवम् ..
स्वयमेव तदा चक्रे ब्राह्मणार्ह प्रतिक्रियाम् .. .. 27 ..
16.111.m: Seeing that she was gone and that the descendant of Raghu was seized with anger, / Lakṣmaṇa himself then performed the duties appropriate for the brahmins.

16.111.s:
atha bhukteṣu vipreṣu kṛta piṃḍapradānake ..
āgatā jānakī sītā yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ .. 28 ..
16.111.d:
अथ भुक्तेषु विप्रेषु कृत पिंडप्रदानके ..
आगता जानकी सीता यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः .. 28 ..
16.111.m: Then, when the brahmins had eaten and the offering of rice balls was completed, / Sītā, the daughter of Janaka, came to where Rāma stood.

16.111.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paruṣairvākyairbhartsayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ..
dhigdhikpāpe dvijāṃstyaktvā pitṛkṛtyamahodayam ..
kva gatā'si ca māṃ hitvā śrāddhakāle hyupasthite .. 29 ..
16.111.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा परुषैर्वाक्यैर्भर्त्सयामास राघवः ..
धिग्धिक्पापे द्विजांस्त्यक्त्वा पितृकृत्यमहोदयम् ..
क्व गताऽसि च मां हित्वा श्राद्धकाले ह्युपस्थिते .. 29 ..
16.111.m: Seeing her, the descendant of Raghu rebuked her with harsh words: / “Fie, fie, O sinful woman! Leaving the twice-born and this greatly auspicious rite for the ancestors, / where did you go, abandoning me when the time of the śrāddha was at hand?”

16.111.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhayabhītā ca jānakī .. 7.1.111.30 ..
16.111.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भयभीता च जानकी .. 7.1.111.30 ..
16.111.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, Janaka's daughter was terrified,

16.111.s:
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā vepamānā hyabhāṣata ..
mā kopaṃ kuru kalyāṇa mā māṃ nirbhartsaya prabho .. 31 ..
16.111.d:
कृताञ्जलिपुटा भूत्वा वेपमाना ह्यभाषत ..
मा कोपं कुरु कल्याण मा मां निर्भर्त्सय प्रभो .. 31 ..
16.111.m: And joining her palms, trembling, she spoke: / “Do not be angry, O auspicious one! Do not rebuke me, O lord!

16.111.s:
śṛṇu yasmādvibho'nyatra gatā tyaktvā tavāntikam ..
dṛṣṭastatra pitā me'dya tathā caiva pitāmahaḥ .. 32 ..
16.111.d:
शृणु यस्माद्विभोऽन्यत्र गता त्यक्त्वा तवान्तिकम् ..
दृष्टस्तत्र पिता मेऽद्य तथा चैव पितामहः .. 32 ..
16.111.m: Hear why, O lord, I went elsewhere, away from your presence. / My father was seen by me there today, and likewise my grandfather,

16.111.s:
tasya pūrvataraścāpi tathā mātāmahādayaḥ ..
aṃgeṣu brāhmaṇendrāṇāmākrāntāste pṛthakpṛthak .. 33 ..
16.111.d:
तस्य पूर्वतरश्चापि तथा मातामहादयः ..
अंगेषु ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणामाक्रान्तास्ते पृथक्पृथक् .. 33 ..
16.111.m: And those prior to him, as well as my maternal grandfathers and others: / each of them took possession of the limbs of the foremost brahmins!

16.111.s:
tato lajjā samabhavattatra me raghunandana ..
pitrā tatra mahābāho manojñāni śubhāni ca .. 34 ..
16.111.d:
ततो लज्जा समभवत्तत्र मे रघुनन्दन ..
पित्रा तत्र महाबाहो मनोज्ञानि शुभानि च .. 34 ..
16.111.m: Then shame came over me there, O descendant of Raghu! / By your father, O mighty-armed one, pleasant and splendid

16.111.s:
bhakṣyāṇi bhakṣitānyeva yāni vai guṇavanti ca ..
sa kathaṃ sukaṣāyāṇi kṣārāṇi kaṭukāni ca ..
bhakṣayiṣyati rājendra tato me duḥkhamāviśat.. 36 ..
etasmātkāraṇānnaṣṭā lajjayā'haṃ raghūdvaha ..
dṛṣṭvā śvaśuravargaṃ svaṃ tasmātkopaṃ parityaja .. 36 ..
16.111.d:
भक्ष्याणि भक्षितान्येव यानि वै गुणवन्ति च ..
स कथं सुकषायाणि क्षाराणि कटुकानि च ..
भक्षयिष्यति राजेन्द्र ततो मे दुःखमाविशत्.. 36 ..
एतस्मात्कारणान्नष्टा लज्जयाऽहं रघूद्वह ..
दृष्ट्वा श्वशुरवर्गं स्वं तस्मात्कोपं परित्यज .. 36 ..
16.111.m:
Edibles were always eaten, foods of excellent quality; / how will he eat these very astringent, salty, and bitter foods? / Therefore, O king of kings, sorrow entered my heart.
For this reason, out of shame, I vanished, O best of the Raghus, / seeing my father-in-law's line; therefore abandon your anger.”

16.111.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismito rāghavo'bhavat ..
viśeṣeṇa dadau tasmiñchrāddhaṃ tīrthe tu puṣkare .. 37 ..
tatra puṣkarasānnidhye dakṣiṇe dhanuṣāṃ traye ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa rāmeśvaramiti śrutam .. 35 ..
16.111.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मितो राघवोऽभवत् ..
विशेषेण ददौ तस्मिञ्छ्राद्धं तीर्थे तु पुष्करे .. 37 ..
तत्र पुष्करसान्निध्ये दक्षिणे धनुषां त्रये ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास रामेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् .. 35 ..
16.111.m:
Hearing those words of hers, the descendant of Raghu was filled with wonder. / He then performed the śrāddha with special care at that sacred ford of Puṣkara.
There, in the presence of Puṣkara, three bow-lengths to the south, / he established the liṅga known as Rāmeśvara.

16.111.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
sa prāpnoti paraṃ sthānaṃ yratra devo janārdanaḥ .. 39 ..
16.111.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् ..
स प्राप्नोति परं स्थानं य्रत्र देवो जनार्दनः .. 39 ..
16.111.m: Whoever worships it with devotion, duly with fragrant paste, flowers, and the like, / reaches the highest abode where the god Janārdana resides.

16.111.s:
kimatra bahunoktena dvādaśyāṃ yatpradāpayet ..
na tatra parisaṃkhyānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate .. 7.1.111.40 ..
16.111.d:
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन द्वादश्यां यत्प्रदापयेत् ..
न तत्र परिसंख्यानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते .. 7.1.111.40 ..
16.111.m: What is the use of speaking much here? Whatever one gives on the twelfth lunar day, / there is no reckoning of it in the three worlds.

16.111.s:
śukrāṃgārakasaṃyuktā caturthī yā bhavetkvacit ..
ṣaṣṭhī vātra varārohe tatra śrāddhe mahatphalam .. 41 ..
16.111.d:
शुक्रांगारकसंयुक्ता चतुर्थी या भवेत्क्वचित् ..
षष्ठी वात्र वरारोहे तत्र श्राद्धे महत्फलम् .. 41 ..
16.111.m: Whenever there is a fourth lunar day conjoined with Friday or Tuesday, / or a sixth [lunar day] here, O fair-hipped woman, a śrāddha there bears great fruit.

16.111.s:
yāvaddvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ ..
tarpitā nānyamicchanti puṣkare svakulodbhave .. 42 ..
16.111.d:
यावद्द्वादशवर्षाणि पितरश्च पितामहाः ..
तर्पिता नान्यमिच्छन्ति पुष्करे स्वकुलोद्भवे .. 42 ..
16.111.m: For as long as twelve years, fathers and grandfathers, / satisfied at Puṣkara by one born in their own family, desire nothing else.

16.111.s:
tatra yo vājinaṃ dadyātsamyagbhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 43 ..
16.111.d:
तत्र यो वाजिनं दद्यात्सम्यग्भक्तिसमन्वितः ..
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 43 ..
16.111.m: A person who gives a horse there, endowed with perfect devotion, / obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.111.s:
iti te kathitaṃ samyaṅmāhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
rāmeśvarasya devasya puṣkarasya ca bhāmini .. 44 ..
16.111.d:
इति ते कथितं सम्यङ्माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
रामेश्वरस्य देवस्य पुष्करस्य च भामिनि .. 44 ..
16.111.m: Thus has been told to you fully the sin-destroying māhātmya / of the god Rāmeśvara and of Puṣkara, O lovely lady.

16.111.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkaramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 111 .. ..
16.111.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्करमाहात्म्ये रामेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 111 .. ..
16.111.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eleventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Rāmeśvara in the Māhātmya of Puṣkara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.112.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi lakṣmaṇeśvaramuttamam ..
rāmeśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam .. 1 ..
16.112.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लक्ष्मणेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
रामेशात्पूर्वदिग्भागे धनुस्त्रिंशकसंस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.112.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Lakṣmaṇeśvara, / situated thirty bow-lengths to the east of Rāmeśa.

16.112.s:
sthāpitaṃ lakṣmaṇenaiva tatra yātrāgatena vai ..
mahāpāpaharaṃ devi talliṃgaṃ surapūjitam .. 2 ..
16.112.d:
स्थापितं लक्ष्मणेनैव तत्र यात्रागतेन वै ..
महापापहरं देवि तल्लिंगं सुरपूजितम् .. 2 ..
16.112.m: It was installed indeed by Lakṣmaṇa when he had gone there on pilgrimage; / that liṅga, worshipped by the gods, removes great sin, O goddess.

16.112.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā nṛtyagītādivādanaiḥ ..
homajāpyaiḥ samādhisthaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 3 ..
16.112.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या नृत्यगीतादिवादनैः ..
होमजाप्यैः समाधिस्थः स याति परमां गतिम् .. 3 ..
16.112.m: Whoever worships it with devotion, with dances, songs, musical instruments, and the like, / with oblations and recitations, steady in concentration, goes to the supreme state.

16.112.s:
annodakaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tatra deyaṃ dvijātaye ..
saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt .. .. 4 ..
16.112.d:
अन्नोदकं हिरण्यं च तत्र देयं द्विजातये ..
संपूज्य देवदेवेशं गंधपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् .. .. 4 ..
16.112.m: Food, water, and gold should be given there to a twice-born, / having worshipped the god of the gods of gods duly with fragrant paste, flowers, and the like.

16.112.s:
māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ viśeṣastatra pūjane ..
snānaṃ dānaṃ japastatra bhavedakṣayakārakam .. 5 ..
16.112.d:
माघे कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां विशेषस्तत्र पूजने ..
स्नानं दानं जपस्तत्र भवेदक्षयकारकम् .. 5 ..
16.112.m: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, there is special merit in worship there; / ritual ablution, gifting, and recitation there become the cause of imperishable [merit].

16.112.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmye lakṣmaṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 112 ..
16.112.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रामेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये लक्ष्मणेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 112 ..
16.112.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twelfth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Lakṣmaṇeśvara in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Rāmeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.113.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi jānakīśvaramuttamam ..
rāmeśānnaiṛte bhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam .. 1 ..
16.113.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि जानकीश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
रामेशान्नैऋते भागे धनुस्त्रिंशकसंस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.113.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Jānakīśvara, / situated thirty bow-lengths to the southwest of Rāmeśa.

16.113.s:
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ jānakyā''rādhitaṃ purā ..
pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśeṣeṇa samyagārādhyaśaṃkaram .. 2 ..
16.113.d:
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां जानक्या'ऽराधितं पुरा ..
प्रतिष्ठितं विशेषेण सम्यगाराध्यशंकरम् .. 2 ..
16.113.m: It destroys the sin of all creatures; it was worshipped of old by Jānakī, / and especially established after she had properly propitiated Śaṃkara.

16.113.s:
pūrvaṃ tasyaiva liṃgasya vasiṣṭheśeti nāma vai ..
tatpaścājjānakīśeti tretāyāṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau .. 3 ..
16.113.d:
पूर्वं तस्यैव लिंगस्य वसिष्ठेशेति नाम वै ..
तत्पश्चाज्जानकीशेति त्रेतायां प्रथितं क्षितौ .. 3 ..
16.113.m: Previously, the name of that very liṅga was Vasiṣṭheśa; / afterwards, in the Tretāyuga, it became renowned on earth as Jānakīśa.

16.113.s:
tataḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ..
tatra siddhimanuprāptāstena siddheśvareti ca .. .. 4 ..
16.113.d:
ततः षष्टिसहस्राणि वालखिल्या महर्षयः ..
तत्र सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तास्तेन सिद्धेश्वरेति च .. .. 4 ..
16.113.m: Then sixty thousand great seers, the Vālakhilyas, / attained perfection there; therefore [it is also called] Siddheśvara.

16.113.s:
khyātaṃ kalau mahādevi yugaliṃgaṃ mahāprabham..
taddṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpairduḥkhadaurbhāgyasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.113.d:
ख्यातं कलौ महादेवि युगलिंगं महाप्रभम्..
तद्दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते पापैर्दुःखदौर्भाग्यसंभवैः .. 5 ..
16.113.m: It is renowned in the Kali age, O great goddess, as the liṅga of the ages, of great splendour; / upon seeing it, one is freed from sins arising from misery and misfortune.

16.113.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā ..
saṃsnāpya vidhivadbhaktyā sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 6 ..
16.113.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा ..
संस्नाप्य विधिवद्भक्त्या स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 6 ..
16.113.m: Whether a woman or a man, whoever worships it with devotion, / properly bathing it according to rule with devotion, becomes freed from sins.

16.113.s:
snātvā ca puṣkare tīrthe yastalligaṃ prapūjayet ..
niyato niyatāhāro māsamekaṃ nirantaram.. 7 ..
16.113.d:
स्नात्वा च पुष्करे तीर्थे यस्तल्लिगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
नियतो नियताहारो मासमेकं निरन्तरम्.. 7 ..
16.113.m: And having performed ritual ablution in the Puṣkara sacred ford, whoever worships that liṅga / self-controlled and regulated in diet for one full month continuously,

16.113.s:
dinedine bhavettasya vājimedhādhikaṃ phalam ..
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ yā nārī taṃ prapūjayet ..
tadanvaye'pi daurbhāgyaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaśca no bhavet .. 8 ..
16.113.d:
दिनेदिने भवेत्तस्य वाजिमेधाधिकं फलम् ..
माघे मासि तृतीयायां या नारी तं प्रपूजयेत् ..
तदन्वयेऽपि दौर्भाग्यं दुःखं शोकश्च नो भवेत् .. 8 ..
16.113.m: day by day for him there is fruit greater than an horse sacrifice. / The woman who worships it on the third day in the month of Māgha, / in her lineage too there shall be no misfortune, misery, or sorrow.

16.113.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni saubhāgyaṃ saṃprayacchati .. 9 ..
16.113.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि सौभाग्यं संप्रयच्छति .. 9 ..
16.113.m: Thus has been told to you, O goddess, the sin-destroying māhātmya; / when heard, it removes sins and bestows good fortune.

16.113.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jānakīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 113 ..
16.113.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जानकीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 113 ..
16.113.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Jānakīśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.114.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi viṣṇuṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
vāmanasvāmināmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.114.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विष्णुं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
वामनस्वामिनामानं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.114.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Viṣṇu, the destroyer of sins, / named Vāmanasvāmin, the destroyer of all wicked deeds,

16.114.s:
puṣkarānnairṛte bhāge dhanurviśatibhiḥ smṛtam ..
yadā baddho balirdevi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 2 ..
16.114.d:
पुष्करान्नैरृते भागे धनुर्विशतिभिः स्मृतम् ..
यदा बद्धो बलिर्देवि विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .. 2 ..
16.114.m: recorded as twenty bow-lengths to the southwest of Puṣkara. / When Bali was bound, O goddess, by the all-powerful Viṣṇu,

16.114.s:
tadā tatra padaṃ nyastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ viśvarūpiṇā ..
dvitīyaṃ meruśṛṃge tu tṛtīyaṃ gagane priye .. 3 ..
16.114.d:
तदा तत्र पदं न्यस्तं दक्षिणं विश्वरूपिणा ..
द्वितीयं मेरुशृंगे तु तृतीयं गगने प्रिये .. 3 ..
16.114.m: at that time his right foot was placed there by him whose form is the universe; / the second on the peak of Meru, and the third in the sky, O beloved.

16.114.s:
yāvadūrdhvaṃ cotkṣipati tāvadbhinnaṃ sudūrataḥ ..
pādāgreṇa tu brahmāṇḍaṃ niṣkrāntaṃ salilaṃ tataḥ .. 4 ..
16.114.d:
यावदूर्ध्वं चोत्क्षिपति तावद्भिन्नं सुदूरतः ..
पादाग्रेण तु ब्रह्माण्डं निष्क्रान्तं सलिलं ततः .. 4 ..
16.114.m: As far upwards as he cast it, that far the cosmic egg was pierced from a great distance / by the tip of his foot, and water gushed forth from it.

16.114.s:
tataḥ svajānumātreṇa saṃprāptaṃ pṛthivītale ..
tato viṣṇupadī gaṃgā prasiddhimagamatkṣitau .. 5 ..
16.114.d:
ततः स्वजानुमात्रेण संप्राप्तं पृथिवीतले ..
ततो विष्णुपदी गंगा प्रसिद्धिमगमत्क्षितौ .. 5 ..
16.114.m: Then, rising just to his own knees, it reached the surface of the earth; / thence the Gaṅgā, flowing from Viṣṇu's foot, attained fame on earth.

16.114.s:
pūrvaṃ sā puṣkare prāptā puṣkarātsā mahānadī ..
puṣkaraṃ kathyate vyoma puṣkaraṃ kathyate jalam ..
tena tatpuṣkaraṃ khyātaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ prajāpateḥ .. 6 ..
16.114.d:
पूर्वं सा पुष्करे प्राप्ता पुष्करात्सा महानदी ..
पुष्करं कथ्यते व्योम पुष्करं कथ्यते जलम् ..
तेन तत्पुष्करं ख्यातं संनिधानं प्रजापतेः .. 6 ..
16.114.m: First it reached Puṣkara; from Puṣkara [flowed] that great river. / The sky is called 'puṣkara', water is called 'puṣkara'; / therefore it is known as Puṣkara, the dwelling place of Prajāpati.

16.114.s:
tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaḥ paśyati hareḥ padam ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam .. 7 ..
16.114.d:
तत्र स्नानं नरः कृत्वा यः पश्यति हरेः पदम् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् .. 7 ..
16.114.m: Having performed ritual ablution there, the person who sees the foot of Hari / goes to the supreme abode where the god Hari is himself.

16.114.s:
tatra piṃḍapradānena tṛptiḥ syātkoṭivārṣikī ..
pitṝṇāṃ ca varārohe hyetadāha hariḥ svayam .. 8 ..
16.114.d:
तत्र पिंडप्रदानेन तृप्तिः स्यात्कोटिवार्षिकी ..
पितॄणां च वरारोहे ह्येतदाह हरिः स्वयम् .. 8 ..
16.114.m: By offering a funeral cake there, satisfaction lasts for ten million years / for the ancestors, O fair-hipped lady; indeed, Hari himself said this.

16.114.s:
atra gāthā purā gītā vasiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā ..
vāmanasvāminaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitā .. 9 ..
16.114.d:
अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता वसिष्ठेन महर्षिणा ..
वामनस्वामिनं दृष्ट्वा तां शृणुष्व समाहिता .. 9 ..
16.114.m: Here a verse was sung of old by the great seer Vasiṣṭha / upon seeing Vāmanasvāmin; listen to it with an attentive mind:

16.114.s:
snātvā tu puṣkare tīrthe dṛṣṭvā viṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ ..
api kṛtvā mahatpāpaṃ kimataḥ paritapyate .. 7.1.114.10 ..
16.114.d:
स्नात्वा तु पुष्करे तीर्थे दृष्ट्वा विष्णुपदं ततः ..
अपि कृत्वा महत्पापं किमतः परितप्यते .. 7.1.114.10 ..
16.114.m: 'Having performed ritual ablution in the Puṣkara sacred ford and then seen Viṣṇu's foot, / even having committed great sin, why should one grieve further?'

16.114.s:
yastatropānahau dadyādbrāhmaṇāya yatavrataḥ ..
sa yānavaramārūḍho viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 11 ..
16.114.d:
यस्तत्रोपानहौ दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय यतव्रतः ..
स यानवरमारूढो विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 11 ..
16.114.m: Whoever, restrained in vows, gives a pair of sandals to a brahmin there, / mounted on an excellent aerial vehicle, is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu.

16.114.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye vāmanasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 114 ..
16.114.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये वामनस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 114 ..
16.114.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vāmanasvāmin', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.115.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkareśvaramuttamam ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge jānakīśvaramuttamam .. 1 ..
16.115.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुष्करेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे जानकीश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
16.115.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Puṣkareśvara; / to the south of it is the supreme Jānakīśvara.

16.115.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu brahmaputreṇa pūjitam ..
sanatkumāramuninā śraddhayā hema puṣkaraiḥ .. 2 ..
16.115.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु ब्रह्मपुत्रेण पूजितम् ..
सनत्कुमारमुनिना श्रद्धया हेम पुष्करैः .. 2 ..
16.115.m: The liṅga is indeed of great efficacy, worshipped by the son of Brahmā, / the sage Sanatkumāra, with devotion and golden lotuses.

16.115.s:
pūjitaṃ tadvidhānena tena tatpuṣkareśvaram ..
khyātaṃ tatra varārohe sarvapātakanāśanam .. 3 ..
16.115.d:
पूजितं तद्विधानेन तेन तत्पुष्करेश्वरम् ..
ख्यातं तत्र वरारोहे सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 3 ..
16.115.m: It was worshipped according to the ritual for it; therefore it is known there as Puṣkareśvara, / O fair-hipped lady, destroying all wicked deeds.

16.115.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃṣapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
yātrā kṛtā bhavettena pauṣkarī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
16.115.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या गंषपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् ..
यात्रा कृता भवेत्तेन पौष्करी नात्र संशयः .. 4 ..
16.115.m: Whoever worships it with devotion in proper sequence, with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / by him the pilgrimage to Puṣkara has indeed been performed; of this there is no doubt.

16.115.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vāmanasvāmimāhātmye puṣkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 115 ..
16.115.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वामनस्वामिमाहात्म्ये पुष्करेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 115 ..
16.115.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Puṣkareśvara' in the Glory of Vāmanasvāmin, in the first [part], the Glory of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.116.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ saubhāgyakāriṇīm ..
kuṇḍeśvarīti vikhyātāṃ puṣkarādvāyugocare .. 1 ..
16.116.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीं सौभाग्यकारिणीम् ..
कुण्डेश्वरीति विख्यातां पुष्कराद्वायुगोचरे .. 1 ..
16.116.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the goddess who brings good fortune, / renowned as Kuṇḍeśvarī, in the north-west direction from Puṣkara,

16.116.s:
dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi bhūtanāthācca nairṛte ..
saṃsthitā pāpadamanī dāridryaughavināśinī .. 2 ..
16.116.d:
धनुषां त्रिंशता देवि भूतनाथाच्च नैरृते ..
संस्थिता पापदमनी दारिद्र्यौघविनाशिनी .. 2 ..
16.116.m: at a distance of thirty bows, O goddess, and south-west of Bhūtanātha; / she who subdues sins and destroys streams of poverty is situated there.

16.116.s:
tasyā nairṛtadigbhāge dhanuḥpañcadaśe sthitam ..
śaṃkhodakaṃnāma kuṇḍaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 3 ..
16.116.d:
तस्या नैरृतदिग्भागे धनुःपञ्चदशे स्थितम् ..
शंखोदकंनाम कुण्डं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 3 ..
16.116.m: In her south-western direction, situated at fifteen bows, / is the pool named Śaṅkhodaka, which destroys all sins.

16.116.s:
tatra snātvā tu ye martyā nārī vā śubhavāriṇi ..
pūjayettāṃ mahādevi śaṃkhāvarteti viśrutām .. 4 ..
16.116.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु ये मर्त्या नारी वा शुभवारिणि ..
पूजयेत्तां महादेवि शंखावर्तेति विश्रुताम् .. 4 ..
16.116.m: Having bathed there in the auspicious water, mortal men or a woman / should worship her, celebrated as Śaṅkhāvartā, O great goddess.

16.116.s:
kalau kuṇḍeśvarīnāma sarvasaukhyapradāyinī ..
śaṃkho nāma purā devi viṣṇunā nihataḥ priye .. 5 ..
16.116.d:
कलौ कुण्डेश्वरीनाम सर्वसौख्यप्रदायिनी ..
शंखो नाम पुरा देवि विष्णुना निहतः प्रिये .. 5 ..
16.116.m: In the Kali age she is named Kuṇḍeśvarī, granting all happiness. / Formerly, O beloved goddess, [an Asura] named Śaṅkha was slain by Viṣṇu.

16.116.s:
tasya dehaṃ samādāya mahāntaṃ śaṃkharūpiṇam ..
tīrthodakena saṃpūrya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ .. 6 ..
16.116.d:
तस्य देहं समादाय महान्तं शंखरूपिणम् ..
तीर्थोदकेन संपूर्य प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः .. 6 ..
16.116.m: Taking his huge body shaped like a conch, / and filling it with sacred water, he came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.116.s:
tatra śaṃkhaṃ tu prakṣālya kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham ..
tatra pūritavāñchaṅkhaṃ meghagambhīranisvanam ..7 ..
16.116.d:
तत्र शंखं तु प्रक्षाल्य कृतं तीर्थं महाप्रभम् ..
तत्र पूरितवाञ्छङ्खं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनम् ..7 ..
16.116.m: There he washed the conch and made a sacred ford of great brilliance; / there he blew the conch, which had a sound deep like thunderclouds.

16.116.s:
tasya nādena mahatā devī tatra samāgatā ..
pṛcchatī kāraṇaṃ tatra tatkuṇḍasya samīpagā ..
tena kuṇḍeśvarī khyātā kuṇḍaṃ śaṃkhodakaṃ smṛtam .. 8 ..
16.116.d:
तस्य नादेन महता देवी तत्र समागता ..
पृच्छती कारणं तत्र तत्कुण्डस्य समीपगा ..
तेन कुण्डेश्वरी ख्याता कुण्डं शंखोदकं स्मृतम् .. 8 ..
16.116.m: At that great roar, the goddess came there / inquiring after the cause, coming near that pool. / Therefore she is celebrated as Kuṇḍeśvarī, and the pool is recorded as Śaṅkhodaka.

16.116.s:
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
nārī vā bhaktisaṃyuktā sa gaurīpadamāpnuyāt .. 9 ..
16.116.d:
माघे मासि तृतीयायां यस्तां पूजयते नरः ..
नारी वा भक्तिसंयुक्ता स गौरीपदमाप्नुयात् .. 9 ..
16.116.m: The man who worships her on the third lunar day in the month of Māgha, / or a woman endowed with devotion, reaches the station of Gaurī.

16.116.s:
daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ tatra deyaṃ yātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..
kañcukaṃ phaladānaṃ ca gauriṇīnāṃ ca bhojanam .. 7.1.116.10 ..
16.116.d:
दंपत्योर्भोजनं तत्र देयं यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..
कञ्चुकं फलदानं च गौरिणीनां च भोजनम् .. 7.1.116.10 ..
16.116.m: There a meal should be offered to a married couple by those desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage, / along with the gift of a bodice and fruit, and a meal for married women.

16.116.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhodakakuṇḍeśvarīgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 116 .. ..
16.116.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शंखोदककुण्डेश्वरीगौरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 116 .. ..
16.116.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Śaṅkhodaka and Kuṇḍeśvarī-Gaurī', in the first [part], the Glory of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.117.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bhūtanātheśvaraṃ haram..
kuṇḍeśvaryā īśabhāge dhanuṣāṃ viṃśake'ntare .. 1 ..
16.117.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि भूतनाथेश्वरं हरम्..
कुण्डेश्वर्या ईशभागे धनुषां विंशकेऽन्तरे .. 1 ..
16.117.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Hara, the lord of Bhūtanātha, / in the north-east direction of Kuṇḍeśvarī, at an interval of twenty bows.

16.117.s:
kalpaliṃgaṃ mahādevi hyanādinidhanaṃ sthitam ..
pūrvaṃ tretāyuge devi vīrabhadreśvarīti ca .. 2 ..
16.117.d:
कल्पलिंगं महादेवि ह्यनादिनिधनं स्थितम् ..
पूर्वं त्रेतायुगे देवि वीरभद्रेश्वरीति च .. 2 ..
16.117.m: O great goddess, this is a liṅga of a cosmic age, standing without beginning or end. / Formerly, in the Tretā age, O goddess, it was known as Vīrabhadreśvara,

16.117.s:
prakhyātaṃ bhuvi deveśi kalau bhūteśvaraṃ smṛtam ..
purā dvāparasaṃdhau ca tatra bhūtāni koṭiśaḥ ..3..
16.117.d:
प्रख्यातं भुवि देवेशि कलौ भूतेश्वरं स्मृतम् ..
पुरा द्वापरसंधौ च तत्र भूतानि कोटिशः ..3..
16.117.m: renowned on earth, O ruler of gods, and in the Kali age it is recorded as Bhūteśvara. / Anciently, at the junction of the Dvāpara age, millions of spirits there

16.117.s:
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ jagmustalliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ ..
tena bhūteśvaraṃ nāma prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale.. .. 4 ..
16.117.d:
संसिद्धिं परमां जग्मुस्तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावतः ..
तेन भूतेश्वरं नाम प्रख्यातं धरणीतले.. .. 4 ..
16.117.m: attained supreme perfection through the power of that liṅga. / Therefore it became celebrated on the surface of the earth by the name Bhūteśvara.

16.117.s:
tatra kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ rātrau saṃpūjya śaṃkaram ..
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritya aghoraṃ pūjayettu yaḥ .. 5 ..
16.117.d:
तत्र कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां रात्रौ संपूज्य शंकरम् ..
दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रित्य अघोरं पूजयेत्तु यः .. 5 ..
16.117.m: Having worshipped Śaṃkara there at night on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / whoever turns toward the southern direction and worships Aghora,

16.117.s:
dṛḍhaṃ jitendriyo bhūtvā nirbhayo dhyānasaṃyu taḥ ..
tasyaiva jāyate siddhiryā kācidbhūtale sthitā .. 6 ..
16.117.d:
दृढं जितेन्द्रियो भूत्वा निर्भयो ध्यानसंयु तः ..
तस्यैव जायते सिद्धिर्या काचिद्भूतले स्थिता .. 6 ..
16.117.m: being firmly self-controlled, fearless, and absorbed in meditation, / to him alone belongs whatever perfection exists on the face of the earth.

16.117.s:
tilahemapradānaṃ ca piṇḍadānaṃ ca tatra vai ..
pitṝnuddiśya dadyādvai teṣāṃ pretatvamuktaye .. .. 7 ..
16.117.d:
तिलहेमप्रदानं च पिण्डदानं च तत्र वै ..
पितॄनुद्दिश्य दद्याद्वै तेषां प्रेतत्वमुक्तये .. .. 7 ..
16.117.m: A gift of sesame seeds and gold, as well as an offering of rice balls, / one should indeed make there dedicated to the ancestors, for their release from the state of ghosts.

16.117.s:
iti nigaditametadbhūtanātheśvarasya pracurakalimalānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyahetuḥ ..
paṭhati ca puruṣo vā yaḥ śṛṇotīha bhaktyā suravaramahimānaṃ mucyate pātakaughaiḥ .. 8 ..
16.117.d:
इति निगदितमेतद्भूतनाथेश्वरस्य प्रचुरकलिमलानां नाशनं पुण्यहेतुः ..
पठति च पुरुषो वा यः शृणोतीह भक्त्या सुरवरमहिमानं मुच्यते पातकौघैः .. 8 ..
16.117.m: Thus has this [glory] of Bhūtanātheśvara been related, which destroys abundant impurities of the Kali age and causes merit. / Whatever man recites it, or whoever hears with devotion this greatness of the best of gods, is freed from masses of sins.

16.117.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuṃḍeśvarī māhātmye bhūtanātheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 117 ..
16.117.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुंडेश्वरी माहात्म्ये भूतनाथेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 117 ..
16.117.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Bhūtanātheśvara' in the Glory of Kuṇḍeśvarī, in the first [part], the Glory of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.118.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gopyādityamanuttamam ..
bhūteśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ triṃśakentare .. 1 ..
16.118.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गोप्यादित्यमनुत्तमम् ..
भूतेशाद्वायवे भागे धनुषां त्रिंशकेन्तरे .. 1 ..
16.118.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unexcelled Gopyāditya, / in the north-west direction from Bhūteśa, at an interval of thirty bows.

16.118.s:
balātibaladaityaghnyā dakṣiṇāgneyasaṃsthitam ..
dhanuṣāṃ daśake devi saṃsthitaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.118.d:
बलातिबलदैत्यघ्न्या दक्षिणाग्नेयसंस्थितम् ..
धनुषां दशके देवि संस्थितं पापनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.118.m: Situated in the south-east of the slayer of the Daityas Bala and Atibala, / at [a distance of] ten bows, O goddess, it stands destroying sins.

16.118.s:
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāpāpaharāṃ śubhām ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā duḥkhaśokaiḥ pramucyate .. 3 ..
16.118.d:
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि महापापहरां शुभाम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या दुःखशोकैः प्रमुच्यते .. 3 ..
16.118.m: I shall relate its auspicious origin, which takes away great sins, / hearing which with devotion a mortal is freed from sorrows and grief.

16.118.s:
purā kṛṣṇo mahātejā yadā prabhāsamāgataḥ ..
sahito yādavaiḥ sarvaiḥ ṣaṭpañcāśatikoṭibhiḥ .. 4 ..
16.118.d:
पुरा कृष्णो महातेजा यदा प्रभासमागतः ..
सहितो यादवैः सर्वैः षट्पञ्चाशतिकोटिभिः .. 4 ..
16.118.m: Formerly, when Kṛṣṇa of great splendour came to Prabhāsa / accompanied by all the Yādavas, fifty-six crores [in number],

16.118.s:
ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi gopyastatra samāgatāḥ ..
lakṣamekaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭirete kṛṣṇasutāḥ priye .. 5 ..
16.118.d:
षोडशैव सहस्राणि गोप्यस्तत्र समागताः ..
लक्षमेकं तथा षष्टिरेते कृष्णसुताः प्रिये .. 5 ..
16.118.m: sixteen thousand cowherd women (gopīs) came there, / and one hundred and sixty thousand sons of Kṛṣṇa, O beloved.

16.118.s:
tatra prābhāsike kṣetre saṃsthitāḥ pāpanāśane ..
yādavasthalamāsādya yāvadraivatako giri .. 6 ..
16.118.d:
तत्र प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे संस्थिताः पापनाशने ..
यादवस्थलमासाद्य यावद्रैवतको गिरि .. 6 ..
16.118.m: They settled there in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, which destroys sins, / occupying the Yādavasthala as far as the Raivataka mountain.

16.118.s:
tatra dvādaśavarṣāṇi saṃsthitāste mahābalāḥ ..
kṣetraṃ pavitramādāya śivaliṃgāni te pṛthak ..
sthāpayāñcakrire sarve hyaṃkitāni svanāmabhiḥ .. 7 ..
16.118.d:
तत्र द्वादशवर्षाणि संस्थितास्ते महाबलाः ..
क्षेत्रं पवित्रमादाय शिवलिंगानि ते पृथक् ..
स्थापयाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वे ह्यंकितानि स्वनामभिः .. 7 ..
16.118.m: Those men of great might stayed there for twelve years. / Taking up the holy sacred field, they all individually installed / Śivaliṅgas marked with their own names.

16.118.s:
evaṃ samagraṃ tatkṣetraṃ yāvaddvādaśayojanam ..
dhvajaliṃgāṃkitaṃ cakruḥ sarve yādavapuṃgavāḥ .. 8 ..
16.118.d:
एवं समग्रं तत्क्षेत्रं यावद्द्वादशयोजनम् ..
ध्वजलिंगांकितं चक्रुः सर्वे यादवपुंगवाः .. 8 ..
16.118.m: Thus all the foremost of the Yādavas covered that entire sacred field, / extending for twelve yojanas, with banner-bearing liṅgas.

16.118.s:
hastahastāntare devi prāsādāḥ kṣetra madhyataḥ ..
suvarṇakalaśopetāḥ patākākulitāṃbarāḥ ..
virājaṃte tu tatrasthāḥ kīrtistaṃbhā hareriva .. 9 ..
16.118.d:
हस्तहस्तान्तरे देवि प्रासादाः क्षेत्र मध्यतः ..
