सुवर्णकलशोपेताः पताकाकुलितांबराः ..
विराजंते तु तत्रस्थाः कीर्तिस्तंभा हरेरिव .. 9 ..
16.118.m: O goddess, at intervals of one cubit across the middle of the sacred field, temples / endowed with golden pinnacles and filling the sky with flags / shone forth standing there like pillars of fame of Hari.

16.118.s:
tato gopyo mahādevi ādyā yāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ ..
tāsāṃ nāmāni te vakṣye tāni hmekamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 7.1.118.10 ..
16.118.d:
ततो गोप्यो महादेवि आद्या याः षोडश स्मृताः ..
तासां नामानि ते वक्ष्ये तानि ह्मेकमनाः शृणु .. 7.1.118.10 ..
16.118.m: Then, O great goddess, the cowherd women who are remembered as the foremost sixteen— / I shall tell you their names; hear them with a one-pointed mind:

16.118.s:
laṃbinī candrikā kāntā krūrā śāntā mahodayā ..
bhīṣaṇī nandinī'śokā suparṇā vimalā'kṣayā .. 11 ..
16.118.d:
लंबिनी चन्द्रिका कान्ता क्रूरा शान्ता महोदया ..
भीषणी नन्दिनीऽशोका सुपर्णा विमलाऽक्षया .. 11 ..
16.118.m: Lambinī, Candrikā, Kāntā, Krūrā, Śāntā, Mahodayā, / Bhīṣaṇī, Nandinī, Aśokā, Suparṇā, Vimalā, Akṣayā,

16.118.s:
śubhadā śobhanā puṇyā haṃsasyaitāḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
haṃsa eva mataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā janārdanaḥ .. 12 ..
16.118.d:
शुभदा शोभना पुण्या हंसस्यैताः कलाः स्मृताः ..
हंस एव मतः कृष्णः परमात्मा जनार्दनः .. 12 ..
16.118.m: Śubhadā, Śobhanā, Puṇyā—these are remembered as the digits of the Swan (Haṃsa). / The Swan indeed is considered to be Kṛṣṇa, Janārdana, the Supreme Self.

16.118.s:
tasyaitāḥ śaktayo devi ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ ..
candrarūpī tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kalārūpāstu tāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 13 ..
16.118.d:
तस्यैताः शक्तयो देवि षोडशैव प्रकीर्तिताः ..
चन्द्ररूपी ततः कृष्णः कलारूपास्तु ताः स्मृताः .. 13 ..
16.118.m: These are proclaimed as his sixteen powers (śaktis), O goddess; / therefore Kṛṣṇa has the form of the moon, while they are remembered as having the forms of its digits.

16.118.s:
saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalā tāsāṃ mālinī ṣoḍaśī kalā ..
pratipattithimārabhya vicaratyāsu candramāḥ .. 14 ..
16.118.d:
संपूर्णमण्डला तासां मालिनी षोडशी कला ..
प्रतिपत्तिथिमारभ्य विचरत्यासु चन्द्रमाः .. 14 ..
16.118.m: The sixteenth digit among them is Mālinī, forming the full disc. / Beginning from the first lunar day (pratipad), the moon moves through these.

16.118.s:
ṣoḍaśaiva kalā yāstā gopīrūpā varānane ..
ekaikaśastāḥ saṃbhinnāḥ sahasreṇa pṛthakpṛthak .. 15 ..
16.118.d:
षोडशैव कला यास्ता गोपीरूपा वरानने ..
एकैकशस्ताः संभिन्नाः सहस्रेण पृथक्पृथक् .. 15 ..
16.118.m: Those sixteen digits that took the form of cowherd women, O fair-faced one, / were each separately multiplied by a thousand.

16.118.s:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ jñānasaṃbhavam ..
evaṃ yo veda puruṣaḥ sa jñeyo vaiṣṇavo budhaiḥ .. 16 ..
16.118.d:
एवं ते कथितं देवि रहस्यं ज्ञानसंभवम् ..
एवं यो वेद पुरुषः स ज्ञेयो वैष्णवो बुधैः .. 16 ..
16.118.m: Thus has the secret born of wisdom been told to you, O goddess. / The man who understands it thus is to be known as a Vaiṣṇava by the wise.

16.118.s:
atha tābhiḥ kṛtāñjñātvā prāsādānyādavaiḥ pṛthak ..
tato gopyo'pi tāḥ sarvāḥ sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa ..
kṛṣṇamājñāpya bhāvena sthāpayāṃcakrire ravim .. 17 ..
16.118.d:
अथ ताभिः कृताञ्ज्ञात्वा प्रासादान्यादवैः पृथक् ..
ततो गोप्योऽपि ताः सर्वाः सहस्राणि तु षोडश ..
कृष्णमाज्ञाप्य भावेन स्थापयांचक्रिरे रविम् .. 17 ..
16.118.m: Then, learning that separate temples had been built by the Yādavas, / all those gopīs too, sixteen thousand [in number], / having obtained Kṛṣṇa's permission, established the Sun with devotion. // 17

16.118.s:
ṛṣibhirnāradādyaistāstathā kṣetranivāsibhiḥ ..
taṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsuḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhinā ravim .. 18 ..
16.118.d:
ऋषिभिर्नारदाद्यैस्तास्तथा क्षेत्रनिवासिभिः ..
तं प्रतिष्ठापयामासुः प्रतिष्ठाविधिना रविम् .. 18 ..
16.118.m: Together with the ṛṣis headed by Nārada and the inhabitants of the sacred field, / they installed that Sun according to the rules of consecration. // 18

16.118.s:
pratiṣṭhite tataḥ sūrye dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ..
tataḥ kṣetranivāsibhyo gobhūhemāṃbarāṇi ca .. 19 ..
16.118.d:
प्रतिष्ठिते ततः सूर्ये ददुर्दानानि भूरिशः ..
ततः क्षेत्रनिवासिभ्यो गोभूहेमांबराणि च .. 19 ..
16.118.m: When the Sun was consecrated, they gave lavish gifts / of cows, land, gold, and garments to the residents of the sacred field. // 19

16.118.s:
tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
cakrurnāma ravestatra gopyādityeti viśrutam..
sarvapāpa haraṃ devaṃ mahāsaubhāgyadāyakam .. 7.1.118.20 ..
16.118.d:
ततस्त ऋषयः सर्वे संतुष्टा हृष्टमानसाः ..
चक्रुर्नाम रवेस्तत्र गोप्यादित्येति विश्रुतम्..
सर्वपाप हरं देवं महासौभाग्यदायकम् .. 7.1.118.20 ..
16.118.m: Then all those ṛṣis, pleased and delighted at heart, / gave the Sun there the renowned name of Gopyāditya, / the god who removes all sin and bestows great good fortune. // 20

16.118.s:
evaṃ kṛte kṛtārthāstāḥ saṃprāpyātimahadyaśaḥ ..
jagmuryathāgataṃ sarvā dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutāḥ .. 21 ..
16.118.d:
एवं कृते कृतार्थास्ताः संप्राप्यातिमहद्यशः ..
जग्मुर्यथागतं सर्वा द्वारकां कृष्णसंयुताः .. 21 ..
16.118.m: Having done this, their purpose achieved and having attained great renown, / all [of them] returned to Dvārakā with Kṛṣṇa just as they had come. // 21

16.118.s:
punaḥ kālāntare devi śāpāddurvāsasaḥ priye ..
yādavasthalatāṃ prāptāḥ prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 22 ..
16.118.d:
पुनः कालान्तरे देवि शापाद्दुर्वाससः प्रिये ..
यादवस्थलतां प्राप्ताः प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 22 ..
16.118.m: Again, after a lapse of time, O goddess, beloved, by the curse of Durvāsas, / they came to the place of the Yādavas in Prabhāsa, which destroys sin. // 22

16.118.s:
evaṃ te kathito devi gopyādityasamudbhavaḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ tasya te vacmi pūjāvandanajaṃ kramāt .. 23 ..
16.118.d:
एवं ते कथितो देवि गोप्यादित्यसमुद्भवः ..
माहात्म्यं तस्य ते वच्मि पूजावन्दनजं क्रमात् .. 23 ..
16.118.m: Thus has the origin of Gopyāditya been told to you, O goddess; / I shall now declare to you in sequence its māhātmya arising from worship and obeisance. // 23

16.118.s:
asminmitravane devi yo gopībhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
tasya darśanamātreṇa duḥkhaśokaiḥ pramucyate .. 24 ..
16.118.d:
अस्मिन्मित्रवने देवि यो गोपीभिः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण दुःखशोकैः प्रमुच्यते .. 24 ..
16.118.m: O goddess, he who was consecrated by the gopīs in this Mitravana— / by the mere darśana of him, one is freed from grief and sorrow. // 24

16.118.s:
sutapteneha tapasā yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ ..
tāṃ gatiṃ te narā yānti ye gopīravimāśritāḥ .. 25 ..
16.118.d:
सुतप्तेनेह तपसा यज्ञैर्वा बहुदक्षिणैः ..
तां गतिं ते नरा यान्ति ये गोपीरविमाश्रिताः .. 25 ..
16.118.m: Those men who take refuge in the Sun of the gopīs / attain that destination [reached] by austerity well performed here or by sacrifices with lavish priestly gifts. // 25

16.118.s:
yena sarvātmanā bhāvo gopyāditye niveśitaḥ ..
maheśvari kṛtārthatvātsa ślāghyo dhanya eva saḥ .. 26 ..
16.118.d:
येन सर्वात्मना भावो गोप्यादित्ये निवेशितः ..
महेश्वरि कृतार्थत्वात्स श्लाघ्यो धन्य एव सः .. 26 ..
16.118.m: The one whose devotion is directed whole-heartedly to Gopyāditya / is praiseworthy and truly blessed, O Maheśvarī, having achieved his goal. // 26

16.118.s:
api naḥ sa kule dhanyo jāyate kulapāvanaḥ ..
bhāgyavānbhaktibhāvena yena bhānurupāsitaḥ .. 27 ..
16.118.d:
अपि नः स कुले धन्यो जायते कुलपावनः ..
भाग्यवान्भक्तिभावेन येन भानुरुपासितः .. 27 ..
16.118.m: A blessed man who purifies his family is born even in our family, / fortunate is he by whom the Sun has been worshipped with devotion. // 27

16.118.s:
saptamyāṃ pūjayedyastu māghe māsyuṣasi priye ..
saptāvarānsapta pūrvānpitṝnsopyuddharennaraḥ .. 28 ..
16.118.d:
सप्तम्यां पूजयेद्यस्तु माघे मास्युषसि प्रिये ..
सप्तावरान्सप्त पूर्वान्पितॄन्सोप्युद्धरेन्नरः .. 28 ..
16.118.m: A man who worships [him] at dawn on the seventh day in the month of Māgha, O beloved, / delivers seven ancestors and seven descendants. // 28

16.118.s: chinatti rogānduśceṣṭāndurjayāñjayati hyarīn .. 29 ..
16.118.d: छिनत्ति रोगान्दुश्चेष्टान्दुर्जयाञ्जयति ह्यरीन् .. 29 ..
16.118.m: He destroys diseases and wicked deeds, and conquers enemies difficult to overcome. // 29

16.118.s:
na saptamyāṃ spṛśettailaṃ nīlavastraṃ na dhārayet ..
na cāpyāmalakaiḥ snānaṃ na kuryātkalahaṃ kvacit .. 7.1.118.30 ..
16.118.d:
न सप्तम्यां स्पृशेत्तैलं नीलवस्त्रं न धारयेत् ..
न चाप्यामलकैः स्नानं न कुर्यात्कलहं क्वचित् .. 7.1.118.30 ..
16.118.m: On the seventh day, one should not touch oil, nor wear blue cloth, / nor bathe with myrobalan fruits, nor quarrel anywhere. // 30

16.118.s:
nīlaraktena vastreṇa yatkarma kurute dvijaḥ ..
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam ..
vṛthā tasya mahāyajñā nīlasūtrasya dhāraṇāt .. 31 ..
16.118.d:
नीलरक्तेन वस्त्रेण यत्कर्म कुरुते द्विजः ..
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायः पितृतर्पणम् ..
वृथा तस्य महायज्ञा नीलसूत्रस्य धारणात् .. 31 ..
16.118.m: Whatever rite a twice-born performs wearing a garment dyed blue— / ritual ablution, gifts, recitation of mantras, oblations, study of the Veda, offerings to the ancestors— / his great sacrifices are in vain, because of wearing indigo thread. // 31

16.118.s:
nīlīraktaṃ yadā vastraṃ viprastvaṃgeṣu dhārayet ..
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati .. 32 ..
16.118.d:
नीलीरक्तं यदा वस्त्रं विप्रस्त्वंगेषु धारयेत् ..
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति .. 32 ..
16.118.m: When a brahmin wears a cloth dyed with indigo upon his limbs, / he becomes purified by [consuming] the five products of the cow after fasting for a day and night. // 32

16.118.s:
romakūpe yadā gacchedrasaṃ nīlasya kasyacit ..
patitastu bhavedviprastribhiḥ kṛcchrairvyapohati .. 33 ..
16.118.d:
रोमकूपे यदा गच्छेद्रसं नीलस्य कस्यचित् ..
पतितस्तु भवेद्विप्रस्त्रिभिः कृच्छ्रैर्व्यपोहति .. 33 ..
16.118.m: If the juice of indigo enters anyone's hair follicle, / that brahmin becomes fallen, [and] purifies [himself] with three kṛcchra penances. // 33

16.118.s:
nīlamadhyaṃ yadā gacchetpramādādbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit ..
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati .. 34 ..
16.118.d:
नीलमध्यं यदा गच्छेत्प्रमादाद्ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् ..
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति .. 34 ..
16.118.m: If a brahmin inadvertently enters an indigo plantation anywhere, / he becomes purified by [consuming] the five products of the cow after fasting for a day and night. // 34

16.118.s:
nīladāru yadā bhidyedbrāhmaṇānāṃ śarīrake ..
śoṇitaṃ dṛśyate tatra dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 35 ..
16.118.d:
नीलदारु यदा भिद्येद्ब्राह्मणानां शरीरके ..
शोणितं दृश्यते तत्र द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत् .. 35 ..
16.118.m: If the indigo plant pierces the body of brahmins / and blood is seen there, the twice-born must perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance. // 35

16.118.s:
kuryādajñānato yastu nīlaṃ vai dantadhāvanam ..
kṛtvā kṛcchradvayaṃ tasya śuddhiruktā manīṣibhiḥ .. 36 ..
16.118.d:
कुर्यादज्ञानतो यस्तु नीलं वै दन्तधावनम् ..
कृत्वा कृच्छ्रद्वयं तस्य शुद्धिरुक्ता मनीषिभिः .. 36 ..
16.118.m: Whoever unknowingly cleans his teeth with an indigo twig, / the wise have declared that he is purified after performing two kṛcchra penances. // 36

16.118.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi gopyādityamahodaya ..
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam .. .. 37 ..
16.118.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि गोप्यादित्यमहोदय ..
पापघ्नं सर्वजन्तूनां श्रुतं सर्वार्थसाधकम् .. .. 37 ..
16.118.m: Thus, O goddess, the great glory of Gopyāditya has been related, / which destroys sins of all creatures and, when heard, accomplishes all desires. // 37

16.118.s:
gavāṃ śatasahasraistu dattairyatkurujāṃgale ..
puṇyaṃ bhavati deveśi tadgopyādityadarśane .. 38 ..
16.118.d:
गवां शतसहस्रैस्तु दत्तैर्यत्कुरुजांगले ..
पुण्यं भवति देवेशि तद्गोप्यादित्यदर्शने .. 38 ..
16.118.m: The merit that is gained by giving a hundred thousand cows in Kurujāṅgala, / O queen of the gods, is gained by the darśana of Gopyāditya. // 38

16.118.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gopyādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 118 ..
16.118.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गोप्यादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 118 ..
16.118.m: Thus ends the hundred and eighteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gopyāditya,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 118

16.119.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi mahādevīṃ mahāprabhām ..
balātibaladaityaghnīṃ nāmneti prathitāṃ kṣitau .. 1 ..
16.119.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि महादेवीं महाप्रभाम् ..
बलातिबलदैत्यघ्नीं नाम्नेति प्रथितां क्षितौ .. 1 ..
16.119.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the Great Goddess of great splendor, / the slayer of the demons Bala and Atibala, famed by that name on earth, // 1

16.119.s:
anādinidhanāṃ devīṃ tatra kṣetre vyavasthitām ..
koṭibhūtaparīvārāṃ sarvadaityanibarhiṇīm .. 2 ..
16.119.d:
अनादिनिधनां देवीं तत्र क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिताम् ..
कोटिभूतपरीवारां सर्वदैत्यनिबर्हिणीम् .. 2 ..
16.119.m: the goddess without beginning or end, residing in that sacred field, / surrounded by a retinue of ten million spirits, the destroyer of all demons. // 2

16.119.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
balātibaladaityaghnī kathamuktā tvayā prabho ..
balātibalanāmānau kathaṃ daityau nipātitau .. 3 ..
16.119.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
बलातिबलदैत्यघ्नी कथमुक्ता त्वया प्रभो ..
बलातिबलनामानौ कथं दैत्यौ निपातितौ .. 3 ..
16.119.m: The goddess said: / Why has she been called by you the slayer of the demons Bala and Atibala, O Lord? / How were the two demons named Bala and Atibala struck down? // 3

16.119.s:
kutra tiṣṭhati sā devī kiṃprabhāvā maheśvara ..
māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 4 ..
16.119.d:
कुत्र तिष्ठति सा देवी किंप्रभावा महेश्वर ..
माहात्म्यमखिलं तस्याः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 4 ..
16.119.m: Where does that goddess reside, and what is her power, O Maheśvara? / Tell me her entire māhātmya in full detail. // 4

16.119.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.119.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 5 ..
16.119.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall relate the narrative that destroys sins, / hearing which with devotion, a mortal is freed from all offenses. // 5

16.119.s:
āsīdraktāsuronāma mahiṣasya suto balī ..
mahākāyo mahābāhurhiraṇyākṣa ivāparaḥ .. 6 ..
16.119.d:
आसीद्रक्तासुरोनाम महिषस्य सुतो बली ..
महाकायो महाबाहुर्हिरण्याक्ष इवापरः .. 6 ..
16.119.m: There was a mighty son of Mahiṣa named Raktāsura, / of huge body and mighty arms, like a second Hiraṇyākṣa. // 6

16.119.s:
balātibala nāmānau tasya putrau babhūvatuḥ ..
tau vijitya surānsarvāndevendrāgnipurogamān .. 7 ..
16.119.d:
बलातिबल नामानौ तस्य पुत्रौ बभूवतुः ..
तौ विजित्य सुरान्सर्वान्देवेन्द्राग्निपुरोगमान् .. 7 ..
16.119.m: He had two sons named Bala and Atibala; / having conquered all the gods led by Devendra and Agni, // 7

16.119.s:
trailokye'sminnirātaṃkau cakratū rājyamañjasā ..
tayoḥ senā mukhe vīrāstrayastriṃśatprakīrtitāḥ .. 8 ..
16.119.d:
त्रैलोक्येऽस्मिन्निरातंकौ चक्रतू राज्यमञ्जसा ..
तयोः सेना मुखे वीरास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत्प्रकीर्तिताः .. 8 ..
16.119.m: the two easily ruled the kingdom in this world of three realms without fear. / Thirty-three heroes are renowned as commanders at the head of their army, // 8

16.119.s:
raudrātmāno mahāyodhāḥ sahasrākṣauhiṇīmukhāḥ ..
siṃhaskandhā mahākāyā durātmāno mahābalāḥ .. 9 ..
16.119.d:
रौद्रात्मानो महायोधाः सहस्राक्षौहिणीमुखाः ..
सिंहस्कन्धा महाकाया दुरात्मानो महाबलाः .. 9 ..
16.119.m: terrible in nature, great warriors, leaders of a thousand akṣauhiṇīs, / with lion-like shoulders, huge bodies, wicked minds, and great strength: // 9

16.119.s:
dhūmrākṣo bhīmadaṃṣṭraśca kālavaśyo mahāhanuḥ ..
brahmaghno yajñakopaśca strīghnaḥ pāpaniketanaḥ .. 7.1.119.10 ..
16.119.d:
धूम्राक्षो भीमदंष्ट्रश्च कालवश्यो महाहनुः ..
ब्रह्मघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च स्त्रीघ्नः पापनिकेतनः .. 7.1.119.10 ..
16.119.m: Dhūmrākṣa, Bhīmadaṃṣṭra, Kālavaśya, Mahāhanu, / Brahmaghna, Yajñakopa, Strīghna, Pāpaniketana, // 10

16.119.s:
vidyunmālī ca bandhūkaḥ śaṃkukarṇo vibhāvasuḥ ..
devāṃtako vikarmā ca durbhikṣa krūra eva ca .. 11 ..
16.119.d:
विद्युन्माली च बन्धूकः शंकुकर्णो विभावसुः ..
देवांतको विकर्मा च दुर्भिक्ष क्रूर एव च .. 11 ..
16.119.m: Vidyunmālī, Bandhūka, Śaṅkukarṇa, Vibhāvasu, / Devāntaka, Vikarmā, Durbhikṣa, and Krūra, // 11

16.119.s:
hayagrīvo'śvakarṇaśca ketumānvṛṣabho dvijaḥ ..
śarabhaḥ śalabho vyāghro nikuṃbho maṇiko bakaḥ .. 12 ..
16.119.d:
हयग्रीवोऽश्वकर्णश्च केतुमान्वृषभो द्विजः ..
शरभः शलभो व्याघ्रो निकुंभो मणिको बकः .. 12 ..
16.119.m: Hayagrīva, Aśvakarṇa, Ketumān, Vṛṣabha, Dvija, / Śarabha, Śalabha, Vyāghra, Nikuṃbha, Maṇika, Baka, // 12

16.119.s:
śūrpako vikṣaro mālī kālo daṇḍakakeralaḥ ..
ete daityā mahākāyāstayoḥ senādhikāriṇaḥ .. 13 ..
16.119.d:
शूर्पको विक्षरो माली कालो दण्डककेरलः ..
एते दैत्या महाकायास्तयोः सेनाधिकारिणः .. 13 ..
16.119.m: Śūrpaka, Vikṣara, Mālī, Kāla, Daṇḍaka, and Kerala— / these demons of huge body were commanders of their army. // 13

16.119.s:
evaṃ taiḥ pṛthivī vyāptā pañcāśatkoṭi vistarā ..
evaṃ jñātvā tadā devā bhayenodvignamānasāḥ .. 14 ..
16.119.d:
एवं तैः पृथिवी व्याप्ता पञ्चाशत्कोटि विस्तरा ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा तदा देवा भयेनोद्विग्नमानसाः .. 14 ..
16.119.m: Thus the earth, extending over fifty koṭis [of yojanas], was pervaded by them. / Knowing this, the gods, their minds agitated with fear, // 14

16.119.s:
sarvairdevarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagmuste himavadvanam ..
stotreṇānena tāṃ devīṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ prayatāstadā .. 15 ..
16.119.d:
सर्वैर्देवर्षिभिः सार्धं जग्मुस्ते हिमवद्वनम् ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन तां देवीं तुष्टुवुः प्रयतास्तदा .. 15 ..
16.119.m: went with all the celestial ṛṣis to the forest of the Himavat. / Then, with concentrated minds, they praised that goddess with this hymn: // 15

16.119.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
jayākṣare jayā'naṃte jayā'vyakte nirāmaye ..
jaya devi mahāmāye jaya devarṣivaṃdite .. 16 ..
16.119.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
जयाक्षरे जयाऽनंते जयाऽव्यक्ते निरामये ..
जय देवि महामाये जय देवर्षिवंदिते .. 16 ..
16.119.m: The gods said: / Victory to you, the Imperishable! Victory to you, the Infinite! Victory to you, the Unmanifest, free from ailment! / Victory, O goddess, Mahāmāyā! Victory to you who are venerated by celestial ṛṣis! // 16

16.119.s:
jaya viśveśvare gaṃge jaya sarvārthasiddhide ..
jaya brahmāṇi kaumāri jaya nārāyaṇīśvari .. 17 ..
16.119.d:
जय विश्वेश्वरे गंगे जय सर्वार्थसिद्धिदे ..
जय ब्रह्माणि कौमारि जय नारायणीश्वरि .. 17 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Sovereign of the Universe, Gaṅgā! Victory to you who bestow all accomplishments! / Victory, Brahmāṇī, Kaumārī! Victory, Nārāyaṇī, Supreme Mistress! // 17

16.119.s:
jaya brahmāṇi cāmuṃḍe jayendrāṇi maheśvari ..
jaya mātarmahālakṣmi jaya pārvati sarvage .. 18 ..
16.119.d:
जय ब्रह्माणि चामुंडे जयेन्द्राणि महेश्वरि ..
जय मातर्महालक्ष्मि जय पार्वति सर्वगे .. 18 ..
16.119.m: Victory, Brahmāṇī, Cāmuṇḍā! Victory, Indrāṇī, Maheśvarī! / Victory, Mother Mahālakṣmī! Victory, Pārvatī, all-pervading one! // 18

16.119.s:
jaya devi jagatsṛṣṭe jayairāvati bhārati ..
jayānaṃte jaya jaye jaya devi jalāvile .. 19 ..
16.119.d:
जय देवि जगत्सृष्टे जयैरावति भारति ..
जयानंते जय जये जय देवि जलाविले .. 19 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O goddess who create the universe! Victory, Airāvatī, Bhāratī! / Victory, Infinite One! Victory, Jayā! Victory, O goddess abounding in waters! // 19

16.119.s:
jayeśāni śive śarve jaya nityaṃ jayārcite ..
mokṣade jaya sarvajñe jaya dharmārthakāmade .. 7.1.119.20 ..
16.119.d:
जयेशानि शिवे शर्वे जय नित्यं जयार्चिते ..
मोक्षदे जय सर्वज्ञे जय धर्मार्थकामदे .. 7.1.119.20 ..
16.119.m: Victory to you, Īśānī, Śivā, Śarvā! Victory constantly, O you who are worshipped by victory! / O bestower of liberation, victory, O omniscient one! Victory, O granter of dharma, wealth, and desire!

16.119.s:
jaya gāyatri kalyāṇi jaya sahye vibhāvari ..
jaya durge mahākāli śiva dūti jayā'jaye .. 21 ..
16.119.d:
जय गायत्रि कल्याणि जय सह्ये विभावरि ..
जय दुर्गे महाकालि शिव दूति जयाऽजये .. 21 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Gāyatrī, Kalyāṇī! Victory, O Sahyā, Vibhāvarī! / Victory, O Durgā, Mahākālī, Śivadūtī, Jayā, Ajayā!

16.119.s:
jaya caṇḍe mahāmuṇḍe jaya nande śivapriye ..
jaya kṣemaṃkari śive jaya kalyāṇi revati .. 22 ..
16.119.d:
जय चण्डे महामुण्डे जय नन्दे शिवप्रिये ..
जय क्षेमंकरि शिवे जय कल्याणि रेवति .. 22 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Caṇḍā, Mahāmuṇḍā! Victory, O Nandā, beloved of Śiva! / Victory, O Kṣemaṃkarī, Śivā! Victory, O Kalyāṇī, Revatī!

16.119.s:
jayome siddhimāṃgalye harasiddhe namostu te ..
jayāparṇe jayānande mahiṣā'suraghātini .. 23 ..
16.119.d:
जयोमे सिद्धिमांगल्ये हरसिद्धे नमोस्तु ते ..
जयापर्णे जयानन्दे महिषाऽसुरघातिनि .. 23 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Umā, Siddhimāṅgalyā, Harasiddhi, bow to you! / Victory, O Aparṇā, victory, O Ānandā, slayer of the demon Mahiṣa!

16.119.s:
jaya medhe viśālākṣi jayānaṃge sarasvati ..
jayāśeṣaguṇāvāse jayāvarte surāntake .. 24 ..
16.119.d:
जय मेधे विशालाक्षि जयानंगे सरस्वति ..
जयाशेषगुणावासे जयावर्ते सुरान्तके .. 24 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Medhā, Viśālākṣī! Victory, O Anaṅgā, Sarasvatī! / Victory, O abode of endless virtues! Victory, O whirlpool, destroyer of the enemies of the gods!

16.119.s:
jaya saṃkalpasaṃsiddhe jaya trailokyasuṃdari ..
jaya śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaghne jaya padme'drisaṃbhave .. 25 ..
16.119.d:
जय संकल्पसंसिद्धे जय त्रैलोक्यसुंदरि ..
जय शुंभनिशुंभघ्ने जय पद्मेऽद्रिसंभवे .. 25 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O accomplisher of resolves! Victory, O beauty of the three worlds! / Victory, O slayer of Śumbha and Niśumbha! Victory, O Padmā, born of the mountain!

16.119.s:
jaya kauśiki kaumāri jaya vāruṇi kāmade ..
namonamaste śarvāṇi bhūyobhūyo jayāmbike .. 26 ..
16.119.d:
जय कौशिकि कौमारि जय वारुणि कामदे ..
नमोनमस्ते शर्वाणि भूयोभूयो जयाम्बिके .. 26 ..
16.119.m: Victory, O Kauśikī, Kaumārī! Victory, O Vāruṇī, granter of desires! / Bows, bows to you, Śarvāṇī! Repeatedly, victory to you, Ambikā!

16.119.s: trāhi nastrāhi no devi śaraṇye śaraṇāgatān .. 27 ..
16.119.d: त्राहि नस्त्राहि नो देवि शरण्ये शरणागतान् .. 27 ..
16.119.m: Protect us, protect us, O goddess, refuge of those who have sought refuge!

16.119.s:
saivaṃ stutā bhagavatī devaiḥ sarvairvarānane ..
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa bhābhāsitadigantaram .. 28 ..
16.119.d:
सैवं स्तुता भगवती देवैः सर्वैर्वरानने ..
आत्मानं दर्शयामास भाभासितदिगन्तरम् .. 28 ..
16.119.m: Puffed with praise in this way by all the gods, O fair-faced one, / the Blessed Lady revealed herself, illuminating the horizons with her brilliance.

16.119.s:
namaskṛtya tu tāmūcuḥ surāste bhayanāśanīm ..
balātibalanāmānau hatvā daityau mahābalau ..
teṣāṃ caiva mahatsainyaṃ pāhyato mahato bhayāt .. 29 ..
16.119.d:
नमस्कृत्य तु तामूचुः सुरास्ते भयनाशनीम् ..
बलातिबलनामानौ हत्वा दैत्यौ महाबलौ ..
तेषां चैव महत्सैन्यं पाह्यतो महतो भयात् .. 29 ..
16.119.m: Bowing to her, the destroyer of fear, those gods said: / 'Having slain the two mighty Daityas named Bala and Atibala, / and their vast army, protect [us] from this great fear.'

16.119.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dattvā tebhyo'bhayaṃ tataḥ ..
babhūvādbhutarūpā sā trinetrā cenduśekharā ..7.1.119.30..
16.119.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्योऽभयं ततः ..
बभूवाद्भुतरूपा सा त्रिनेत्रा चेन्दुशेखरा ..7.1.119.30..
16.119.m: Hearing their words and granting them fearlessness, / she then assumed a wondrous form, three-eyed and crested with the moon,

16.119.s:
siṃhārūḍhā mahādevi nānāśastrāstradhāriṇī ..
suvaktrā viṃśatibhujā sphūrjadvidyullatopamā ..31..
16.119.d:
सिंहारूढा महादेवि नानाशस्त्रास्त्रधारिणी ..
सुवक्त्रा विंशतिभुजा स्फूर्जद्विद्युल्लतोपमा ..31..
16.119.m: mounted upon a lion, the great goddess bearing diverse weapons and missiles, / fair-faced, twenty-armed, resembling a flashing streak of lightning.

16.119.s: tatoṃ 'bikā ninādoccaiḥ sāṭṭahāsaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 32 ..
16.119.d: ततों ऽबिका निनादोच्चैः साट्टहासं मुहुर्मुहुः .. 32 ..
16.119.m: Then Ambikā uttered loud cries with boisterous laughter again and again.

16.119.s:
tasyā nādena ghoreṇa kṛtsnamāpūritaṃ nabhaḥ ..
prakaṃpitākhilā corvī saridvāridhimekhalā .. 33 ..
16.119.d:
तस्या नादेन घोरेण कृत्स्नमापूरितं नभः ..
प्रकंपिताखिला चोर्वी सरिद्वारिधिमेखला .. 33 ..
16.119.m: By her terrible sound the entire sky was filled; / the whole earth shook, girdled by rivers and the ocean,

16.119.s:
śailatuṃgastanī ramyā pramadeva bhayāturā ..
te'pi tatrāsurāḥ prāptāścaturaṃgabalānvitāḥ .. 34 ..
16.119.d:
शैलतुंगस्तनी रम्या प्रमदेव भयातुरा ..
तेऽपि तत्रासुराः प्राप्ताश्चतुरंगबलान्विताः .. 34 ..
16.119.m: lovely, with mountains for high breasts, like a woman stricken with fear. / Those Asuras too arrived there, accompanied by their fourfold army,

16.119.s:
samyagviditavikrāntāḥ kālāntakayamopamāḥ ..
rakṣo dānavadaityāśca pātāle ye'pi saṃsthitāḥ .. 35 ..
16.119.d:
सम्यग्विदितविक्रान्ताः कालान्तकयमोपमाः ..
रक्षो दानवदैत्याश्च पाताले येऽपि संस्थिताः .. 35 ..
16.119.m: of well-known prowess, equal to Death and Yama at the end of time— / Rakṣases, Dānavas, and Daityas, even those dwelling in Pātāla.

16.119.s:
te sarva eva daityendrāḥ koṭiśaḥ samupāgatāḥ ..
tato'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ devyāstatrāsuraiḥ saha .. 36 ..
16.119.d:
ते सर्व एव दैत्येन्द्राः कोटिशः समुपागताः ..
ततोऽभवन्महायुद्धं देव्यास्तत्रासुरैः सह .. 36 ..
16.119.m: All those lords of Daityas gathered by the crores. / Then a great battle ensued between the goddess and the Asuras,

16.119.s:
babhūva sarvabrahmāṇḍe hyakāṇḍakṣayakāraṇam ..
akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśatsureśvari .. 37 ..
16.119.d:
बभूव सर्वब्रह्माण्डे ह्यकाण्डक्षयकारणम् ..
अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सुरेश्वरि .. 37 ..
16.119.m: which was the cause of an untimely destruction of the entire universe, O ruler of the gods: / thirty-three thousand akṣauhiṇīs,

16.119.s:
ekaviṃśatsahasrāṇi śatānyaṣṭau ca saptatiḥ ..
sānugānāṃ sayodhānāṃ rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām .. 38 ..
16.119.d:
एकविंशत्सहस्राणि शतान्यष्टौ च सप्ततिः ..
सानुगानां सयोधानां रथानां वातरंहसाम् .. 38 ..
16.119.m: twenty-one thousand, eight hundred, and seventy / chariots swift as the wind, with their retinues and warriors.

16.119.s: hatvā sā līlayā devī ninye kṣayamanākulā .. 39 ..
16.119.d: हत्वा सा लीलया देवी निन्ये क्षयमनाकुला .. 39 ..
16.119.m: Effortlessly and untroubled, the goddess killed them and brought them to destruction.

16.119.s:
tato devyā hatānāṃ ca dānavānāṃ mahaujasām ..
gajavājirathānāṃ ca śarīrairāvṛtā mahī .. 7.1.119.40 ..
16.119.d:
ततो देव्या हतानां च दानवानां महौजसाम् ..
गजवाजिरथानां च शरीरैरावृता मही .. 7.1.119.40 ..
16.119.m: Then the earth was covered with the bodies of the powerful Dānavas / slain by the goddess, and of elephants, horses, and chariots.

16.119.s:
kabaṃdhanṛtyasaṃkule sravadvasāsthikarddame ..
raṇājire niśācarāstato vicerurūrjitāḥ .. 41 ..
16.119.d:
कबंधनृत्यसंकुले स्रवद्वसास्थिकर्द्दमे ..
रणाजिरे निशाचरास्ततो विचेरुरूर्जिताः .. 41 ..
16.119.m: In that battle-yard crowded with the dance of headless trunks and mired with flowing fat and bones, / night-roaming demons then roamed about, energized.

16.119.s:
śṛgāla gṛdhavāyasāḥ paraṃ prapātamādadhuḥ ..
kvacitpare niśācarāḥ prapītaśoṇitotkaṭāḥ ..
pratarpya cātmanaḥ pitṝnsamarcayaṃstathā ṛṣīn .. 42 ..
16.119.d:
शृगाल गृधवायसाः परं प्रपातमादधुः ..
क्वचित्परे निशाचराः प्रपीतशोणितोत्कटाः ..
प्रतर्प्य चात्मनः पितॄन्समर्चयंस्तथा ऋषीन् .. 42 ..
16.119.m: Jackals, vultures, and crows swooped down abundantly. / Somewhere other night-roaming demons, exhilarated from drinking blood, / having propitiated their ancestors and likewise worshipped the seers,

16.119.s:
gajānnarāṃsturaṃgamānbabhakṣire sunirghṛṇāḥ ..
rathoḍupaistathā pare taraṃti śoṇitārṇavam .. 43 ..
16.119.d:
गजान्नरांस्तुरंगमान्बभक्षिरे सुनिर्घृणाः ..
रथोडुपैस्तथा परे तरंति शोणितार्णवम् .. 43 ..
16.119.m: mercilessly devoured elephants, men, and horses; / and others crossed the ocean of blood on rafts of chariots.

16.119.s:
iti pragāḍhasaṃgare surārisaṃghasaṃkule ..
virājate'mbikā dhanuḥ śarā'siśūladhāriṇī .. 44 ..
16.119.d:
इति प्रगाढसंगरे सुरारिसंघसंकुले ..
विराजतेऽम्बिका धनुः शराऽसिशूलधारिणी .. 44 ..
16.119.m: Thus in that fierce battle dense with hosts of the enemies of the gods, / Ambikā shone forth, holding bow, arrows, sword, and spear,

16.119.s:
gajendradarpamarddanī turaṃgayūthapothinī ..
surārisainyanāśinī itastataḥ prapaśyatī .. 45 ..
16.119.d:
गजेन्द्रदर्पमर्द्दनी तुरंगयूथपोथिनी ..
सुरारिसैन्यनाशिनी इतस्ततः प्रपश्यती .. 45 ..
16.119.m: crushing the pride of lordly elephants, slaying troops of horses, / destroying the armies of the enemies of the gods, looking all around.

16.119.s: siṃhāṣṭakayukte mahā pretake bhūdharahaṃsaśubhrojjaladbhāsvarābhe vṛṣabhasamāne māninīmatho te daityendravīrāḥ paśyaṃtaḥ samudbhūtaroṣāstato'pi jagmurnadanto ravanto ravaṃ meghanādāḥ .. 46 ..
16.119.d: सिंहाष्टकयुक्ते महा प्रेतके भूधरहंसशुभ्रोज्जलद्भास्वराभे वृषभसमाने मानिनीमथो ते दैत्येन्द्रवीराः पश्यंतः समुद्भूतरोषास्ततोऽपि जग्मुर्नदन्तो रवन्तो रवं मेघनादाः .. 46 ..
16.119.m: Seeing that proud goddess upon a great throne drawn by eight lions, radiant as a mountain or a white swan, like a bull, those valiant lords of the Daityas, their wrath aroused, rushed forward, shouting, roaring, with voices like thunderclouds.

16.119.s:
hāhākāraṃ vikurvāṇā hanyamānāstato'surāḥ ..
kecitsamudraṃ viviśuradrīnkecicca dānavāḥ .. 47 ..
16.119.d:
हाहाकारं विकुर्वाणा हन्यमानास्ततोऽसुराः ..
केचित्समुद्रं विविशुरद्रीन्केचिच्च दानवाः .. 47 ..
16.119.m: Slain then, the Asuras fled, wailing loudly; / some Dānavas entered the sea, and some [fled to] the mountains.

16.119.s:
kecilluñcitamūrdhāno jālmā bhūtvā vane'vasan ..
dayādharmaṃ bruvāṇāśca nirgraṃthavratamāsthitāḥ .. 48 ..
16.119.d:
केचिल्लुञ्चितमूर्धानो जाल्मा भूत्वा वनेऽवसन् ..
दयाधर्मं ब्रुवाणाश्च निर्ग्रंथव्रतमास्थिताः .. 48 ..
16.119.m: Some, having shaved their heads and become wretched, lived in the forest; / speaking of the virtue of compassion, they took to the vow of Nirgranthas.

16.119.s:
kecitprāṇaparā bhītāḥ pākhaṇḍāśramamāsthitāḥ ..
hetuvādaparā mūḍhā niḥśaucā nirapekṣakāḥ .. 49 ..
16.119.d:
केचित्प्राणपरा भीताः पाखण्डाश्रममास्थिताः ..
हेतुवादपरा मूढा निःशौचा निरपेक्षकाः .. 49 ..
16.119.m: Some, desperate for life, terrified, resorted to heretical ways; / devoted to rationalist argumentation, foolish, impure, and indifferent [to the Vedas].

16.119.s:
te cādyāpīha dṛśyante loke kṣapaṇakāḥ kila ..
tathaiva bhindakāścānye śivaśāstrabahiṣkṛtāḥ .. 7.1.119.50 ..
16.119.d:
ते चाद्यापीह दृश्यन्ते लोके क्षपणकाः किल ..
तथैव भिन्दकाश्चान्ये शिवशास्त्रबहिष्कृताः .. 7.1.119.50 ..
16.119.m: Even today they are seen here in the world as mendicants indeed; / likewise other sectarians excluded from Śiva's scriptures.

16.119.s:
kecitkaulavratā hyasmindṛśyante sakalairjanaiḥ..
surāstrīmāṃsabhūyiṣṭhā vikarmasthāśca liṅginaḥ .. 51 ..
16.119.d:
केचित्कौलव्रता ह्यस्मिन्दृश्यन्ते सकलैर्जनैः..
सुरास्त्रीमांसभूयिष्ठा विकर्मस्थाश्च लिङ्गिनः .. 51 ..
16.119.m: Some are seen by all people in this world observing the Kaula vow, / deeply given to liquor, women, and meat, and false ascetics committed to improper actions,

16.119.s:
prāyo naiṣkṛtikāḥ pāpā jihvopasthaparāyaṇā..
evaṃ devyā hatāḥ sarve balātibalasaṃyutāḥ..52..
16.119.d:
प्रायो नैष्कृतिकाः पापा जिह्वोपस्थपरायणा..
एवं देव्या हताः सर्वे बलातिबलसंयुताः..52..
16.119.m: mostly roguish, sinful, and devoted to tongue and genitals. / Thus all were slain by the goddess, along with Bala and Atibala.

16.119.s:
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā sā tadāmbikā..
yoginīnāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā saṃyutā pāpanāśinī..
balātibalanāśīti prabhāse prathitā kṣitau..53..
16.119.d:
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य संस्थिता सा तदाम्बिका..
योगिनीनां चतुःषष्ट्या संयुता पापनाशिनी..
बलातिबलनाशीति प्रभासे प्रथिता क्षितौ..53..
16.119.m: Having reached the Prabhāsa sacred field, Ambikā then settled there, / accompanied by the sixty-four Yoginīs, the destroyer of sin; / she became celebrated on earth at Prabhāsa as the destroyer of Bala and Atibala.

16.119.s:
devyuvāca..
catuḥṣaṣṭistvayā proktā yoginyo yāḥ sureśvara..
tāsāṃ nāmāni me brūhi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca.. 54..
16.119.d:
देव्युवाच..
चतुःषष्टिस्त्वया प्रोक्ता योगिन्यो याः सुरेश्वर..
तासां नामानि मे ब्रूहि सर्वपापहराणि च.. 54..
16.119.m: The goddess said: / The sixty-four Yoginīs that have been mentioned by you, O lord of gods— / tell me their names, which remove all sins.

16.119.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yoginīnāṃ mahodayam ..
sarvarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ mahābhayavināśanam .. 55 ..
16.119.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि योगिनीनां महोदयम् ..
सर्वरक्षाकरं दिव्यं महाभयविनाशनम् .. 55 ..
16.119.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I will proclaim the great glory of the Yoginīs, / which grants all protection, is divine, and destroys great danger.

16.119.s:
ādau tatra mahālakṣmīrnaṃdā kṣemaṃkarī tathā ..
śivadūtī mahābhadrā bhrāmarī candramaṇḍalā .. 56 ..
16.119.d:
आदौ तत्र महालक्ष्मीर्नंदा क्षेमंकरी तथा ..
शिवदूती महाभद्रा भ्रामरी चन्द्रमण्डला .. 56 ..
16.119.m: First there is Mahālakṣmī, Nandā, and Kṣemaṃkarī, / Śivadūtī, Mahābhadrā, Bhrāmarī, Candramaṇḍalā,

16.119.s:
revatī harasiddhiśca durgā viṣamalocanā ..
sahajā kulajā kubjā māyāvī śāṃbhavī kriyā .. 57 ..
16.119.d:
रेवती हरसिद्धिश्च दुर्गा विषमलोचना ..
सहजा कुलजा कुब्जा मायावी शांभवी क्रिया .. 57 ..
16.119.m: Revatī, Harasiddhi, Durgā, Viṣamalocanā, / Sahajā, Kulajā, Kubjā, Māyāvī, Śāmbhavī, Kriyā,

16.119.s:
ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvagamyā manotigā ..
vidyāvidyā mahāmāyā suṣumnā sarvamaṃgalā .. 58 ..
16.119.d:
आद्या सर्वगता शुद्धा भावगम्या मनोतिगा ..
विद्याविद्या महामाया सुषुम्ना सर्वमंगला .. 58 ..
16.119.m: Ādyā, Sarvagatā, Śuddhā, Bhāvagamyā, Manotigā, / Vidyā, Avidyā, Mahāmāyā, Suṣumnā, Sarvamaṅgalā,

16.119.s:
oṃkārātmā mahādevi vedārthajananī śivā ..
purāṇānvīkṣikī dīkṣā cāmuṇḍā śaṃkarapriyā .. 59 ..
16.119.d:
ओंकारात्मा महादेवि वेदार्थजननी शिवा ..
पुराणान्वीक्षिकी दीक्षा चामुण्डा शंकरप्रिया .. 59 ..
16.119.m: Oṃkārātmā, Mahādevī, Vedārthajananī, Śivā, / Purāṇā, Anvīkṣikī, Dīkṣā, Cāmuṇḍā, Śaṃkarapriyā,

16.119.s:
brāhmī śāṃtikarī gaurī brahmaṇyā brāhmaṇapriyā ..
bhadrā bhagavatī kṛṣṇā grahanakṣatramālinī .. 7.1.119.60 ..
16.119.d:
ब्राह्मी शांतिकरी गौरी ब्रह्मण्या ब्राह्मणप्रिया ..
भद्रा भगवती कृष्णा ग्रहनक्षत्रमालिनी .. 7.1.119.60 ..
16.119.m: Brāhmī, Śāntikarī, Gaurī, Brahmaṇyā, Brāhmaṇapriyā, / Bhadrā, Bhagavatī, Kṛṣṇā, Grahamakṣatramālinī,

16.119.s:
tripurā tvaritā nityā sāṃkhyā kuṃḍalinī dhruvā ..
kalyāṇī śobhanā nirayā niṣkalā paramā kalā .. 61 ..
16.119.d:
त्रिपुरा त्वरिता नित्या सांख्या कुंडलिनी ध्रुवा ..
कल्याणी शोभना निरया निष्कला परमा कला .. 61 ..
16.119.m: Tripurā, Tvaritā, Nityā, Sāṅkhyā, Kuṇḍalinī, Dhruvā, / Kalyāṇī, Śobhanā, Nirayā, Niṣkalā, Paramā Kalā,

16.119.s:
yoginī yogasadbhāvā yogagamyā guhāśayā ..
kātyāyanī umā śarvā hyaparṇeti prakīrtitā .. 62 ..
16.119.d:
योगिनी योगसद्भावा योगगम्या गुहाशया ..
कात्यायनी उमा शर्वा ह्यपर्णेति प्रकीर्तिता .. 62 ..
16.119.m: Yoginī, Yogasadbhāvā, Yogagamyā, Guhāśayā, / Kātyāyanī, Umā, Śarvā, and Aparṇā is proclaimed.

16.119.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭirmahādevi evaṃ te parikīrtitāḥ ..
stotreṇānena divyena bhaktyā yaḥ stauti caṃḍikām .. 63 ..
16.119.d:
चतुःषष्टिर्महादेवि एवं ते परिकीर्तिताः ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन दिव्येन भक्त्या यः स्तौति चंडिकाम् .. 63 ..
16.119.m: Thus the sixty-four have been proclaimed to you, O great goddess. / Whoever praises Caṇḍikā with devotion through this divine hymn...

16.119.s:
taṃ putramiva śarvāṇī sarvāpatsvabhirakṣati ..
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 64 ..
16.119.d:
तं पुत्रमिव शर्वाणी सर्वापत्स्वभिरक्षति ..
चतुर्दश्यामथाष्टम्यां नवम्यां च विशेषतः .. 64 ..
16.119.m: Śarvāṇī protects him from all perils like a son, / especially on the fourteenth, the eighth, and the ninth [lunar days].

16.119.s:
upavāsaikabhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca ..
gṛhītaniyamā devi ye japaṃti ca caṃḍikām .. 65 ..
16.119.d:
उपवासैकभक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ..
गृहीतनियमा देवि ये जपंति च चंडिकाम् .. 65 ..
16.119.m: Undertaking fasting, eating once a day, or living on unasked-for food, / those who observe vows and recite the praises of Caṇḍikā, O goddess,

16.119.s:
varṣārdhaṃ varṣamekaṃ vā siddhāste tattvacāriṇaḥ ..
āśvayukchuklapakṣe ca manvādiṣvaṣṭakāsu ca .. 66 ..
16.119.d:
वर्षार्धं वर्षमेकं वा सिद्धास्ते तत्त्वचारिणः ..
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे च मन्वादिष्वष्टकासु च .. 66 ..
16.119.m: for half a year or for one year, become perfected practitioners who move in the truth. / And in the bright fortnight of the month of Āśvina, at the beginnings of the Manvantaras, and on the Aṣṭakā days,

16.119.s:
kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ devīṃ yajecchreyo'bhivṛddhaye ..
pāduke dhārayeddevyā durgābhakto hiraṇmaye .. 67 ..
16.119.d:
कृत्वा महोत्सवं देवीं यजेच्छ्रेयोऽभिवृद्धये ..
पादुके धारयेद्देव्या दुर्गाभक्तो हिरण्मये .. 67 ..
16.119.m: having held a great festival, one should worship the goddess for the increase of prosperity. / A devotee of Durgā should wear golden sandals belonging to the goddess,

16.119.s:
pramādavighnaśāṃtyarthaṃ kṣurikāṃ ca sadā pumān ..
paśumāṃsāsavaiścaivamāsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ .. 68 ..
16.119.d:
प्रमादविघ्नशांत्यर्थं क्षुरिकां च सदा पुमान् ..
पशुमांसासवैश्चैवमासुरं भावमाश्रिताः .. 68 ..
16.119.m: and a man [should carry] a dagger always, to pacify negligence and obstacles. / Those who resort to a demonic disposition, with animal meat and liquor,

16.119.s:
ye yajantyambikāṃ te syurdaityā aiśvaryabhoginaḥ ..
devatvaṃ sāttvikā yāṃti sāttvikīṃ bhaktimāsthitāḥ .. 69 ..
16.119.d:
ये यजन्त्यम्बिकां ते स्युर्दैत्या ऐश्वर्यभोगिनः ..
देवत्वं सात्त्विका यांति सात्त्विकीं भक्तिमास्थिताः .. 69 ..
16.119.m: and worship Ambikā, shall become Daityas enjoying dominion. / But the sattvic, resting on sattvic devotion, attain divine status.

16.119.s:
etatte kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
balātibalanāśinyā devyā sarvārthasādhakam ..
prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthāyāḥ saṃkṣepātkīrtivardhanam .. 70 ..
16.119.d:
एतत्ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
बलातिबलनाशिन्या देव्या सर्वार्थसाधकम् ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रसंस्थायाः संक्षेपात्कीर्तिवर्धनम् .. 70 ..
16.119.m: Thus has this sin-destroying māhātmya been told to you, O goddess, / accomplishing all desires, of the goddess who destroyed Bala and Atibala, / residing in the Prabhāsa sacred field, increasing fame, [told] in brief.

16.119.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balātibaladaityaghnīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 119 ..
16.119.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलातिबलदैत्यघ्नीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 119 ..
16.119.m: Thus ends the one hundred and nineteenth chapter, named 'The description of the māhātmya of the goddess who slew the Daityas Bala and Atibala', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.120.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gopīśvaramanuttamam ..
balātibaladaityaghnyā uttare dhanuṣāṃ traye .. 1 ..
16.120.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गोपीश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
बलातिबलदैत्यघ्न्या उत्तरे धनुषां त्रये .. 1 ..
16.120.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to unexcelled Gopīśvara, / three bow-lengths to the north of [the goddess who] slew the Daityas Bala and Atibala,

16.120.s:
saṃsthitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ gopībhiḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitam ..
samārādhya mahādevaṃ putrahetormaheśvaram ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ pūjitaṃ saṃtatipradam .. 2 ..
16.120.d:
संस्थितं पापशमनं गोपीभिः संप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
समाराध्य महादेवं पुत्रहेतोर्महेश्वरम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नॄणां पूजितं संततिप्रदम् .. 2 ..
16.120.m: which pacifies sins and was established by the Gopīs / who propitiated Mahādeva, the great lord, for the sake of obtaining sons. / It grants all desires to mortals and, when worshipped, bestows progeny.

16.120.s:
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
gaṃdha puṣpopahāraiśca sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ phalam .. 3 ..
16.120.d:
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
गंध पुष्पोपहारैश्च स प्राप्नोतीप्सितं फलम् .. 3 ..
16.120.m: A person who worships him on the third day of the bright fortnight of Caitra / with perfumes, flowers, and food-offerings attains the desired fruit.

16.120.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
gopīśvarasya devasya prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ .. 4 ..
16.120.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
गोपीश्वरस्य देवस्य प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनः .. 4 ..
16.120.m: Thus has been declared in brief the sin-destroying māhātmya / of the deity Gopīśvara, who dwells in the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.120.s: iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balātibaladaityaghnīmāhātmye gopīśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 120 ..
16.120.d: इति श्री स्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलातिबलदैत्यघ्नीमाहात्म्ये गोपीश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 120 ..
16.120.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twentieth chapter, named 'The description of the māhātmya of Gopīśvara' in the māhātmya of the goddess who slew the Daityas Bala and Atibala, in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.121.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi rāmeśvaramanuttamam ..
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa svayaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.121.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रामेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
जामदग्न्येन रामेण स्वयं तत्र प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.121.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to unexcelled Rāmeśvara, / established there by Jamadagni's son Rāma himself.

16.121.s:
gopīśvarācca vāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśake'ntare ..
sthitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.121.d:
गोपीश्वराच्च वायव्ये धनुषां त्रिंशकेऽन्तरे ..
स्थितं महाप्रभावं हि लिंगं पातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.121.m: Situated at a distance of thirty bow-lengths to the northwest of Gopīśvara, / this liṅga is of great majesty and destroys sins.

16.121.s:
yadā rāmeṇa deveśi jamadagnisutena vai ..
kṛto mātṛvadho ghoraḥ piturājñānuvartinā .. 3 ..
16.121.d:
यदा रामेण देवेशि जमदग्निसुतेन वै ..
कृतो मातृवधो घोरः पितुराज्ञानुवर्तिना .. 3 ..
16.121.m: When, O ruler of the gods, by Rāma the son of Jamadagni, / obeying his father's command, the terrible matricide was committed,

16.121.s:
tadā manasi saṃtāpaṃ kṛtvā nirvedamāgataḥ ..
tataḥ prasannatāṃ yāto jamadagnirmahātapāḥ .. 4 ..
16.121.d:
तदा मनसि संतापं कृत्वा निर्वेदमागतः ..
ततः प्रसन्नतां यातो जमदग्निर्महातपाः .. 4 ..
16.121.m: having felt deep anguish in his mind, he fell into despair. / Then Jamadagni of great austerities became pleased;

16.121.s:
dadau varaṃ tatastuṣṭo reṇukāyāśca jīvitam ..
evaṃ yadyapi sā tatra jīvitā varavarṇinī .. 5 ..
16.121.d:
ददौ वरं ततस्तुष्टो रेणुकायाश्च जीवितम् ..
एवं यद्यपि सा तत्र जीविता वरवर्णिनी .. 5 ..
16.121.m: gratified, he granted a boon, and the restoration of Reṇukā's life. / Although that fair-complexioned woman was thus restored to life there,

16.121.s:
tathāpi saghṛṇo devi jāmadagnyo mahāprabhaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaścakre tato'dbhutam .. 6 ..
16.121.d:
तथापि सघृणो देवि जामदग्न्यो महाप्रभः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपश्चक्रे ततोऽद्भुतम् .. 6 ..
16.121.m: nevertheless, O goddess, Jamadagni's son of great splendour felt remorse. / Having arrived at the Prabhāsa sacred field, he then performed wondrous austerity.

16.121.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram ..
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 7 ..
16.121.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महादेवं शंकरं लोकशंकरम् ..
दिव्यं वर्षशतं साग्रं ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 7 ..
16.121.m: Having established Mahādeva Śaṃkara, who brings peace to the world, / [he worshipped him] for a full hundred divine years; then Maheśvara was pleased;

16.121.s:
dadau tasyepsitaṃ sarvaṃ svayaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ ..
tataḥ kṛtārthatāṃ prāpto jāmadagnyo mahāṛṣiḥ .. 8 ..
16.121.d:
ददौ तस्येप्सितं सर्वं स्वयं तत्रैव संस्थितः ..
ततः कृतार्थतां प्राप्तो जामदग्न्यो महाऋषिः .. 8 ..
16.121.m: abiding there himself, he granted him all that he desired. / Thereupon, having achieved his goal, the great seer, the son of Jamadagni,

16.121.s:
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ jitvā hatvā ca kṣatriyān ..
kṛtvā paṃcanadaṃ tatra kurukṣetre mahāmanāḥ .. 9 ..
16.121.d:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवीं जित्वा हत्वा च क्षत्रियान् ..
कृत्वा पंचनदं तत्र कुरुक्षेत्रे महामनाः .. 9 ..
16.121.m: having conquered the earth thrice seven times and slain the kṣatriyas, / having made five rivers there in Kurukṣetra, that high-minded one,

16.121.s:
raktaiḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ nītvā kṣatriyāṇāṃ varānane ..
ānṛṇyaṃ samanu prāptaḥ pitṝṇāṃ yo mahābalaḥ .. 7.1.121.10 ..
16.121.d:
रक्तैः संपूर्णतां नीत्वा क्षत्रियाणां वरानने ..
आनृण्यं समनु प्राप्तः पितॄणां यो महाबलः .. 7.1.121.10 ..
16.121.m: and filled them completely with the blood of the kṣatriyas, O fair-faced one, / that mighty one discharged his debt to the ancestors.

16.121.s:
evaṃ kṣattrāntakaṃ kṛtvā dattvā vipreṣu medinīm ..
kṛtārthatāmanuprāptastrailokye khyātapauruṣaḥ .. 11 ..
16.121.d:
एवं क्षत्त्रान्तकं कृत्वा दत्त्वा विप्रेषु मेदिनीम् ..
कृतार्थतामनुप्राप्तस्त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातपौरुषः .. 11 ..
16.121.m: Having thus exterminated the kṣatriyas and given the earth to the brahmins, / his prowess renowned in the three worlds, he attained the fulfillment of his purpose.

16.121.s:
tena tatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā pāpayukto'pi mānavaḥ ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairyāti lokamumāpateḥ .. 12 ..
16.121.d:
तेन तत्स्थापितं लिंगं क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या पापयुक्तोऽपि मानवः ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्याति लोकमुमापतेः .. 12 ..
16.121.m: By him that liṅga was installed in the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa. / Whatever person worships it with devotion, even if laden with sin, / is freed from all sins and goes to the world of the lord of Umā.

16.121.s:
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ jāgṛyāttatra yo naraḥ ..
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate divi devavat .. 13 ..
16.121.d:
ज्येष्ठकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां जागृयात्तत्र यो नरः ..
सोऽश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 13 ..
16.121.m: The man who keeps vigil there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Jyeṣṭha / obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice and rejoices in heaven like a god.

16.121.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jāmadagnyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ- nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 121 ..
16.121.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जामदग्न्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं- नामैकविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 121 ..
16.121.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-first chapter, named 'The description of the māhātmya of Jāmadagnyeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.122.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ citrāṃgadeśvaram ..
tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge dhanurviṃśatibhiḥ sthitam.. 1 ..
16.122.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं चित्रांगदेश्वरम् ..
तस्यैव नैरृते भागे धनुर्विंशतिभिः स्थितम्.. 1 ..
16.122.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga Citrāṅgadeśvara, / situated twenty bow-lengths to the southwest of that very place.

16.122.s:
citrāṃgadena deveśi gaṃdharvapatinā priye ..
kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ jñātvā vai liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam ..
kṛtvā tapo mahāghoraṃ samārādhya maheśvaram .. 2 ..
16.122.d:
चित्रांगदेन देवेशि गंधर्वपतिना प्रिये ..
क्षेत्रं पवित्रं ज्ञात्वा वै लिंगं तत्र प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
कृत्वा तपो महाघोरं समाराध्य महेश्वरम् .. 2 ..
16.122.m: By Citrāṅgada, the lord of Gandharvas, O ruler of the gods, O dear one, / having recognized it as a holy field, the liṅga was established there / after performing terrible austerity and propitiating Maheśvara.

16.122.s:
atha yo bhāvasaṃyuktastalligaṃ saṃprapūjayet ..
gāṃdharvalokamāpnoti gandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 3 ..
16.122.d:
अथ यो भावसंयुक्तस्तल्लिगं संप्रपूजयेत् ..
गांधर्वलोकमाप्नोति गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते .. 3 ..
16.122.m: Now, whoever, endowed with devotion, thoroughly worships that liṅga / reaches the world of the Gandharvas and rejoices together with the Gandharvas.

16.122.s:
tatra śuklatrayodaśyāṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā śivam ..
pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhadhūpairanu kramāt ..
sa prāpnotyakhilaṃ kāmaṃ manasā yadyadīpsitam .. 4 ..
16.122.d:
तत्र शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां संस्नाप्य विधिना शिवम् ..
पूजयेद्विविधैः पुष्पैर्गंधधूपैरनु क्रमात् ..
स प्राप्नोत्यखिलं कामं मनसा यद्यदीप्सितम् .. 4 ..
16.122.m: Having bathed Śiva there according to the injunction on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, / one should worship him with various flowers, perfumes, and incense in proper order; / he obtains all desires, whatever his mind longed for.

16.122.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrāṃgadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 122 ..
16.122.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रांगदेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 122 ..
16.122.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-second chapter, named 'The description of the māhātmya of Citrāṅgadeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.123.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi rāvaṇeśvaramuttamam ..
tasmāddakṣiṇanairṛtye dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam .. 1 ..
16.123.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रावणेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्माद्दक्षिणनैरृत्ये धनुषां षोडशे स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.123.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to excellent Rāvaṇeśvara, / situated sixteen bow-lengths to the south-southwest from there,

16.123.s:
pratiṣṭhitaṃ daśāsyena sarvapātakanāśanam ..
paulastyo rāvaṇo devi rākṣasastu sudāruṇaḥ .. 2 ..
16.123.d:
प्रतिष्ठितं दशास्येन सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
पौलस्त्यो रावणो देवि राक्षसस्तु सुदारुणः .. 2 ..
16.123.m: established by the ten-faced one, destroying all sins. / Rāvaṇa, descendant of Pulastya, O goddess, was a most cruel rākṣasa.

16.123.s:
trailokyavijayākāṅkṣī puṣpakeṇa cacāra ha ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya vimānaṃ tasya puṣpakam.. 3...
16.123.d:
त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी पुष्पकेण चचार ह ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विमानं तस्य पुष्पकम्.. 3...
16.123.m: Desiring victory over the three worlds, he wandered about in the Puṣpaka. / Then at a certain time, his Puṣpaka aerial chariot,

16.123.s:
vrajadvai vyomamārgeṇa niścalaṃ sahasā'bhavat ..
staṃbhitaṃ puṣpakaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo vismayānvitaḥ .. 4 ..
16.123.d:
व्रजद्वै व्योममार्गेण निश्चलं सहसाऽभवत् ..
स्तंभितं पुष्पकं दृष्ट्वा रावणो विस्मयान्वितः .. 4 ..
16.123.m: as it was proceeding along the path of the sky, suddenly became motionless. / Seeing the Puṣpaka brought to a standstill, Rāvaṇa was filled with astonishment.

16.123.s:
prahastaṃ preṣayāmāsa kimidaṃ vraja medinīm ..
ahatā'sya gatiryasmāttrailokye sacarācare .. 5 ..
16.123.d:
प्रहस्तं प्रेषयामास किमिदं व्रज मेदिनीम् ..
अहताऽस्य गतिर्यस्मात्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .. 5 ..
16.123.m: He dispatched Prahasta: 'What is this? Go to the ground; / for its motion is unimpeded in the three worlds with all that moves and is still!'

16.123.s:
tatkasmānniścalaṃ jātaṃ vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ mama ..
athā'sau satvaro devi jagāma vasudhātale .. 6 ..
16.123.d:
तत्कस्मान्निश्चलं जातं विमानं पुष्पकं मम ..
अथाऽसौ सत्वरो देवि जगाम वसुधातले .. 6 ..
16.123.m: "Why then has my Puṣpaka aerial chariot come to a halt?" / Then, O Goddess, he swiftly descended to the surface of the earth. (6)

16.123.s:
apaśyaddevadeveśaṃ śrīsomeśaṃ mahāprabham ..
stūyamānaṃ suragaṇaiḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 7 ..
16.123.d:
अपश्यद्देवदेवेशं श्रीसोमेशं महाप्रभम् ..
स्तूयमानं सुरगणैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 7 ..
16.123.m: He beheld the Lord of the God of gods, the glorious, supremely splendid Someśa, / being praised by hosts of gods in hundreds and thousands. (7)

16.123.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣase ndrāya tatsarvaṃ vistarātpriye ..
prahastaḥ kathayāmāsa yaddṛṣṭaṃ kṣetramadhyataḥ .. 8 ..
16.123.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसे न्द्राय तत्सर्वं विस्तरात्प्रिये ..
प्रहस्तः कथयामास यद्दृष्टं क्षेत्रमध्यतः .. 8 ..
16.123.m: Having seen Him, Prahasta related everything in detail to the king of the rākṣasas, O beloved, / what he had witnessed in the midst of the sacred field. (8)

16.123.s:
.. prahasta uvāca .. ..
rākṣaseśa mahābāho śivakṣetraṃ nijaṃ prabho ..
prabhāseti samākhyātaṃ gaṇagandharvasevitam .. 9 ..
16.123.d:
.. प्रहस्त उवाच .. ..
राक्षसेश महाबाहो शिवक्षेत्रं निजं प्रभो ..
प्रभासेति समाख्यातं गणगन्धर्वसेवितम् .. 9 ..
16.123.m: Prahasta said: / O lord of the rākṣasas, O mighty-armed master! This is Śiva's own sacred field, / known as Prabhāsa, frequented by gaṇas and gandharvas. (9)

16.123.s:
tatra someśvaro devaḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ ..
abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca daṃtolūkhalibhistathā ..
ṛṣibhirvālakhilyaiśca pūjyamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 7.1.123.10 ..
16.123.d:
तत्र सोमेश्वरो देवः स्वयं तिष्ठति शङ्करः ..
अब्भक्षैर्वायुभक्षैश्च दंतोलूखलिभिस्तथा ..
ऋषिभिर्वालखिल्यैश्च पूज्यमानः समंततः .. 7.1.123.10 ..
16.123.m: There Śaṃkara Himself, the divine Someśvara, resides, / worshipped on all sides by water-feeders, air-feeders, / tooth-mortar ascetics, and the Vālakhilya seers. (10)

16.123.s:
prabhāvāttasya devasya nedaṃ gacchati puṣpakam ..
na sa prālaṃghyate devo hyalaṃghyo yaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 11 ..
16.123.d:
प्रभावात्तस्य देवस्य नेदं गच्छति पुष्पकम् ..
न स प्रालंघ्यते देवो ह्यलंघ्यो यः सुरासुरैः .. 11 ..
16.123.m: By the power of that God, this Puṣpaka does not move. / That God is indeed not to be transgressed, who cannot be crossed over even by gods and asuras. (11)

16.123.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
avatīrya dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ someśaṃ samapaśyata .. 12 ..
16.123.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
अवतीर्य धरापृष्ठं सोमेशं समपश्यत .. 12 ..
16.123.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, with eyes wide with wonder, / descending to the surface of the earth, he beheld Someśa. (12)

16.123.s:
pūjayāmāsa deveśi bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
ratnairbahuvidhairvastrairgandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 13 ..
16.123.d:
पूजयामास देवेशि भक्त्या परमया युतः ..
रत्नैर्बहुविधैर्वस्त्रैर्गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 13 ..
16.123.m: Endowed with supreme devotion, he worshipped [Him], O Queen of the gods, / with various gems, garments, perfumes, flowers, and unguents. (13)

16.123.s:
atha paurajanā dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram ..
sarvadikṣu varārohe bhayādbhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ .. 14 ..
16.123.d:
अथ पौरजना दृष्ट्वा रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ..
सर्वदिक्षु वरारोहे भयाद्भीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः .. 14 ..
16.123.m: Then, seeing Rāvaṇa, the lord of the rākṣasas, / the citizens fled in fear in all directions, O fair-hipped lady! (14)

16.123.s:
śūnyaṃ samabhavatsarvaṃ tatra devo vyavasthitaḥ ..
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 15 ..
16.123.d:
शून्यं समभवत्सर्वं तत्र देवो व्यवस्थितः ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 15 ..
16.123.m: Everything became empty [there] where the God resided. / At that very moment, a bodiless voice spoke: (15)

16.123.s:
daśagrīva mahābāho ayane cottare tathā ..
yātrākāle tu devasya sarvapāpapraṇāśane .. 16 ..
16.123.d:
दशग्रीव महाबाहो अयने चोत्तरे तथा ..
यात्राकाले तु देवस्य सर्वपापप्रणाशने .. 16 ..
16.123.m: "O ten-necked, mighty-armed one! At this northern solstice, / during the pilgrimage-time of the God that destroys all sins, (16)

16.123.s:
dūrataḥ samanuprāptā bhūrilokā dvijātayaḥ ..
rākṣasānāṃ bhayādbhītāḥ prayāṃti hi diśo daśa .. 17 ..
16.123.d:
दूरतः समनुप्राप्ता भूरिलोका द्विजातयः ..
राक्षसानां भयाद्भीताः प्रयांति हि दिशो दश .. 17 ..
16.123.m: numerous people and twice-born brahmins have arrived from afar. / Terrified with fear of the rākṣasas, they are fleeing to the ten directions. (17)

16.123.s:
bhayānmā tvaṃ rākṣasendra yātrāvighnakaro bhava ..
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhakye yauvane'pi ca ..
tatsarvaṃ kṣālayenmartyo dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum .. 18 ..
16.123.d:
भयान्मा त्वं राक्षसेन्द्र यात्राविघ्नकरो भव ..
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धक्ये यौवनेऽपि च ..
तत्सर्वं क्षालयेन्मर्त्यो दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम् .. 18 ..
16.123.m: O lord of the rākṣasas, do not be an obstacle to their pilgrimage out of [their] fear! / Whatever sin is committed in childhood, old age, or youth, / a mortal washes it all away upon seeing Lord Someśvara." (18)

16.123.s:
tato'sau rākṣasendrastu gatvaikānte sugahvare ..
liṃgaṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 19 ..
16.123.d:
ततोऽसौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु गत्वैकान्ते सुगह्वरे ..
लिंगं च स्थापयामास भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 19 ..
16.123.m: Then that king of the rākṣasas, going to a solitary, deep cave, / installed a liṅga, endowed with supreme devotion. (19)

16.123.s:
tatastannirato bhūtvā sarvaistai rākṣaseśvaraḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa deveśi upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ .. 7.1.123.20 ..
16.123.d:
ततस्तन्निरतो भूत्वा सर्वैस्तै राक्षसेश्वरः ..
पूजयामास देवेशि उपवासपरायणः .. 7.1.123.20 ..
16.123.m: Then, devoted to it, the lord of the rākṣasas with all his followers, / intent on fasting, worshipped [it], O Queen of the gods. (20)

16.123.s:
cakāra puratastasya gītavādyena jāgaram ..
tato'rdharātrasamaye vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 21 ..
16.123.d:
चकार पुरतस्तस्य गीतवाद्येन जागरम् ..
ततोऽर्धरात्रसमये वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 21 ..
16.123.m: Before it he kept a night vigil with singing and instrumental music. / Then, at midnight, a bodiless voice spoke: (21)

16.123.s:
daśagrīva mahābāho parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha ..
mama prasādāttrailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ te bhaviṣyati ..
atra saṃnihito nityaṃ sthāsyāmyahamasaṃśayam .. .. 22 ..
16.123.d:
दशग्रीव महाबाहो परितुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ ..
मम प्रसादात्त्रैलोक्यं वशगं ते भविष्यति ..
अत्र संनिहितो नित्यं स्थास्याम्यहमसंशयम् .. .. 22 ..
16.123.m: "O ten-necked, mighty-armed one, I am well pleased with you, O sinless one! / By my grace, the three worlds will come under your control. / I will undoubtedly dwell here always present. (22)

16.123.s:
ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ bhaktiyutā narāḥ ..
ajeyāste bhaviṣyaṃti śatrūṇāṃ rākṣaseśvara .. 23 ..
16.123.d:
ये चैतत्पूजयिष्यंति लिंगं भक्तियुता नराः ..
अजेयास्ते भविष्यंति शत्रूणां राक्षसेश्वर .. 23 ..
16.123.m: And whatever men worship this liṅga with devotion, / they will be invincible to their enemies, O lord of the rākṣasas! (23)

16.123.s:
yāsyaṃti paramāṃ siddhiṃ matprasādādasaṃśayam ..
evamuktvā varārohe virarāma vṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 24 ..
16.123.d:
यास्यंति परमां सिद्धिं मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् ..
एवमुक्त्वा वरारोहे विरराम वृषध्वजः .. 24 ..
16.123.m: They will attain supreme perfection by my grace, without a doubt." / Having spoken thus, O fair-hipped lady, the Bull-bannered Lord fell silent. (24)

16.123.s:
rāvaṇo'pi sa saṃtuṣṭo bhūyobhūyo maheśvaram ..
pūjayitvā ca talliṃgaṃ samāruhya ca puṣpakam ..
trailokyavijayākāṃkṣī iṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha .. 25 ..
16.123.d:
रावणोऽपि स संतुष्टो भूयोभूयो महेश्वरम् ..
पूजयित्वा च तल्लिंगं समारुह्य च पुष्पकम् ..
त्रैलोक्यविजयाकांक्षी इष्टं देशं जगाम ह .. 25 ..
16.123.m: Rāvaṇa too, highly pleased, worshipped Maheśvara again and again / and that liṅga, mounted the Puṣpaka, / and, desiring victory over the three worlds, went to his desired region. (25)

16.123.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāvaṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayorviśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 123 ..
16.123.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रावणेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोर्विशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 123 ..
16.123.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-third chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Rāvaṇeśvara," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. (123)

16.124.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gaurīṃ saubhāgyadāyinīm ..
paścime rāvaṇeśasya dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitām .. 1 ..
16.124.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गौरीं सौभाग्यदायिनीम् ..
पश्चिमे रावणेशस्य धनुषां पञ्चके स्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.124.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should proceed, O great Goddess, to Gaurī, the bestower of conjugal felicity, / situated five bow-lengths to the west of Rāvaṇeśa, (1)

16.124.s:
yatrātapyattapo ghoraṃ svayaṃ devī hyaruṃdhatī ..
saubhāgyaṃ kāṃkṣamāṇā sā gaurīpūjāparāyaṇā .. 2 ..
16.124.d:
यत्रातप्यत्तपो घोरं स्वयं देवी ह्यरुंधती ..
सौभाग्यं कांक्षमाणा सा गौरीपूजापरायणा .. 2 ..
16.124.m: where Lady Arundhatī herself performed terrible austerity, / desiring conjugal felicity, devoted to the worship of Gaurī. (2)

16.124.s:
saṃprāptā paramāṃ siddhiṃ tasyā devyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklapakṣe māghe māsi varānane .. 3 ..
16.124.d:
संप्राप्ता परमां सिद्धिं तस्या देव्याः प्रभावतः ..
तृतीयायां शुक्लपक्षे माघे मासि वरानने .. 3 ..
16.124.m: She attained supreme perfection by the power of that goddess. / On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha, O fair-faced lady, (3)

16.124.s:
yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt..
anyajanmani deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 4 ..
16.124.d:
यस्तां पूजयते भक्त्या स सौभाग्यमवाप्नुयात्..
अन्यजन्मनि देवेशि नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 4 ..
16.124.m: whoever worships her with devotion attains conjugal felicity / in another birth, O Queen of the gods; there should be no doubt about this. (4)

16.124.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saubhāgyeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..124..
16.124.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सौभाग्येश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..124..
16.124.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Saubhāgyeśvarī," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. (124)

16.125.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi surapriyam ..
rāvaṇeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśake'ntare .. 1 ..
16.125.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महालिंगं महादेवि सुरप्रियम् ..
रावणेश्वरवायव्ये धनुषां त्रिंशकेऽन्तरे .. 1 ..
16.125.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great Goddess, to the great liṅga dear to the gods, / located at a distance of thirty bow-lengths to the north-west of Rāvaṇeśvara. (1)

16.125.s:
sthitaṃ kāmapradaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
paulomīśvaranāmāḍhacaṃ paulomyā saṃpratiṣṭhitam .. 2 ..
16.125.d:
स्थितं कामप्रदं लिंगं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
पौलोमीश्वरनामाढचं पौलोम्या संप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 2 ..
16.125.m: It is a wish-fulfilling liṅga that destroys all sins, / celebrated by the name Paulomīśvara, duly installed by Paulomī. (2)

16.125.s:
tārakeṇa yadā dhvastāstridaśāḥ saṃgare sthitāḥ ..
trailokyaṃ vihṛtaṃ sarvaṃ svayamindratvamāgataḥ .. 3 ..
16.125.d:
तारकेण यदा ध्वस्तास्त्रिदशाः संगरे स्थिताः ..
त्रैलोक्यं विहृतं सर्वं स्वयमिन्द्रत्वमागतः .. 3 ..
16.125.m: When the gods assembled in battle were destroyed by Tāraka, / and the three worlds were all seized, he himself assumed the rank of Indra. (3)

16.125.s:
tadā śakraḥ suduḥkhārto bhayodvigno nanāśa vai ..
tadā tadbhāryayā devi indrāṇyā śokakarṣayā .. 4 ..
16.125.d:
तदा शक्रः सुदुःखार्तो भयोद्विग्नो ननाश वै ..
तदा तद्भार्यया देवि इन्द्राण्या शोककर्षया .. 4 ..
16.125.m: Then Śakra, tormented by deep grief and agitated with fear, indeed disappeared. / Then, O Goddess, by his wife Indrāṇī, wasted by sorrow, (4)

16.125.s:
indrasya jayamicchantyā śaṃbhurārādhitastayā ..
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastāmuvāca śubhekṣaṇām.. 5 ..
16.125.d:
इन्द्रस्य जयमिच्छन्त्या शंभुराराधितस्तया ..
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तामुवाच शुभेक्षणाम्.. 5 ..
16.125.m: Śambhu was propitiated by her as she desired Indra's victory. / Then, pleased, the Great God spoke to that auspicious-eyed lady: (5)

16.125.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
utpatsyati suto'smākaṃ ṣaṇmukhastu mahābalaḥ ..
tārakaṃ daityarājānaṃ sa cainaṃ ghātayiṣyati .. 6 ..
16.125.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
उत्पत्स्यति सुतोऽस्माकं षण्मुखस्तु महाबलः ..
तारकं दैत्यराजानं स चैनं घातयिष्यति .. 6 ..
16.125.m: The Blessed Lord said: / A mighty son of ours with six faces will be born, / and he will slay this Tāraka, the king of the daityas. (6)

16.125.s: gaccha tvaṃ vijvarā bhūtvā śṛṇu bhūyo vacaśca me .. 7 ..
16.125.d: गच्छ त्वं विज्वरा भूत्वा शृणु भूयो वचश्च मे .. 7 ..
16.125.m: Go, freed from feverish anxiety, and hear further my word: (7)

16.125.s:
atra sthitamidaṃ liṃgaṃ yo'smākaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
sa nūnaṃ me gaṇo bhūtvā matsakāśamupeṣyati .. 8 ..
16.125.d:
अत्र स्थितमिदं लिंगं योऽस्माकं पूजयिष्यति ..
स नूनं मे गणो भूत्वा मत्सकाशमुपेष्यति .. 8 ..
16.125.m: Whoever among our people worships this liṅga situated here / will surely become my attendant and approach my presence. (8)

16.125.s:
evamuktā gatā sādhvī devarāḍyatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
sarvadduḥkhavinirmuktā sarvadaityabhayojjhitā .. 9 ..
16.125.d:
एवमुक्ता गता साध्वी देवराड्यत्र संस्थितः ..
सर्वद्दुःखविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वदैत्यभयोज्झिता .. 9 ..
16.125.m: Thus addressed, the virtuous woman went to where the king of gods resided, / completely freed from all sorrow and rid of all fear of the daityas. (9)

16.125.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye paulomośvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 125 ..
16.125.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पौलोमोश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 125 ..
16.125.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Paulomīśvara," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses. (125)

16.126.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śāṃḍilyeśvaramuttamam ..
brahmaṇaḥ paścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃtare .. 1 ..
16.126.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शांडिल्येश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
ब्रह्मणः पश्चिमे भागे धनुषां षोडशांतरे .. 1 ..
16.126.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should proceed, O great Goddess, to the excellent Śāṇḍilyeśvara, / located sixteen bow-lengths to the west of Brahmā. (1)
That liṅga is of great power, destroying sin by its mere darśana. (2)

16.126.s:
śāṃḍilyonāma brahmarṣiḥ sārathirbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tapasvī sa mahātejā jñānaniṣṭho jitendriyaḥ .. 3 ..
16.126.d:
शांडिल्योनाम ब्रह्मर्षिः सारथिर्ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः ..
तपस्वी स महातेजा ज्ञाननिष्ठो जितेन्द्रियः .. 3 ..
16.126.m: A brahmin-seer named Śāṇḍilya is remembered as the charioteer of Brahmā; / he was an ascetic of great splendor, steadfast in wisdom, who had conquered his senses. (3)

16.126.s:
sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam ..
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ someśāduttare sthitam .. 4 ..
16.126.d:
स प्रभासं समासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् ..
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिंगं सोमेशादुत्तरे स्थितम् .. 4 ..
16.126.m: Having reached Prabhāsa, he performed terrible austerity, / having installed a great liṅga situated to the north of Someśa. (4)

16.126.s:
sa svayaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye ..
tato'bhilaṣitaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha .. 5 ..
16.126.d:
स स्वयं पूजयामास दिव्याब्दानां शतं प्रिये ..
ततोऽभिलषितं प्राप्य कृतकृत्यो बभूव ह .. 5 ..
16.126.m: He personally worshipped [it] for a hundred divine years, O beloved; / then, having attained what he desired, he became one who had fulfilled his purpose.

16.126.s:
nandīśvaraprasādena aṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu naraḥ sadyo vipāpaḥ saṃprajāyate .. 6 ..
16.126.d:
नन्दीश्वरप्रसादेन अणिमादिगुणैर्युतः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा तु नरः सद्यो विपापः संप्रजायते .. 6 ..
16.126.m: Through the grace of Nandīśvara, he was endowed with the virtues [beginning with] atom-like minuteness and the rest. / But upon seeing that [liṅga], a man instantly becomes free from sin.

16.126.s:
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārdhakye yauvane'pi vā ..
ajñānājjñānato vā'pi yaḥ karoti naraḥ priye ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti śāṃḍilyeśvaradarśanāt .. 7 ..
16.126.d:
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्धक्ये यौवनेऽपि वा ..
अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतो वाऽपि यः करोति नरः प्रिये ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति शांडिल्येश्वरदर्शनात् .. 7 ..
16.126.m: Whatever sin a man commits in childhood, in old age, or in youth, / either through ignorance or knowingly, O beloved, / all of it goes to destruction from the darśana of Śāṇḍilyeśvara.

16.126.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye śāṇḍilyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 126 ..
16.126.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शाण्डिल्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 126 ..
16.126.m: Thus, in the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the description of the greatness of Śāṇḍilyeśvara, being the one hundred twenty-sixth chapter. 126.

16.127.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kṣemeśvaramanuttamam ..
tasmāduttarakoṇasthaṃ kapāleśāgnigocare .. 1 ..
16.127.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि क्षेमेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्मादुत्तरकोणस्थं कपालेशाग्निगोचरे .. 1 ..
16.127.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Kṣemeśvara, / situated in the northern corner from there, in the range of Kapāleśa's south-east direction.

16.127.s:
dhanuṣāṃ paṃcadaśake kapāleśvarataḥ sthitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.127.d:
धनुषां पंचदशके कपालेश्वरतः स्थितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.127.m: Situated at fifteen bows from Kapāleśvara, / that liṅga is indeed of great efficacy, destroying all sins.

16.127.s:
kṣemamūrtiḥ purā rājā babhūva sa mahābalaḥ ..
tena tatra tapastaptaṃ cirakālaṃ mahātmanā .. .. 3 ..
16.127.d:
क्षेममूर्तिः पुरा राजा बभूव स महाबलः ..
तेन तत्र तपस्तप्तं चिरकालं महात्मना .. .. 3 ..
16.127.m: In ancient times there was a king, Kṣemamūrti, of great strength; / by that great-souled one, tapas was performed there for a long time.

16.127.s:
tataḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā bhāvitacetasā ..
taddṛṣṭvā kṣemamāyāti kāryaṃ kṣemeṇa siddhyati .. 4 ..
16.127.d:
ततः संस्थापितं लिंगं भक्त्या भावितचेतसा ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा क्षेममायाति कार्यं क्षेमेण सिद्ध्यति .. 4 ..
16.127.m: Then the liṅga was installed by him with devotion, his mind concentrated. / Having seen it, one attains well-being; one's undertaking succeeds with security.

16.127.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā bhūyā jjanmanijanmani ..
evaṃ kṣemeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ khyātaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 5 ..
16.127.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा भूया ज्जन्मनिजन्मनि ..
एवं क्षेमेश्वरं लिंगं ख्यातं पातकनाशनम् .. 5 ..
16.127.m: He becomes abundant in all desires birth after birth. / Thus the liṅga Kṣemeśvara is famed as destroying sins,

16.127.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam ..
darśanenāpi tasyāpi gośatasya phalaṃ smṛtam .. 6 ..
16.127.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां श्रुतं सौभाग्यदायकम् ..
दर्शनेनापि तस्यापि गोशतस्य फलं स्मृतम् .. 6 ..
16.127.m: granting all desires to men, and heard to bestow good fortune. / Even by the darśana of it, the fruit of a hundred cows is taught.
Therefore, one desiring the fruit of the sacred field should constantly resort to that liṅga.

16.127.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣemaṃkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 127 ..
16.127.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये क्षेमंकरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 127 ..
16.127.m: Thus, in the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the description of the greatness of Kṣemaṃkareśvara, being the one hundred twenty-seventh chapter. 127.

16.128.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sāgarādityamuttamam ..
bhairaveśātpaścimato rudrānmṛtyuñjayāttathā .. 1 ..
16.128.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सागरादित्यमुत्तमम् ..
भैरवेशात्पश्चिमतो रुद्रान्मृत्युञ्जयात्तथा .. 1 ..
16.128.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Sāgarāditya, / to the west of Bhairaveśa and likewise of Rudra Mṛtyuñjaya,

16.128.s:
kāmeśāddakṣiṇāgneye nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
sarva rogapraśamanaṃ dāridryaughavighātakam ..
pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahādevi sagareṇa mahātmanā .. 2 ..
16.128.d:
कामेशाद्दक्षिणाग्नेये नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
सर्व रोगप्रशमनं दारिद्र्यौघविघातकम् ..
प्रतिष्ठितं महादेवि सगरेण महात्मना .. 2 ..
16.128.m: located not far to the south-southeast of Kāmeśa; / it allays all diseases and destroys floods of poverty, / installed, O great goddess, by the great-souled Sagara,

16.128.s:
ṣaṣṭiputrasahasrāṇi yaḥ prāpārātisūdanaḥ ..
sūryaṃ tatra samārādhya sagaraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 3 ..
16.128.d:
षष्टिपुत्रसहस्राणि यः प्रापारातिसूदनः ..
सूर्यं तत्र समाराध्य सगरः पृथिवीपतिः .. 3 ..
16.128.m: that destroyer of foes who obtained sixty thousand sons, / having properly worshipped the Sun there, Sagara the lord of the earth.

16.128.s:
ya eṣa sāgaro devi yojanāyatavistaraḥ ..
āyato'śītisāhasraṃ yojanānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ .. 4 ..
16.128.d:
य एष सागरो देवि योजनायतविस्तरः ..
आयतोऽशीतिसाहस्रं योजनानां प्रकीर्तितः .. 4 ..
16.128.m: This ocean, O goddess, which is a yojana in extent and breadth, / is proclaimed to extend eighty thousand yojanas;

16.128.s:
asminmanvantare kṣiptaḥ sāgaraiśca caturdiśam ..
tasyedaṃ kīrtitaṃ devi nāma sāgarasaṃjñitam .. 5 ..
16.128.d:
अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे क्षिप्तः सागरैश्च चतुर्दिशम् ..
तस्येदं कीर्तितं देवि नाम सागरसंज्ञितम् .. 5 ..
16.128.m: in this manvantara it was dug in the four directions by the sons of Sagara; / therefore its name, known as Sāgara, has been proclaimed, O goddess.

16.128.s:
yasyādyāpīha gāyanti purāṇe prathitaṃ yaśaḥ ..
tenāyaṃ sthāpito devo bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ .. 6 ..
16.128.d:
यस्याद्यापीह गायन्ति पुराणे प्रथितं यशः ..
तेनायं स्थापितो देवो भास्करो वारितस्करः .. 6 ..
16.128.m: Whose renown, famous in the Purāṇa, they sing of here even today; / by him this god Bhāskara, the stealer of waters, was installed.

16.128.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāndho na daridro na duḥkhitaḥ ..
na caiveṣṭaviyogī syānna rogī naiva pāpakṛt .. 7 ..
16.128.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा न जडो नान्धो न दरिद्रो न दुःखितः ..
न चैवेष्टवियोगी स्यान्न रोगी नैव पापकृत् .. 7 ..
16.128.m: Having seen him, one does not become dull, nor blind, nor poor, nor sorrowful; / nor would one suffer separation from loved ones, nor fall ill, nor commit sin.

16.128.s:
māghe māsi mahādevi site pakṣe jitendriyaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito bhūtvā rātrau tasyāgrataḥ svapet .. 8 ..
16.128.d:
माघे मासि महादेवि सिते पक्षे जितेन्द्रियः ..
षष्ठ्यामुपोषितो भूत्वा रात्रौ तस्याग्रतः स्वपेत् .. 8 ..
16.128.m: In the month of Māgha, O great goddess, in the bright fortnight, with senses restrained, / having fasted on the sixth [tithi], one should sleep at night in front of him.

16.128.s:
vibuddhastvatha saptamyāṃ bhaktyā bhānuṃ samarcayet ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet .. 9 ..
16.128.d:
विबुद्धस्त्वथ सप्तम्यां भक्त्या भानुं समर्चयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्भक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् .. 9 ..
16.128.m: Having awakened on the seventh, one should worship the Sun with devotion; / one should feed brahmins with devotion and avoid deceit with regard to wealth.

16.128.s:
sutapteneha tapasā yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ ..
tāṃ gatiṃ na narā yānti yāṃ gatāḥ sūryamāśritāḥ .. 7.1.128.10 ..
16.128.d:
सुतप्तेनेह तपसा यज्ञैर्वा बहुदक्षिणैः ..
तां गतिं न नरा यान्ति यां गताः सूर्यमाश्रिताः .. 7.1.128.10 ..
16.128.m: Men do not attain through well-performed tapas here, or through sacrifices with abundant priestly fees, / that destination which they reach who have taken refuge in the Sun.

16.128.s:
bhaktyā tu puruṣaiḥ pūjā kṛtā dūrvāṃkurairapi ..
bhānurdadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham .. 11 ..
16.128.d:
भक्त्या तु पुरुषैः पूजा कृता दूर्वांकुरैरपि ..
भानुर्ददाति हि फलं सर्वयज्ञैः सुदुर्लभम् .. 11 ..
16.128.m: Even when worship is performed with devotion by men using only sprouts of dūrvā grass, / the Sun indeed gives a fruit very difficult to attain through all sacrifices.

16.128.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sūryamevābhipūjayet ..
janakādayo yathā siddhiṃ gatā bhānuṃ prapūjya ca .. 12 ..
16.128.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन सूर्यमेवाभिपूजयेत् ..
जनकादयो यथा सिद्धिं गता भानुं प्रपूज्य च .. 12 ..
16.128.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should indeed worship the Sun, / just as Janaka and others attained perfection having worshipped the Sun.

16.128.s:
sarvātmā sarvalokeśo devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
sūrya eva trilokasya mūlaṃ paramadaivatam .. 13 ..
16.128.d:
सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो देवदेवः प्रजापतिः ..
सूर्य एव त्रिलोकस्य मूलं परमदैवतम् .. 13 ..
16.128.m: The Self of all, the lord of all worlds, the god of gods, Prajāpati; / the Sun alone is the root and supreme deity of the three worlds.

16.128.s:
vasante kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ ..
śvetavarṇaśca varṣāsu pāṃḍuḥ śaradi bhāskaraḥ .. 14 ..
16.128.d:
वसन्ते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मे काञ्चनसप्रभः ..
श्वेतवर्णश्च वर्षासु पांडुः शरदि भास्करः .. 14 ..
16.128.m: In spring the Sun is tawny; in summer he has the radiance of gold; / in the rainy season he is white in color; and in autumn the Sun is pale.

16.128.s:
hemante tāmravarṇastu śiśire lohito raviḥ ..
evaṃ varṇaviśeṣeṇa dhyāyetsūryaṃ yathākramam .. 15 ..
16.128.d:
हेमन्ते ताम्रवर्णस्तु शिशिरे लोहितो रविः ..
एवं वर्णविशेषेण ध्यायेत्सूर्यं यथाक्रमम् .. 15 ..
16.128.m: In early winter he is copper-colored, and in winter the Sun is blood-red; / thus according to the distinction of colors one should meditate on the Sun in due order.

16.128.s:
pūjayitvā vidhānena yatātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ ..
paṭhennāmasahasraṃ tu sarvapātakanāśanam .. .. 16 ..
16.128.d:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन यतात्मा संयतेन्द्रियः ..
पठेन्नामसहस्रं तु सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. .. 16 ..
16.128.m: Having worshipped him according to the injunctions, self-restrained and with controlled senses, / one should recite the thousand names that destroy all sins.

16.128.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ me brūhi prasādāñchaṃkara prabho ..
tulyaṃ nāmasahasrasya kimapyanyatprakīrtaya .. 17 ..
16.128.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
नाम्नां सहस्रं मे ब्रूहि प्रसादाञ्छंकर प्रभो ..
तुल्यं नामसहस्रस्य किमप्यन्यत्प्रकीर्तय .. 17 ..
16.128.m: The goddess said: / Tell me the thousand names through [your] favor, O Lord Śaṃkara; / or proclaim something else that is equal to the thousand names.

16.128.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
alaṃ nāmasahasreṇa paṭhasvaivaṃ śubhaṃ stavam ..
yāni guhyāni nāmāni pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca ..
tāni te kīrtayiṣyāmi prayatnādavadhāraya .. 18 ..
16.128.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अलं नामसहस्रेण पठस्वैवं शुभं स्तवम् ..
यानि गुह्यानि नामानि पवित्राणि शुभानि च ..
तानि ते कीर्तयिष्यामि प्रयत्नादवधारय .. 18 ..
16.128.m: Īśvara said: / Enough with the thousand names; recite this auspicious hymn of praise! / Those names which are secret, pure, and auspicious, / those I shall proclaim to you; listen attentively with effort:

16.128.s:
vikartano vivasvāṃśca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ ..
lokaprakāśakaḥ śrīmām̐llokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ .. 19 ..
16.128.d:
विकर्तनो विवस्वांश्च मार्तण्डो भास्करो रविः ..
लोकप्रकाशकः श्रीमाम्̐ल्लोकचक्षुर्ग्रहेश्वरः .. 19 ..
16.128.m: Vikartana, Vivasvat, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Ravi, / Illuminator of the World, the Glorious One, Eye of the World, Lord of Planets,

16.128.s:
lokasākṣī trilokeśaḥ karttā harttā tamisrahā ..
tapanastāpanaścaiva śuciḥ saptāśvavāhanaḥ .. 7.1.128.20 ..
16.128.d:
लोकसाक्षी त्रिलोकेशः कर्त्ता हर्त्ता तमिस्रहा ..
तपनस्तापनश्चैव शुचिः सप्ताश्ववाहनः .. 7.1.128.20 ..
16.128.m: Witness of the World, Lord of the Three Worlds, Creator, Destroyer, Dispeller of Darkness, / Burning One, Scorching One, Pure One, Having Seven Horses as His Vehicle,

16.128.s:
gabhastihasto brahmā ca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ..
ekaviṃśatirityeṣa stava iṣṭo mahātmanaḥ .. 21 ..
16.128.d:
गभस्तिहस्तो ब्रह्मा च सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ..
एकविंशतिरित्येष स्तव इष्टो महात्मनः .. 21 ..
16.128.m: Ray-Handed, Brahmā, and Revered by All the Gods: / this twenty-one-fold hymn of praise is beloved of that great-souled one.

16.128.s:
śarīrārogyadaścaiva dhanavṛddhiyaśaskaraḥ ..
