stavarāja iti khyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ .. .. 22 ..
16.128.d:
शरीरारोग्यदश्चैव धनवृद्धियशस्करः ..
स्तवराज इति ख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः .. .. 22 ..
16.128.m: It bestows bodily health, increases wealth, and brings renown; / it is known as the King of Hymns, celebrated throughout the three worlds.

16.128.s:
yaścānena mahādevi dve saṃdhye'stamanodaye ..
stautyarkaṃ prayato bhūtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 23 ..
16.128.d:
यश्चानेन महादेवि द्वे संध्येऽस्तमनोदये ..
स्तौत्यर्कं प्रयतो भूत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति .. 23 ..
16.128.m: And whoever, O great goddess, having become pure, praises the Sun with this / at both twilight junctions—at setting and rising—is freed from all sins; / abundant in all desires, he goes to the world of the Sun.

16.128.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sāgarārkajam ..
śrutaṃ duḥkhaughaśamanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 24 ..
16.128.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं सागरार्कजम् ..
श्रुतं दुःखौघशमनं महापातकनाशनम् .. 24 ..
16.128.m: In this manner, O goddess, the greatness arising from Sāgarārka has been told, / which when heard pacifies floods of sorrow and destroys great sins.

16.128.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāgarādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 128 ..
16.128.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सागरादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 128 ..
16.128.m: Thus, in the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the description of the greatness of Sāgarāditya, being the one hundred twenty-eighth chapter. 128.

16.129.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi akṣamāleśvaraṃ param ..
sāgarārkādīśakoṇe paṃcāśaddhanuṣāntare .. 1 ..
16.129.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अक्षमालेश्वरं परम् ..
सागरार्कादीशकोणे पंचाशद्धनुषान्तरे .. 1 ..
16.129.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Akṣamāleśvara, / in the northeast corner from Sāgarārka, at a distance of fifty bows.

16.129.s:
saṃsthitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ yugaliṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
akṣamāleśvaraṃnāma purā tasya prakīrtitam ..
ugraseneśvaraṃ nāma khyātaṃ tasyaiva sāmpratam .. 2..
16.129.d:
संस्थितं पापशमनं युगलिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
अक्षमालेश्वरंनाम पुरा तस्य प्रकीर्तितम् ..
उग्रसेनेश्वरं नाम ख्यातं तस्यैव साम्प्रतम् .. 2..
16.129.m: Situated [there] is a pair of liṅgas of great splendour that pacifies sin; / formerly its name was proclaimed as Akṣamāleśvara, / [and] now that very [liṅga] is famous under the name Ugraseneśvara.

16.129.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
akṣamāleśvaraṃ nāma yatpūrvaṃ samudāhṛtam ..
kathaṃ tadabhavaddeva kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 3 ..
16.129.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अक्षमालेश्वरं नाम यत्पूर्वं समुदाहृतम् ..
कथं तदभवद्देव कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 3 ..
16.129.m: The Goddess said: / The name Akṣamāleśvara, which was previously mentioned, / how did that come about, O God? Please tell me through your grace.

16.129.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā mahādevi satī cādha mayonijā ..
akṣamāleti vai nāmnā satīdharmaparāyaṇā .. 4 ..
16.129.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरा महादेवि सती चाध मयोनिजा ..
अक्षमालेति वै नाम्ना सतीधर्मपरायणा .. 4 ..
16.129.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly, O great goddess, there was a chaste woman born from a base womb, / Akṣamālā by name, devoted to the duties of a chaste wife.

16.129.s:
kadācitsamanuprāpte durbhikṣe kālaparyayāt ..
ṛṣayaśca mahādevi kṣudhākrāntā vicetasaḥ .. 5 ..
16.129.d:
कदाचित्समनुप्राप्ते दुर्भिक्षे कालपर्ययात् ..
ऋषयश्च महादेवि क्षुधाक्रान्ता विचेतसः .. 5 ..
16.129.m: Once, when a famine occurred through the turning of time, / the seers, O great goddess, overcome by hunger, lost their senses.

16.129.s:
sarve cānnaṃ parīpsaṃto gatāścaṇḍālaveśmani ..
jñātvānnasaṃgrahaṃ tasya prārthayāñcakrurantyajam .. 6 ..
16.129.d:
सर्वे चान्नं परीप्संतो गताश्चण्डालवेश्मनि ..
ज्ञात्वान्नसंग्रहं तस्य प्रार्थयाञ्चक्रुरन्त्यजम् .. 6 ..
16.129.m: All desiring to obtain food, they went to the house of an outcaste. / Learning that he had a store of grain, they begged the outcaste:

16.129.s:
bhobho'ntyaja mahābuddhe rakṣāsmānannadānataḥ ..
prāṇasaṃdehamāpannānkṛśāṃgānkṣutprapīḍitān .. 7 ..
16.129.d:
भोभोऽन्त्यज महाबुद्धे रक्षास्मानन्नदानतः ..
प्राणसंदेहमापन्नान्कृशांगान्क्षुत्प्रपीडितान् .. 7 ..
16.129.m: “O outcaste, O you of great understanding, save us by giving food, / who have reached danger of our lives, whose limbs are emaciated, tormented by hunger!

16.129.s:
aho dhanyo'si pūjyo'si na tvamantyaja ucyase ..
yadasminpralaye yāte sthitaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhe tava .. 8 ..
16.129.d:
अहो धन्योऽसि पूज्योऽसि न त्वमन्त्यज उच्यसे ..
यदस्मिन्प्रलये याते स्थितं धान्यं गृहे तव .. 8 ..
16.129.m: Ah, you are blessed, you are worthy of honor; you are not called an outcaste, / since, when this dissolution has arrived, grain remains in your house!

16.129.s:
anāvṛṣṭihate deśe sasye ca pralayaṃ gate ..
ekaṃ yo bhojayedvipraṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 9 ..
16.129.d:
अनावृष्टिहते देशे सस्ये च प्रलयं गते ..
एकं यो भोजयेद्विप्रं कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 9 ..
16.129.m: When the land is struck by drought and the crops have perished, / whoever feeds one brahmin, it is as if ten million have been fed.”

16.129.s:
.. antyaja uvāca ..
aho āścaryamatulaṃ yadetaddṛśyate'dhunā ..
yadetanmadgṛhaṃ prāptā ṛṣayaścānnakāṃkṣiṇaḥ .. 7.1.129.10 ..
16.129.d:
.. अन्त्यज उवाच ..
अहो आश्चर्यमतुलं यदेतद्दृश्यतेऽधुना ..
यदेतन्मद्गृहं प्राप्ता ऋषयश्चान्नकांक्षिणः .. 7.1.129.10 ..
16.129.m: The outcaste said: / “Ah, what an incomparable marvel is seen here now, / that these seers have arrived at my house desiring food!

16.129.s: śūdrānnamapi nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kimutāntyajāt .. 11 ..
16.129.d: शूद्रान्नमपि नादेयं ब्राह्मणैः किमुतान्त्यजात् .. 11 ..
16.129.m: Even the food of a śūdra is not to be taken by brahmins, how much less from an outcaste?

16.129.s:
āmaṃ vā yadi vā pakvaṃ śūdrānnaṃ yastu bhakṣati ..
sa bhavecchūkaro grāmyastasya vā jāyate kule .. 12 ..
16.129.d:
आमं वा यदि वा पक्वं शूद्रान्नं यस्तु भक्षति ..
स भवेच्छूकरो ग्राम्यस्तस्य वा जायते कुले .. 12 ..
16.129.m: Whether raw or cooked, whoever eats the food of a śūdra / becomes a village pig, or is born into that [pig’s] family.

16.129.s:
amṛtaṃ bāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam ..
vaiśyānnamannamityāhuḥ śūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam .. 13 ..
16.129.d:
अमृतं बाह्मणस्यान्नं क्षत्रियान्नं पयः स्मृतम् ..
वैश्यान्नमन्नमित्याहुः शूद्रान्नं रुधिरं स्मृतम् .. 13 ..
16.129.m: The food of a brahmin is considered nectar; the food of a kṣatriya is milk; / they say the food of a vaiśya is [mere] food; the food of a śūdra is regarded as blood.

16.129.s:
śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa ca sahāsanam ..
śūdrādannāgamaścaiva jvalaṃtamapi pātayet .. 14 ..
16.129.d:
शूद्रान्नं शूद्रसंपर्कं शूद्रेण च सहासनम् ..
शूद्रादन्नागमश्चैव ज्वलंतमपि पातयेत् .. 14 ..
16.129.m: A śūdra's food, contact with a śūdra, sitting together with a śūdra, / and the receipt of food from a śūdra will bring down even a blazing [sage].

16.129.s:
agnihotrī tu yo vipraḥ śūdrānnānna nivartate ..
ete tasya praṇaśyaṃti ātmā brahma trayo'gnayaḥ .. 15 ..
16.129.d:
अग्निहोत्री तु यो विप्रः शूद्रान्नान्न निवर्तते ..
एते तस्य प्रणश्यंति आत्मा ब्रह्म त्रयोऽग्नयः .. 15 ..
16.129.m: A brahmin who maintains the sacred fire, if he does not turn away from a śūdra's food, / these perish for him: his self, the Veda, and the three sacred fires.

16.129.s:
śūdrānnenodarasthena brāhmaṇo mriyate yadi ..
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare vipraḥ piśācaḥ so'bhijāyate .. 16 ..
16.129.d:
शूद्रान्नेनोदरस्थेन ब्राह्मणो म्रियते यदि ..
षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे विप्रः पिशाचः सोऽभिजायते .. 16 ..
16.129.m: If a brahmin dies with the food of a śūdra remaining in his stomach, / that brahmin within six months is reborn as a piśāca.

16.129.s:
śūdrānnena dvijo yastu agnihotraṃ juhoti ca ..
caṇḍālo jāyate pretya śūdrāccaiveha daivataḥ .. 17 ..
16.129.d:
शूद्रान्नेन द्विजो यस्तु अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति च ..
चण्डालो जायते प्रेत्य शूद्राच्चैवेह दैवतः .. 17 ..
16.129.m: A twice-born who performs the agnihotra offering with the food of a śūdra / is born after death as an outcaste, and in this life his deity becomes a śūdra.

16.129.s:
yastu bhuñjati śūdrānnaṃ māsamekaṃ nirantaram..
iha janmani śūdratvaṃ mṛtaḥ śūdro'bhijāyate .. 18 ..
16.129.d:
यस्तु भुञ्जति शूद्रान्नं मासमेकं निरन्तरम्..
इह जन्मनि शूद्रत्वं मृतः शूद्रोऽभिजायते .. 18 ..
16.129.m: Whoever eats the food of a śūdra continuously for a month / attains the state of a śūdra in this life, and dying, is reborn a śūdra.

16.129.s:
rājānnaṃ teja ādatte śūdrānnaṃ brahmavarcasam..
āyuḥ suvarṇakārānnaṃ yaśaścarmāvakartinaḥ .. 19 ..
16.129.d:
राजान्नं तेज आदत्ते शूद्रान्नं ब्रह्मवर्चसम्..
आयुः सुवर्णकारान्नं यशश्चर्मावकर्तिनः .. 19 ..
16.129.m: A king's food takes away splendor; a śūdra's food takes away sacred luster; / a goldsmith's food takes away longevity; a leather-cutter's food takes away fame.

16.129.s:
kārukānnaṃ prajā hanti balaṃ nirṇejakasya ca ..
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca lokebhyaḥ parikṛntati .. 7.1.129.20 ..
16.129.d:
कारुकान्नं प्रजा हन्ति बलं निर्णेजकस्य च ..
गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च लोकेभ्यः परिकृन्तति .. 7.1.129.20 ..
16.129.m: An artisan's food destroys offspring; a washerman's food destroys strength; / the food of a guild and the food of a courtesan cut one off from the [heavenly] worlds.

16.129.s:
pūyaṃ cikitsakasyānnaṃ puṃścalyāścānnamindriyam..
viṣṭhā vārdhuṣikasyānnaṃ śastravikrayiṇo malam .. 21 ..
16.129.d:
पूयं चिकित्सकस्यान्नं पुंश्चल्याश्चान्नमिन्द्रियम्..
विष्ठा वार्धुषिकस्यान्नं शस्त्रविक्रयिणो मलम् .. 21 ..
16.129.m: The food of a physician is pus; the food of an unchaste woman is semen; / the food of a usurer is excrement; the food of a weapons-dealer is filth.

16.129.s:
sahasrakṛtvastveteṣāmanne yadbhakṣite bhavet ..
tadekavāraṃ bhuktena kanyāvikrayiṇo bhavet .. 22 ..
16.129.d:
सहस्रकृत्वस्त्वेतेषामन्ने यद्भक्षिते भवेत् ..
तदेकवारं भुक्तेन कन्याविक्रयिणो भवेत् .. 22 ..
16.129.m: Whatever [sin] there would be from eating the food of these a thousand times / occurs by eating once the food of one who sells his daughter.

16.129.s:
sahasrakṛtvastasyaiva bhukte'nne yatphalaṃ bhavet ..
tadantyajānāmannena sakṛdbhuktena vai bhavet .. 23 ..
16.129.d:
सहस्रकृत्वस्तस्यैव भुक्तेऽन्ने यत्फलं भवेत् ..
तदन्त्यजानामन्नेन सकृद्भुक्तेन वै भवेत् .. 23 ..
16.129.m: Whatever consequence there would be from eating his food a thousand times / indeed occurs by eating the food of outcastes only once.

16.129.s:
tatkathaṃ mama viprendrāścaṃḍālasyādhamātmanaḥ ..
dharmamevaṃ vijānanto nūnamannaṃ jihīrṣatha .. 24 .. ..
16.129.d:
तत्कथं मम विप्रेन्द्राश्चंडालस्याधमात्मनः ..
धर्ममेवं विजानन्तो नूनमन्नं जिहीर्षथ .. 24 .. ..
16.129.m: Then how is it, O best of brahmins, that knowing dharma thus, / you surely wish to take the food of me, a base-minded outcaste?”

16.129.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
jīvitātyayamāpanno yo'nnamādriyate tataḥ ..
ākāśa iva paṃkena na sa pāpena lipyate .. 25 ..
16.129.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
जीवितात्ययमापन्नो योऽन्नमाद्रियते ततः ..
आकाश इव पंकेन न स पापेन लिप्यते .. 25 ..
16.129.m: The seers said: / “One who has encountered danger to his life, who accepts food from anywhere, / is not smeared with sin, just as the sky is not smeared by mud.

16.129.s:
ajīgartaḥ sutaṃ haṃtumupasarpanbubhukṣitaḥ ..
na cālipyata pāpena kṣutpratīghātamācaran .. 26 ..
16.129.d:
अजीगर्तः सुतं हंतुमुपसर्पन्बुभुक्षितः ..
न चालिप्यत पापेन क्षुत्प्रतीघातमाचरन् .. 26 ..
16.129.m: Ajīgarta, starving, approached to kill his son, / and he was not smeared with sin, acting to ward off hunger.

16.129.s:
bhāradvājaḥ kṣudhārtastu saputro vijane vane ..
bahvīrgā upajagrāha bṛhajjyotirmahāmanāḥ .. 27 ..
16.129.d:
भारद्वाजः क्षुधार्तस्तु सपुत्रो विजने वने ..
बह्वीर्गा उपजग्राह बृहज्ज्योतिर्महामनाः .. 27 ..
16.129.m: And Bhāradvāja, distressed by hunger with his son in a lonely forest, / accepted many cows—he of great brilliance, great-minded.

16.129.s:
kṣudhārto gītamabhyāgādviśvāmitraḥ śvajāghanīm ..
caṇḍālahastādādāya dharmādharmavicakṣaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
16.129.d:
क्षुधार्तो गीतमभ्यागाद्विश्वामित्रः श्वजाघनीम् ..
चण्डालहस्तादादाय धर्माधर्मविचक्षणः .. 28 ..
16.129.m: Viśvāmitra, distressed by hunger, discerning what is dharma and not dharma, / came to sing [praise], taking the haunch of a dog from the hand of an outcaste.

16.129.s:
śvamāṃsamicchannartau tu dharmānna cyayate sma saḥ ..
prāṇānāṃ parirakṣārthaṃ vāmadevo na liptavān .. 29 ..
16.129.d:
श्वमांसमिच्छन्नर्तौ तु धर्मान्न च्ययते स्म सः ..
प्राणानां परिरक्षार्थं वामदेवो न लिप्तवान् .. 29 ..
16.129.m: Desiring dog's flesh in a time of distress, he did not fall from dharma; / for the sake of preserving life, Vāmadeva was not tainted.

16.129.s:
evaṃ jñātvā dharmabuddhe sāṃprataṃ mā vicāraya ..
dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnamasmākamiha yācatām.. 7.1.129.30 ..
16.129.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा धर्मबुद्धे सांप्रतं मा विचारय ..
ददस्वान्नं ददस्वान्नमस्माकमिह याचताम्.. 7.1.129.30 ..
16.129.m: Knowing this, O you of righteous mind, do not hesitate now! / Give food, give food to us who are begging here!”

16.129.s:
.. caṃḍāla uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ bhavatāṃ kāryamidamaṃgīkṛtaṃ dhuvam..
tadiyaṃ matsutā kanyā bhavadbhiḥ parigṛhyatām .. 31 ..
16.129.d:
.. चंडाल उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं भवतां कार्यमिदमंगीकृतं धुवम्..
तदियं मत्सुता कन्या भवद्भिः परिगृह्यताम् .. 31 ..
16.129.m: The outcaste said: / “If indeed this task is certainly accepted by you, / then let this daughter of mine, a maiden, be taken by you.

16.129.s:
bhavatāṃ yograṇīrjyeṣṭhaḥ sa cemāmudvaheddhruvam ..
dāsye varṣāśanaṃ paścādīpsitaṃ bhavatāṃ dvijāḥ .. 32 ..
16.129.d:
भवतां योग्रणीर्ज्येष्ठः स चेमामुद्वहेद्ध्रुवम् ..
दास्ये वर्षाशनं पश्चादीप्सितं भवतां द्विजाः .. 32 ..
16.129.m: Whoever is your foremost leader and eldest, let him certainly marry her. / Afterwards, O twice-born, I shall give you your desired year's supply of food.”

16.129.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktā ṛṣayo devi lajjayā''natakandharāḥ ..
pratyālocya yathānyāyaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ samanūdvahan.. 33 ..
16.129.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्ता ऋषयो देवि लज्जया'ऽनतकन्धराः ..
प्रत्यालोच्य यथान्यायं वसिष्ठं समनूद्वहन्.. 33 ..
16.129.m: Īśvara said: / Addressed thus, O goddess, the seers, their necks bowed in shame, / conferred according to proper rule and directed [the proposal] to Vasiṣṭha.

16.129.s:
vasiṣṭho'pi samākhyāya āpaddharmaṃ mahāmanāḥ ..
kālasyānantaraprekṣī prodvavāhā'ntyajāṅganām ..
akṣamāleti vai nāmnīṃ prasiddhā bhuvanatraye .. 34 ..
16.129.d:
वसिष्ठोऽपि समाख्याय आपद्धर्मं महामनाः ..
कालस्यानन्तरप्रेक्षी प्रोद्ववाहाऽन्त्यजाङ्गनाम् ..
अक्षमालेति वै नाम्नीं प्रसिद्धा भुवनत्रये .. 34 ..
16.129.m: Vasiṣṭha also, the great-minded, having explained the duty in times of distress / and looking to the needs of the moment, married the outcaste woman / named Akṣamālā, famed in the three worlds.

16.129.s:
yadā svakīyatejobhirarkabiṃbamarundhata ..
aruṃdhatī tadā jātā devadānava vaṃditā .. 35 ..
16.129.d:
यदा स्वकीयतेजोभिरर्कबिंबमरुन्धत ..
अरुंधती तदा जाता देवदानव वंदिता .. 35 ..
16.129.m: When she obstructed the disc of the sun by her own splendors, / she then became Arundhatī, praised by gods and demons.

16.129.s:
yādṛśena tu bhartrā strī saṃyujyeta yathāvidhi ..
sā tādṛgeva bhavati samudreṇeva nimnagā .. 36 ..
16.129.d:
यादृशेन तु भर्त्रा स्त्री संयुज्येत यथाविधि ..
सा तादृगेव भवति समुद्रेणेव निम्नगा .. 36 ..
16.129.m: Whatever sort of husband a woman is joined to according to rule, / she becomes just of that sort, like a river joined with the ocean.

16.129.s:
akṣamālā vasiṣṭhena saṃyuktā'dhama yonijā ..
śārṅgīva mandapālena jagāma hyarhaṇīyatām .. 37 ..
16.129.d:
अक्षमाला वसिष्ठेन संयुक्ताऽधम योनिजा ..
शार्ङ्गीव मन्दपालेन जगाम ह्यर्हणीयताम् .. 37 ..
16.129.m: Akṣamālā, born of a base womb, united with Vasiṣṭha, / attained worshipfulness, just as the female śārṅga bird did through Mandapāla.

16.129.s:
evaṃ kālakrameṇaiva prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ ..
saptarṣayo mahātmāno hyaruṃdhatyā samanvitāḥ .. 38 ..
16.129.d:
एवं कालक्रमेणैव प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः ..
सप्तर्षयो महात्मानो ह्यरुंधत्या समन्विताः .. 38 ..
16.129.m: Thus, in the course of time, the great-souled Seven Seers / together with Arundhatī came to the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.129.s: tīrthāni preṣayāmāsuḥ sarvasiddhipradāni tām .. 39 ..
16.129.d: तीर्थानि प्रेषयामासुः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदानि ताम् .. 39 ..
16.129.m: They sent her to the sacred fords that grant all perfections.

16.129.s:
eṣāmanveṣamāṇānāṃ tava devī hyaruṃdhatī..
apaśyalliṃgamekaṃ tu vṛkṣajālāṃtare sthitam .. 7.1.129.40 ..
16.129.d:
एषामन्वेषमाणानां तव देवी ह्यरुंधती..
अपश्यल्लिंगमेकं तु वृक्षजालांतरे स्थितम् .. 7.1.129.40 ..
16.129.m: While they were searching, your goddess Arundhatī / saw a single liṅga situated within a cluster of trees.

16.129.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśamevaṃ jātismarā'bhavat ..
pūrvasmiñjanmani mayā rajobhāvāṃtarasthayā .. 41 ..
16.129.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशमेवं जातिस्मराऽभवत् ..
पूर्वस्मिञ्जन्मनि मया रजोभावांतरस्थया .. 41 ..
16.129.m: Seeing that lord of the gods of gods, she thus remembered her previous birth: / “In a previous birth, while I was in the state of menstruation,

16.129.s:
ajñānabhāvāddeveśo nūnaṃ cātrārcitaḥ. śivaḥ ..
tasmātkarmaphalaṃ prāptamantyajatvaṃ dvijanmanā .. 42..
16.129.d:
अज्ञानभावाद्देवेशो नूनं चात्रार्चितः. शिवः ..
तस्मात्कर्मफलं प्राप्तमन्त्यजत्वं द्विजन्मना .. 42..
16.129.m: through ignorance the lord of gods, Śiva, was surely worshipped by me here. / From that the fruit of action was obtained: outcaste status by one twice-born.

16.129.s:
kastena sadṛśo devaḥ śaṃbhunā bhuvanatraye ..
rājyaṃ niyamināmevaṃ yo ruṣṭo'pi prayacchati .. 43 ..
16.129.d:
कस्तेन सदृशो देवः शंभुना भुवनत्रये ..
राज्यं नियमिनामेवं यो रुष्टोऽपि प्रयच्छति .. 43 ..
16.129.m: What god is equal to that Śambhu in the three worlds, / who, even when angered, gives sovereignty to the self-restrained in this way?”

16.129.s:
iti saṃciṃtya manasā tatraiva niratā'bhavat ..
pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye .. 44 ..
16.129.d:
इति संचिंत्य मनसा तत्रैव निरताऽभवत् ..
पूजयामास तल्लिंगं दिव्याब्दानां शतं प्रिये .. 44 ..
16.129.m: Reflecting thus in her mind, she became devoted right there; / she worshipped that liṅga for a hundred divine years, O beloved.

16.129.s:
evaṃ tasya prabhāvena dṛśyate gaganāṃtare ..
aruṃdhatī satī hyeṣā dṛṣṭā duṣkṛtanāśinī .. 45 ..
16.129.d:
एवं तस्य प्रभावेन दृश्यते गगनांतरे ..
अरुंधती सती ह्येषा दृष्टा दुष्कृतनाशिनी .. 45 ..
16.129.m: Thus, by its power, this chaste Arundhatī is seen in the sky, / who, when beheld, destroys evil deeds.

16.129.s:
akṣamāleśvarastvevaṃ yathāvatkathitastava ..
tatastu dvāparasyānte kalau saṃdhyāṃśake gate .. 46 ...
16.129.d:
अक्षमालेश्वरस्त्वेवं यथावत्कथितस्तव ..
ततस्तु द्वापरस्यान्ते कलौ संध्यांशके गते .. 46 ...
16.129.m: Thus Akṣamāleśvara has been recounted to you as it truly happened. / Then, at the end of the Dvāpara age, when the twilight portion of the Kali age had arrived...

16.129.s:
aṃdhāsurasutaścāsīdugrasena iti śrutaḥ ..
sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya putrārthaṃ liṃgameyivān .. 47 ..
16.129.d:
अंधासुरसुतश्चासीदुग्रसेन इति श्रुतः ..
स प्रभासं समासाद्य पुत्रार्थं लिंगमेयिवान् .. 47 ..
16.129.m: And there was a son of the Asura Andhaka known as Ugrasena; / having reached Prabhāsa, he approached the liṅga for the sake of a son.

16.129.s:
akṣamāleśvaraṃ nāma jñātvā māhātmyamadbhutam ..
samārādhya mahādevaṃ nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca ..
saṃprāptavāṃstadā putraṃ kaṃsāsuramiti śrutam .. 48 ..
16.129.d:
अक्षमालेश्वरं नाम ज्ञात्वा माहात्म्यमद्भुतम् ..
समाराध्य महादेवं नव वर्षाणि पंच च ..
संप्राप्तवांस्तदा पुत्रं कंसासुरमिति श्रुतम् .. 48 ..
16.129.m: Having learned the wondrous māhātmya of the one named Akṣamāleśvara, / and having propitiated Mahādeva for fourteen years, / he then obtained a son known as the Asura Kaṃsa.

16.129.s:
tatkālāntaramārabhya ugraseneśvaro'bhavat ..
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi .. 49 ..
16.129.d:
तत्कालान्तरमारभ्य उग्रसेनेश्वरोऽभवत् ..
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. 49 ..
16.129.m: Beginning from that time, it became Ugraseneśvara, / destroying the sin of all creatures by its very darśana and touch.

16.129.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ ..
mahānti pātakānyāhurnaśyaṃti tasya darśanāt .. 7.1.129.50 ..
16.129.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः ..
महान्ति पातकान्याहुर्नश्यंति तस्य दर्शनात् .. 7.1.129.50 ..
16.129.m: Killing a brahmin, drinking wine, theft, and intercourse with the guru's wife— / these are called the great sins; they are destroyed by its darśana.

16.129.s:
tatraiva ṛṣipañcamyāṃ prāpte bhādrapade śubhe ..
akṣamāleśvaraṃ pūjya mucyate nārakādbhayāt .. 51 ..
16.129.d:
तत्रैव ऋषिपञ्चम्यां प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे शुभे ..
अक्षमालेश्वरं पूज्य मुच्यते नारकाद्भयात् .. 51 ..
16.129.m: Right there on Ṛṣipañcamī, when auspicious Bhādrapada has arrived, / having worshipped Akṣamāleśvara, one is freed from the fear of hell.

16.129.s:
gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatrānnamudakaṃ tathā ..
sarvapāpavināśāya pretyānaṃtasukhāya ca .. 52 ..
16.129.d:
गोप्रदानं प्रशंसंति तत्रान्नमुदकं तथा ..
सर्वपापविनाशाय प्रेत्यानंतसुखाय च .. 52 ..
16.129.m: They praise the gift of a cow there, and likewise food and water, / for the destruction of all sins and for unending bliss hereafter.

16.129.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi hyakṣamāleśvarodbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ śrutaṃ duḥkhanibarhaṇam .. 53 ..
16.129.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि ह्यक्षमालेश्वरोद्भवम् ..
माहात्म्यं पापशमनं श्रुतं दुःखनिबर्हणम् .. 53 ..
16.129.m: Thus has been told to you, O goddess, the origin of Akṣamāleśvara; / this māhātmya, which pacifies sin and removes sorrow, has been heard.

16.129.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ugraseneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 129 ..
16.129.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उग्रसेनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 129 ..
16.129.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Ugraseneśvara,' in the first [section, the] Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section, the] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
